## 3. ViewModels

### `AuthViewModel.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.viewmodel

import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.BankRepository

class AuthViewModel : ViewModel() {
    private val repository = BankRepository()

    val isLoggedIn = mutableStateOf(false)
    val errorMessage = mutableStateOf<String?>(null)

    fun login(username: String, password: String) {
        if (repository.login(username, password)) {
            isLoggedIn.value = true
            errorMessage.value = null
        } else {
            errorMessage.value = "Invalid credentials"
        }
    }

    fun logout() {
        isLoggedIn.value = false
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.viewmodel

import com.example.bankapp.data.model.Transaction

    val account = mutableStateOf<Account?>(null)
```

## 4. Navigation

### `AppNav.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.navigation

import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.lifecycle.viewmodel.compose.viewModel
import androidx.navigation.compose.*
import com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.DashboardScreen
import com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.LoginScreen
import com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.TransactionsScreen
import com.example.bankapp.viewmodel.AuthViewModel
import com.example.bankapp.viewmodel.BankViewModel

@Composable
fun AppNav() {
    val navController = rememberNavController()
    val authViewModel: AuthViewModel = viewModel()
    val bankViewModel: BankViewModel = viewModel()

    NavHost(navController = navController, startDestination = "login") {
        composable("login") {
            LoginScreen(
                authViewModel = authViewModel,
                onLoginSuccess = {
                    bankViewModel.loadData()
                    navController.navigate("dashboard") {
                        popUpTo("login") { inclusive = true }
                    }
                }
            )
        }

        composable("dashboard") {
            DashboardScreen(
                bankViewModel = bankViewModel,
                onViewTransactions = { navController.navigate("transactions") },
                onLogout = {
                    authViewModel.logout()
                    navController.navigate("login") {
                        popUpTo("dashboard") { inclusive = true }
                    }
                }
            )
        }

        composable("transactions") {
            TransactionsScreen(bankViewModel = bankViewModel)
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens

@Composable
fun LoginScreen(

    onLoginSuccess: () -> Unit
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.items
import androidx.compose.material3.*

import com.example.bankapp.data.model.TransactionType
import com.example.bankapp.viewmodel.BankViewModel

@Composable
fun DashboardScreen(
    bankViewModel: BankViewModel,
    onViewTransactions: () -> Unit,
    onLogout: () -> Unit
) {
    val account = bankViewModel.account.value
    val transactions = bankViewModel.transactions.value.take(3)

    Scaffold(
        topBar = {
            TopAppBar(
                title = { Text("My Bank") },
                actions = {
                    TextButton(onClick = onLogout) {
                        Text("Logout")
                    }
                }
            )
        }
    ) { padding ->
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .padding(padding)
                .padding(16.dp)
                .fillMaxSize()
        ) {
            account?.let {
                Card(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {
                        Text(it.accountName, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
                        Text(it.accountNumberMasked)
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
                        Text(
                            "${it.currency} ${"%.2f".format(it.balance)}",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))

            Text("Recent Transactions", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

            LazyColumn(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                items(transactions) { txn ->
                    ListItem(
                        headlineContent = { Text(txn.title) },
                        supportingContent = { Text(txn.date) },
                        trailingContent = {
                            val prefix = if (txn.type == TransactionType.CREDIT) "+" else "-"
                            Text("$prefix$${"%.2f".format(kotlin.math.abs(txn.amount))}")
                        }
                    )
                    Divider()
                }
            }

            Button(
                onClick = onViewTransactions,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            ) {
                Text("View All Transactions")
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### Secure token storage
```kotlin
import android.content.Context
import androidx.security.crypto.EncryptedSharedPreferences
import androidx.security.crypto.MasterKey

class TokenStorage(context: Context) {
    private val masterKey = MasterKey.Builder(context)
        .setKeyScheme(MasterKey.KeyScheme.AES256_GCM)
        .build()

    private val prefs = EncryptedSharedPreferences.create(
        context,
        "secure_prefs",
        masterKey,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefKeyEncryptionScheme.AES256_SIV,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefValueEncryptionScheme.AES256_GCM
    )

    fun saveToken(token: String) {
        prefs.edit().putString("auth_token", token).apply()
    }

    fun getToken(): String? = prefs.getString("auth_token", null)

    fun clearToken() {
        prefs.edit().remove("auth_token").apply()
    }
}
```

### Auth repository
```kotlin
class AuthRepository(
    private val api: BankingApi,
    private val tokenStorage: TokenStorage
) {
    suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): Result<LoginResponse> {
        return try {
            val response = api.login(LoginRequest(username, password))
            tokenStorage.saveToken(response.token)
            Result.success(response)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Result.failure(e)
        }
    }

    fun logout() {
        tokenStorage.clearToken()
    }

    fun getToken(): String? = tokenStorage.getToken()
}
```

### ViewModel
```kotlin
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

sealed class AuthUiState {
    object Idle : AuthUiState()
    object Loading : AuthUiState()
    data class Success(val name: String) : AuthUiState()
    data class Error(val message: String) : AuthUiState()
}

class AuthViewModel(
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow<AuthUiState>(AuthUiState.Idle)
    val uiState: StateFlow<AuthUiState> = _uiState

    fun login(username: String, password: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = AuthUiState.Loading
            val result = authRepository.login(username, password)
            _uiState.value = result.fold(
                onSuccess = { AuthUiState.Success(it.customerName) },
                onFailure = { AuthUiState.Error(it.message ?: "Login failed") }
            )
        }
    }
}
```

## 6. Secure token storage

### `SecurePrefs.kt`
```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.security

import android.content.Context
import androidx.security.crypto.EncryptedSharedPreferences
import androidx.security.crypto.MasterKey

class SecurePrefs(context: Context) {

    private val masterKey = MasterKey.Builder(context)
        .setKeyScheme(MasterKey.KeyScheme.AES256_GCM)
        .build()

    private val prefs = EncryptedSharedPreferences.create(
        context,
        "secure_bank_prefs",
        masterKey,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefKeyEncryptionScheme.AES256_SIV,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefValueEncryptionScheme.AES256_GCM
    )

    fun saveToken(token: String) {
        prefs.edit().putString("auth_token", token).apply()
    }

    fun getToken(): String? = prefs.getString("auth_token", null)

    fun clearToken() {
        prefs.edit().remove("auth_token").apply()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.viewmodel

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.BankRepository
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

sealed class LoginUiState {
    object Idle : LoginUiState()
    object Loading : LoginUiState()
    object Success : LoginUiState()
    data class Error(val message: String) : LoginUiState()
}

class LoginViewModel(
    private val repository: BankRepository,
    private val securePrefsTokenSaver: (String) -> Unit
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow<LoginUiState>(LoginUiState.Idle)
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState

    fun login(username: String, password: String) {
        if (username.isBlank() || password.length < 6) {
            _uiState.value = LoginUiState.Error("Invalid credentials format")
            return
        }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = LoginUiState.Loading
            try {
                val response = repository.login(username, password)
                securePrefsTokenSaver(response.token)
                _uiState.value = LoginUiState.Success
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = LoginUiState.Error("Login failed")
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
)

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(DashboardUiState())

            try {

                val transactions = repository.getTransactions(token)
                _uiState.value = DashboardUiState(
                    account = account,
                    transactions = transactions
                )
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = DashboardUiState(error = "Failed to load data")
            }
        }
    }
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp

import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.activity.ComponentActivity
import androidx.activity.compose.setContent
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.BankRepository

import com.example.bankapp.viewmodel.LoginViewModel

class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        val securePrefs = SecurePrefs(this)
        val repository = BankRepository()

        setContent {
            var loggedIn by remember { mutableStateOf(securePrefs.getToken() != null) }

            if (loggedIn) {
                val dashboardViewModel = remember { DashboardViewModel(repository) }
                DashboardScreen(
                    viewModel = dashboardViewModel,
                    token = securePrefs.getToken().orEmpty()
                )
            } else {
                val loginViewModel = remember {
                    LoginViewModel(repository) { token ->
                        securePrefs.saveToken(token)
                        loggedIn = true
                    }
                }

                LoginScreen(
                    viewModel = loginViewModel,
                    onLoginSuccess = { loggedIn = true }
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
```

A real banking app should also include:

- **Certificate pinning**
- **Root/jailbreak detection strategy**
- **Device integrity checks**
- **Session expiration and refresh tokens**
- **Strong 2FA/MFA**

- **R8/ProGuard hardening**
- **Play Integrity API**
- **Backend-side fraud/risk controls**
- **Secure transfer confirmation flows**
- **Accessibility and anti-overlay protections where appropriate**

Also, avoid:
- Storing raw passwords
- Logging tokens or account data
- Using mock security patterns in production
- Trusting client-side validation alone

# 6. Secure Retrofit provider with certificate pinning

## `RetrofitProvider.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.securebank.data.api

import okhttp3.CertificatePinner
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.logging.HttpLoggingInterceptor
import retrofit2.Retrofit
import retrofit2.converter.gson.GsonConverterFactory

object RetrofitProvider {

    private const val BASE_URL = "https://api.yourbank.com/"

    private val certificatePinner = CertificatePinner.Builder()
        .add("api.yourbank.com", "sha256/AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=")
        .build()

    private val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
        level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.NONE
    }

    private val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
        .certificatePinner(certificatePinner)
        .addInterceptor(logging)
        .build()

    val authApi: AuthApi = Retrofit.Builder()
        .baseUrl(BASE_URL)
        .client(client)
        .addConverterFactory(GsonConverterFactory.create())
        .build()
        .create(AuthApi::class.java)

    val bankingApi: BankingApi = Retrofit.Builder()
        .baseUrl(BASE_URL)
        .client(client)
        .addConverterFactory(GsonConverterFactory.create())
        .build()
        .create(BankingApi::class.java)
}
```

```kotlin
class AuthViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    private val repository = AuthRepository()
    private val securePrefs = SecurePrefs(application)

    private val _loginState = MutableStateFlow<Result<String>?>(null)

    fun login(username: String, password: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {

                val response = repository.login(username, password)
                securePrefs.saveToken(response.token)
                _loginState.value = Result.success(response.token)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _loginState.value = Result.failure(e)
            }
        }
    }

    fun getSavedToken(): String? = securePrefs.getToken()
```

```kotlin
import com.example.securebank.data.model.Account
import com.example.securebank.data.model.Transaction
import com.example.securebank.data.repository.BankingRepository
import com.example.securebank.security.SecurePrefs
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class BankingViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    private val repository = BankingRepository()
    private val securePrefs = SecurePrefs(application)

    private val _accounts = MutableStateFlow<List<Account>>(emptyList())
    val accounts: StateFlow<List<Account>> = _accounts

    private val _transactions = MutableStateFlow<List<Transaction>>(emptyList())
    val transactions: StateFlow<List<Transaction>> = _transactions

    fun loadDashboard() {
        val token = securePrefs.getToken() ?: return
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                _accounts.value = repository.getAccounts(token)
                _transactions.value = repository.getTransactions(token)
            } catch (_: Exception) {
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.securebank.security

import androidx.biometric.BiometricManager
import androidx.fragment.app.FragmentActivity

class BiometricHelper(private val activity: FragmentActivity) {

    fun canAuthenticate(): Boolean {
        val biometricManager = BiometricManager.from(activity)
        return biometricManager.canAuthenticate(
            BiometricManager.Authenticators.BIOMETRIC_STRONG
        ) == BiometricManager.BIOMETRIC_SUCCESS
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.viewmodel

import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import com.example.bankingapp.data.BankingRepository
import com.example.bankingapp.model.User

class AuthViewModel(
    private val repository: BankingRepository = BankingRepository()
) : ViewModel() {

    val currentUser = mutableStateOf<User?>(null)
    val loginError = mutableStateOf<String?>(null)

    fun login(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        val user = repository.login(username, password)
        return if (user != null) {
            currentUser.value = user
            loginError.value = null
            true
        } else {
            loginError.value = "Invalid username or password"
            false
        }
    }

    fun logout() {
        currentUser.value = null
    }
}
```

```kotlin
import androidx.navigation.NavHostController
import androidx.navigation.compose.NavHost
import androidx.navigation.compose.composable
import com.example.bankingapp.ui.screens.AccountsScreen
import com.example.bankingapp.ui.screens.DashboardScreen
import com.example.bankingapp.ui.screens.LoginScreen
import com.example.bankingapp.ui.screens.TransactionsScreen
import com.example.bankingapp.viewmodel.AuthViewModel
import com.example.bankingapp.viewmodel.BankingViewModel

object Routes {
    const val LOGIN = "login"
    const val DASHBOARD = "dashboard"
    const val ACCOUNTS = "accounts"
    const val TRANSACTIONS = "transactions"
}

@Composable
fun AppNavGraph(
    navController: NavHostController,
    authViewModel: AuthViewModel = viewModel(),
    bankingViewModel: BankingViewModel = viewModel()
) {
    NavHost(
        navController = navController,
        startDestination = Routes.LOGIN
    ) {
        composable(Routes.LOGIN) {
            LoginScreen(
                authViewModel = authViewModel,
                onLoginSuccess = {
                    navController.navigate(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
                        popUpTo(Routes.LOGIN) { inclusive = true }
                    }
                }
            )
        }

        composable(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
            DashboardScreen(
                authViewModel = authViewModel,
                bankingViewModel = bankingViewModel,
                onAccountsClick = { navController.navigate(Routes.ACCOUNTS) },
                onTransactionsClick = { navController.navigate(Routes.TRANSACTIONS) },
                onLogout = {
                    authViewModel.logout()
                    navController.navigate(Routes.LOGIN) {
                        popUpTo(0)
                    }
                }
            )
        }

        composable(Routes.ACCOUNTS) {
            AccountsScreen(
                bankingViewModel = bankingViewModel
            )
        }

        composable(Routes.TRANSACTIONS) {
            TransactionsScreen(
                bankingViewModel = bankingViewModel
            )
        }
    }
}
```

# 9. Repository

## `data/repository/BankingRepository.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toDomain
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.LoginRequest
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val apiService: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) {
    suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): Result<String> {
        return try {
            val response = apiService.login(LoginRequest(username, password))
            Result.success(response.token)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Result.failure(e)
        }
    }

    fun getAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> {
        return accountDao.getAccounts().map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }
    }

    suspend fun refreshAccounts() {
        val remoteAccounts = apiService.getAccounts()
        accountDao.insertAccounts(remoteAccounts.map { it.toEntity() })
    }

    fun getTransactions(accountId: String): Flow<List<Transaction>> {
        return transactionDao.getTransactions(accountId).map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }
    }

    suspend fun refreshTransactions(accountId: String) {
        val remoteTransactions = apiService.getTransactions(accountId)
        transactionDao.insertTransactions(remoteTransactions.map { it.toEntity() })
    }
}
```

```kotlin
    private val repository: BankingRepository

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = true, error = null)
            val result = repository.login(_uiState.value.username, _uiState.value.password)
            _uiState.value = if (result.isSuccess) {
                _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = false, isLoggedIn = true)
            } else {
                _uiState.value.copy(
                    isLoading = false,
                    error = result.exceptionOrNull()?.message ?: "Login failed"
```

```kotlin
    data object Login : Screen("login")
    data object Accounts : Screen("accounts")
    data object Transactions : Screen("transactions/{accountId}") {
        fun createRoute(accountId: String) = "transactions/$accountId"
    }

@Composable
fun BankNavGraph() {
    val navController = rememberNavController()

    NavHost(
        navController = navController,
        startDestination = Screen.Login.route
    ) {
        composable(Screen.Login.route) {
            val vm: LoginViewModel = hiltViewModel()
            LoginScreen(
                viewModel = vm,
                onLoginSuccess = {
                    navController.navigate(Screen.Accounts.route) {
                        popUpTo(Screen.Login.route) { inclusive = true }
                    }
                }
            )
        }

        composable(Screen.Accounts.route) {
            val vm: AccountsViewModel = hiltViewModel()
            AccountsScreen(
                viewModel = vm,
                onAccountClick = { accountId ->
                    navController.navigate(Screen.Transactions.createRoute(accountId))
                }
            )
        }

        composable(
            route = Screen.Transactions.route,
            arguments = listOf(navArgument("accountId") { type = NavType.StringType })
        ) {
            val vm: TransactionsViewModel = hiltViewModel()
            TransactionsScreen(viewModel = vm)
        }
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankingapp.data.model.Account
import com.example.bankingapp.data.model.Transaction
import com.example.bankingapp.data.model.TransactionType
import com.example.bankingapp.data.model.User

class BankingRepository {

    private var loggedInUser: User? = null

    private val account = Account(
        id = "acc_001",
        accountName = "Checking Account",
        accountNumberMasked = "****1234",
        balance = 5240.75,
        currency = "USD"
    )

    private val transactions = mutableListOf(
        Transaction("txn_001", "Coffee Shop", "2026-09-10", -5.75, TransactionType.DEBIT),
        Transaction("txn_002", "Salary", "2026-09-09", 2500.00, TransactionType.CREDIT),
        Transaction("txn_003", "Electric Bill", "2026-09-08", -120.40, TransactionType.DEBIT),
        Transaction("txn_004", "Grocery Store", "2026-09-07", -86.15, TransactionType.DEBIT)
    )

    fun login(username: String, password: String): Result<User> {
        return if (username == "user" && password == "password") {
            val user = User(
                id = "user_001",
                fullName = "Alex Johnson",
                email = "alex@example.com"
            )
            loggedInUser = user
            Result.success(user)
        } else {
            Result.failure(Exception("Invalid credentials"))
        }
    }

    fun getLoggedInUser(): User? = loggedInUser

    fun getAccount(): Account = account

    fun getTransactions(): List<Transaction> = transactions.toList()

    fun transfer(toAccount: String, amount: Double): Result<Unit> {
        if (toAccount.isBlank()) {
            return Result.failure(Exception("Recipient account is required"))
        }
        if (amount <= 0) {
            return Result.failure(Exception("Amount must be greater than zero"))
        }
        if (amount > account.balance) {
            return Result.failure(Exception("Insufficient funds"))
        }

        val updatedBalance = account.balance - amount

        val newTransaction = Transaction(
            id = "txn_${System.currentTimeMillis()}",
            title = "Transfer to $toAccount",
            date = "2026-09-16",
            amount = -amount,
            type = TransactionType.DEBIT
        )

        transactions.add(0, newTransaction)

        currentAccount = account.copy(balance = updatedBalance)

        return Result.success(Unit)
    }

    private var currentAccount: Account = account

    fun getCurrentAccount(): Account = currentAccount
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.viewmodel

import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import com.example.bankingapp.data.repository.BankingRepository
import com.example.bankingapp.ui.state.TransferUiState

class TransferViewModel(
    private val repository: BankingRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    var uiState by mutableStateOf(TransferUiState())
        private set

    fun onRecipientChange(value: String) {
        uiState = uiState.copy(recipientAccount = value, errorMessage = null, successMessage = null)
    }

    fun onAmountChange(value: String) {
        uiState = uiState.copy(amount = value, errorMessage = null, successMessage = null)
    }

    fun submitTransfer() {
        val amountValue = uiState.amount.toDoubleOrNull()
        if (amountValue == null) {
            uiState = uiState.copy(errorMessage = "Enter a valid amount")
            return
        }

        uiState = uiState.copy(isSubmitting = true, errorMessage = null, successMessage = null)

        val result = repository.transfer(uiState.recipientAccount, amountValue)

        uiState = result.fold(
            onSuccess = {
                uiState.copy(
                    isSubmitting = false,
                    successMessage = "Transfer completed successfully",
                    recipientAccount = "",
                    amount = ""
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.navigation

import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable

import com.example.bankingapp.viewmodel.DashboardViewModel
import com.example.bankingapp.viewmodel.LoginViewModel
import com.example.bankingapp.viewmodel.TransferViewModel

object Routes {
    const val LOGIN = "login"
    const val DASHBOARD = "dashboard"
    const val TRANSFER = "transfer"
}

@Composable
fun AppNavGraph(
    navController: NavHostController,
    repository: BankingRepository
) {
    val factory = AppViewModelFactory(repository)

    NavHost(
        navController = navController,
        startDestination = Routes.LOGIN
    ) {
        composable(Routes.LOGIN) {
            val viewModel: LoginViewModel = viewModel(factory = factory)
            LoginScreen(
                uiState = viewModel.uiState,
                onUsernameChange = viewModel::onUsernameChange,
                onPasswordChange = viewModel::onPasswordChange,
                onLoginClick = {
                    viewModel.login()
                    if (viewModel.uiState.isLoggedIn) {
                        navController.navigate(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
                            popUpTo(Routes.LOGIN) { inclusive = true }
                        }
                    }
                }
            )
        }

        composable(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
            val viewModel: DashboardViewModel = viewModel(factory = factory)
            viewModel.loadData()

            DashboardScreen(
                uiState = viewModel.uiState,
                onTransferClick = {
                    navController.navigate(Routes.TRANSFER)
                }
            )
        }

        composable(Routes.TRANSFER) {
            val viewModel: TransferViewModel = viewModel(factory = factory)

            TransferScreen(
                uiState = viewModel.uiState,
                onRecipientChange = viewModel::onRecipientChange,
                onAmountChange = viewModel::onAmountChange,
                onSubmitClick = viewModel::submitTransfer,
                onBackClick = { navController.popBackStack() }
            )
        }
    }
}
```

# 12. Important Fixes to Apply

There is one issue in the repository implementation above:
- `getAccount()` returns the original immutable `account`
- `transfer()` updates `currentAccount`

To keep things consistent, use only `currentAccount`.

## Replace `BankingRepository.kt` with this corrected version:

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankingapp.data.model.Account
import com.example.bankingapp.data.model.Transaction
import com.example.bankingapp.data.model.TransactionType
import com.example.bankingapp.data.model.User
import java.time.LocalDate

class BankingRepository {

    private var loggedInUser: User? = null

    private var currentAccount = Account(
        id = "acc_001",
        accountName = "Checking Account",
        accountNumberMasked = "****1234",
        balance = 5240.75,
        currency = "USD"
    )

    private val transactions = mutableListOf(
        Transaction("txn_001", "Coffee Shop", "2026-09-10", -5.75, TransactionType.DEBIT),
        Transaction("txn_002", "Salary", "2026-09-09", 2500.00, TransactionType.CREDIT),
        Transaction("txn_003", "Electric Bill", "2026-09-08", -120.40, TransactionType.DEBIT),
        Transaction("txn_004", "Grocery Store", "2026-09-07", -86.15, TransactionType.DEBIT)
    )

    fun login(username: String, password: String): Result<User> {
        return if (username == "user" && password == "password") {
            val user = User(
                id = "user_001",
                fullName = "Alex Johnson",
                email = "alex@example.com"
            )
            loggedInUser = user
            Result.success(user)
        } else {
            Result.failure(Exception("Invalid credentials"))
        }
    }

    fun getLoggedInUser(): User? = loggedInUser

    fun getCurrentAccount(): Account = currentAccount

    fun getTransactions(): List<Transaction> = transactions.toList()

    fun transfer(toAccount: String, amount: Double): Result<Unit> {
        if (toAccount.isBlank()) {
            return Result.failure(Exception("Recipient account is required"))
        }
        if (amount <= 0) {
            return Result.failure(Exception("Amount must be greater than zero"))
        }
        if (amount > currentAccount.balance) {
            return Result.failure(Exception("Insufficient funds"))
        }

        currentAccount = currentAccount.copy(balance = currentAccount.balance - amount)

        val newTransaction = Transaction(
            id = "txn_${System.currentTimeMillis()}",
            title = "Transfer to $toAccount",
            date = LocalDate.now().toString(),
            amount = -amount,
            type = TransactionType.DEBIT
        )

        transactions.add(0, newTransaction)

        return Result.success(Unit)
    }
}
```

# 13. Recommended Improvement for Dashboard Reload

Right now, `viewModel.loadData()` is called directly inside the composable destination, which is not ideal because recomposition can call it multiple times.

Use `LaunchedEffect`.

```kotlin
    androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        viewModel.loadData()
    }

    DashboardScreen(
        uiState = viewModel.uiState,
        onTransferClick = {
            navController.navigate(Routes.TRANSFER)
        }
    )
}
```

# 14. Recommended Improvement for Refresh After Transfer

When returning from transfer, dashboard should reflect updated balance and transactions.

Simple approach:
- Reload dashboard when screen resumes or when navigating back
- Or share observable repository state using `StateFlow`

For an initial implementation, easiest improvement is to call `loadData()` each time dashboard is entered using `LaunchedEffect`.

A better architecture would use:
- `MutableStateFlow<Account>`
- `MutableStateFlow<List<Transaction>>`

# 8. Repository

## `data/repository/BankingRepository.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toDomain
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.TransferRequestDto
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val apiService: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) {
    fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        accountDao.getAccounts().map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }

    fun observeTransactions(accountId: String): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        transactionDao.getTransactions(accountId).map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }

    suspend fun refreshAccounts() {
        val remoteAccounts = apiService.getAccounts()
        accountDao.insertAccounts(remoteAccounts.map { it.toEntity() })
    }

    suspend fun refreshTransactions(accountId: String) {
        val remoteTransactions = apiService.getTransactions(accountId)
        transactionDao.insertTransactions(remoteTransactions.map { it.toEntity() })
    }

    suspend fun makeTransfer(fromAccountId: String, toAccountNumber: String, amount: Double) {
        apiService.makeTransfer(
            TransferRequestDto(
                fromAccountId = fromAccountId,
                toAccountNumber = toAccountNumber,
                amount = amount
            )
        )
        refreshAccounts()
        refreshTransactions(fromAccountId)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.transfer

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.BankingRepository
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

@HiltViewModel
class TransferViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repository: BankingRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(TransferUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<TransferUiState> = _uiState

    fun updateFromAccount(id: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(fromAccountId = id)
    }

    fun updateToAccountNumber(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(toAccountNumber = value)
    }

    fun updateAmount(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(amount = value)
    }

    fun submit() {
        val state = _uiState.value
        val amount = state.amount.toDoubleOrNull()

        if (state.fromAccountId.isBlank() || state.toAccountNumber.isBlank() || amount == null || amount <= 0.0) {
            _uiState.value = state.copy(error = "Invalid transfer details")
            return
        }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = state.copy(isSubmitting = true, error = null)
            try {
                repository.makeTransfer(
                    fromAccountId = state.fromAccountId,
                    toAccountNumber = state.toAccountNumber,
                    amount = amount
                )
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    isSubmitting = false,
                    success = true
                )
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    isSubmitting = false,
                    error = e.message ?: "Transfer failed"
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
object Routes {
    const val LOGIN = "login"
    const val DASHBOARD = "dashboard"
    const val TRANSACTIONS = "transactions"
    const val TRANSFER = "transfer"
}

@Composable
fun BankNavGraph() {
    val navController = rememberNavController()

    NavHost(
        navController = navController,
        startDestination = Routes.LOGIN
    ) {
        composable(Routes.LOGIN) {
            LoginScreen(
                onLoginSuccess = {
                    navController.navigate(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
                        popUpTo(Routes.LOGIN) { inclusive = true }
                    }
                }
            )
        }

        composable(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
            DashboardScreen(
                onAccountClick = { accountId ->
                    navController.navigate("${Routes.TRANSACTIONS}/$accountId")
                },
                onTransferClick = {
                    navController.navigate(Routes.TRANSFER)
                }
            )
        }

        composable(
            route = "${Routes.TRANSACTIONS}/{accountId}",
            arguments = listOf(navArgument("accountId") { type = NavType.StringType })
        ) { backStackEntry ->
            val accountId = backStackEntry.arguments?.getString("accountId").orEmpty()
            TransactionsScreen(accountId = accountId)
        }

        composable(Routes.TRANSFER) {
            TransferScreen(
                onTransferSuccess = {
                    navController.popBackStack()
                }
            )
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.navigation

import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.lifecycle.viewmodel.compose.viewModel
import androidx.navigation.NavHostController
import androidx.navigation.compose.NavHost

import com.example.bankapp.ui.screen.LoginScreen
import com.example.bankapp.ui.screen.TransactionsScreen
import com.example.bankapp.ui.viewmodel.AccountViewModel
import com.example.bankapp.ui.viewmodel.AuthViewModel

object Routes {
    const val LOGIN = "login"
    const val DASHBOARD = "dashboard"
    const val TRANSACTIONS = "transactions"
}

@Composable
fun AppNavGraph(navController: NavHostController) {
    val authViewModel: AuthViewModel = viewModel()
    val accountViewModel: AccountViewModel = viewModel()

    NavHost(
        navController = navController,
        startDestination = Routes.LOGIN
    ) {
        composable(Routes.LOGIN) {
            LoginScreen(
                viewModel = authViewModel,
                onLoginSuccess = {
                    navController.navigate(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
                        popUpTo(Routes.LOGIN) { inclusive = true }
                    }
                }
            )
        }

        composable(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
            DashboardScreen(
                authViewModel = authViewModel,
                accountViewModel = accountViewModel,
                onViewTransactions = {
                    navController.navigate(Routes.TRANSACTIONS)
                }
            )
        }

        composable(Routes.TRANSACTIONS) {
            TransactionsScreen(
                accountViewModel = accountViewModel,
                onBack = { navController.popBackStack() }
            )
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
            items(accountViewModel.transactions) { transaction ->
                TransactionItem(transaction)
                HorizontalDivider()
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun TransactionItem(transaction: Transaction) {
    val amountColor = if (transaction.type == TransactionType.CREDIT) {
        MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
    } else {
        MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error
    }

    val prefix = if (transaction.type == TransactionType.CREDIT) "+" else "-"

    ListItem(
        headlineContent = { Text(transaction.title) },
        supportingContent = { Text(transaction.date) },
        trailingContent = {
            Text(
                text = "$prefix${formatAmount(transaction.amount)}",
                color = amountColor
            )
        },
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
    )
}

fun formatAmount(amount: Double): String {
    return NumberFormat.getCurrencyInstance(Locale.US).format(amount)
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.ui.viewmodel

import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import com.example.bankingapp.data.BankingRepository
import com.example.bankingapp.model.User

class AuthViewModel(
    private val repository: BankingRepository = BankingRepository()
) : ViewModel() {

    var user by mutableStateOf<User?>(null)
        private set

    var loginError by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
        private set

    fun login(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        val loggedInUser = repository.login(username, password)
        return if (loggedInUser != null) {
            user = loggedInUser
            loginError = null
            true
        } else {
```

```kotlin
import com.example.bankingapp.ui.viewmodel.AuthViewModel
import com.example.bankingapp.ui.viewmodel.BankingViewModel

object Routes {
    const val LOGIN = "login"
    const val DASHBOARD = "dashboard"
    const val ACCOUNTS = "accounts"
    const val TRANSACTIONS = "transactions"
}

@Composable
fun BankingNavGraph(
    navController: NavHostController,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val authViewModel: AuthViewModel = viewModel()
    val bankingViewModel: BankingViewModel = viewModel()

    NavHost(
        navController = navController,
        startDestination = Routes.LOGIN,
        modifier = modifier
    ) {
        composable(Routes.LOGIN) {
            LoginScreen(
                authViewModel = authViewModel,
                onLoginSuccess = {
                    navController.navigate(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
                        popUpTo(Routes.LOGIN) { inclusive = true }
                    }
                }
            )
        }

        composable(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
            DashboardScreen(
                authViewModel = authViewModel,
                onAccountsClick = { navController.navigate(Routes.ACCOUNTS) },
                onTransactionsClick = { navController.navigate(Routes.TRANSACTIONS) },
                onLogout = {
                    authViewModel.logout()
                    navController.navigate(Routes.LOGIN) {
                        popUpTo(0)
                    }
                }
            )
        }

        composable(Routes.ACCOUNTS) {
            AccountsScreen(
                accounts = bankingViewModel.accounts
            )
        }

        composable(Routes.TRANSACTIONS) {
            TransactionsScreen(
                transactions = bankingViewModel.transactions
            )
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.ui

import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import com.example.bankingapp.data.Transaction
import com.example.bankingapp.data.UserAccount

@Composable
fun BankingApp() {
    var loggedIn by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    var account by remember {
        mutableStateOf(
            UserAccount(
                username = "demo",
                balance = 1250.75,
                transactions = listOf(
                    Transaction(1, "Salary", 2000.00, true),
                    Transaction(2, "Groceries", 85.20, false),
                    Transaction(3, "Electric Bill", 120.50, false)
                )
            )
        )
    }

    if (!loggedIn) {
        LoginScreen(
            onLogin = { username, password ->
                if (username == "demo" && password == "password") {
                    loggedIn = true
                }
            }
        )
    } else {
        DashboardScreen(
            account = account,
            onTransfer = { recipient, amount ->
                if (recipient.isNotBlank() && amount > 0 && amount <= account.balance) {
                    val newTransaction = Transaction(
                        id = account.transactions.size + 1,
                        title = "Transfer to $recipient",
                        amount = amount,
                        isCredit = false
                    )
                    account = account.copy(
                        balance = account.balance - amount,
                        transactions = listOf(newTransaction) + account.transactions
                    )
                }
            },
            onLogout = {
                loggedIn = false
            }
        )
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.items
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import com.example.bankingapp.data.Transaction
import com.example.bankingapp.data.UserAccount
import java.util.Locale

@Composable
fun DashboardScreen(
    account: UserAccount,
    onTransfer: (String, Double) -> Unit,
    onLogout: () -> Unit
) {
    var recipient by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var amountText by remember { mutableStateOf("") }

    Scaffold(
        topBar = {
            TopAppBar(
                title = { Text("Welcome, ${account.username}") },
                actions = {
                    TextButton(onClick = onLogout) {
                        Text("Logout")
                    }
                }
            )
        }
    ) { padding ->
        LazyColumn(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(padding)
                .padding(16.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)
        ) {
            item {
                Card(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {
                        Text("Current Balance", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
                        Text(
                            text = "$" + String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", account.balance),
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            item {
                Card(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {
                        Text("Transfer Money", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))

                        OutlinedTextField(
                            value = recipient,
                            onValueChange = { recipient = it },
                            label = { Text("Recipient") },
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                        )

                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))

                        OutlinedTextField(
                            value = amountText,
                            onValueChange = { amountText = it },
                            label = { Text("Amount") },
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                        )

                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))

                        Button(
                            onClick = {
                                val amount = amountText.toDoubleOrNull() ?: 0.0
                                onTransfer(recipient, amount)
                                recipient = ""
                                amountText = ""
                            },
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                        ) {
                            Text("Send")
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            item {
                Text("Recent Transactions", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
            }

            items(account.transactions) { transaction ->
                TransactionRow(transaction)
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun TransactionRow(transaction: Transaction) {
    val color = if (transaction.isCredit) Color(0xFF2E7D32) else Color(0xFFC62828)
    val prefix = if (transaction.isCredit) "+" else "-"

    Card(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(16.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
        ) {
            Text(transaction.title)
            Text(
                text = "$prefix$" + String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", transaction.amount),
                color = color
            )
        }
    }
}
```

Below is an initial implementation of a privacy-focused browser extension that blocks common tracking scripts using the `webRequest` API.

This example targets **Manifest V2** style APIs for simplicity and broad conceptual clarity. I’ll also note how to adapt it for **Manifest V3**, since Chrome now prefers MV3.

---

## Features

- Blocks requests to known tracking domains
- Works on all websites
- Lightweight and easy to extend
- Logs blocked requests in the background console

---

## Project structure

```text
privacy-blocker/
├── manifest.json
├── background.js
├── rules.js
├── icons/
│   ├── icon16.png
│   ├── icon48.png
│   └── icon128.png
```

---

## `manifest.json`

```json
{
  "manifest_version": 2,
  "name": "Privacy Tracker Blocker",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Blocks known tracking scripts and requests for improved privacy.",
  "permissions": [
    "webRequest",
    "webRequestBlocking",
    "<all_urls>"
  ],
  "background": {
    "scripts": ["rules.js", "background.js"],
    "persistent": true
  },
  "browser_action": {
    "default_title": "Privacy Tracker Blocker"
  },
  "icons": {
    "16": "icons/icon16.png",
    "48": "icons/icon48.png",
    "128": "icons/icon128.png"
  }
}
```

---

## `rules.js`

This file contains a starter list of tracking domains.

```js
const TRACKER_DOMAINS = [
  "google-analytics.com",
  "www.google-analytics.com",
  "ssl.google-analytics.com",
  "doubleclick.net",
  "www.googletagmanager.com",
  "connect.facebook.net",
  "facebook.com/tr",
  "static.hotjar.com",
  "script.hotjar.com",
  "vars.hotjar.com",
  "cdn.segment.com",
  "api.segment.io",
  "analytics.twitter.com",
  "ads-twitter.com",
  "snap.licdn.com",
  "px.ads.linkedin.com",
  "bat.bing.com",
  "cdn.mouseflow.com",
  "api.mixpanel.com"
];
```

---

## `background.js`

This script intercepts outgoing requests and blocks ones matching the tracker list.

```js
function isTrackerUrl(url) {
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(url);
    const hostname = parsed.hostname;
    const fullUrl = parsed.href;

    return TRACKER_DOMAINS.some((domain) => {
      return (
        hostname === domain ||
        hostname.endsWith("." + domain) ||
        fullUrl.includes(domain)
      );
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
}

chrome.webRequest.onBeforeRequest.addListener(
  function (details) {
    if (isTrackerUrl(details.url)) {
      console.log("Blocked tracker:", details.url);
      return { cancel: true };
    }

    return { cancel: false };
  },
  { urls: ["<all_urls>"] },
  ["blocking"]
);
```

---

## How to load it

### Chrome
1. Open `chrome://extensions/`
2. Enable **Developer mode**
3. Click **Load unpacked**
4. Select the `privacy-blocker/` folder

### Firefox
1. Open `about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox`
2. Click **Load Temporary Add-on**
3. Select `manifest.json`

---

## Recommended next improvements

### 1. Move from substring matching to stricter hostname matching
The current implementation uses:
- exact hostname match
- subdomain match
- fallback URL substring match

That substring match is simple but can create false positives. A better approach is to separate:
- hostname-based rules
- path-based rules

---

### 2. Add first-party exception logic
You may want to avoid blocking a request if the tracker belongs to the same site the user is visiting.

Example:
- Visiting `google.com`
- Request to `analytics.google.com`

This may or may not be considered third-party tracking depending on your policy.

---

### 3. Add a popup UI
Useful features:
- enable/disable blocking
- show number of blocked requests
- whitelist current site

---

### 4. Use a larger blocklist
You could import or periodically update from:
- EasyPrivacy
- Disconnect tracking protection lists
- DuckDuckGo Tracker Radar

---

## Better Manifest V3 direction

If you want a modern Chrome-compatible version, the preferred approach is:
- use `declarativeNetRequest`
- define static or dynamic blocking rules
- use a service worker instead of persistent background scripts

That is more future-proof and better for store compatibility.

---

```json
    "<all_urls>"
  ],

    "service_worker": "background.js"
  },

    "128": "icons/icon128.png"
  }
}
```

## `background.js`

```js
const trackerDomains = [
  "google-analytics.com",
  "doubleclick.net",
  "googletagmanager.com",
  "connect.facebook.net",
  "hotjar.com",
  "segment.com",
  "segment.io",
  "analytics.twitter.com",
  "ads-twitter.com",
  "linkedin.com",
  "bing.com",
  "mixpanel.com"
];

chrome.runtime.onInstalled.addListener(async () => {
  const rules = trackerDomains.map((domain, index) => ({
    id: index + 1,
    priority: 1,
    action: { type: "block" },
    condition: {
      urlFilter: `||${domain}`,
      resourceTypes: ["script", "xmlhttprequest", "image", "sub_frame"]
    }
  }));

  await chrome.declarativeNetRequest.updateDynamicRules({
    removeRuleIds: rules.map(rule => rule.id),
    addRules: rules
  });
});
```

`icons/icon16.png` - `icons/icon48.png` - `icons/icon128.png` If you want, you can omit the `icons` section from `manifest.json` during testing. --- ## How to load it in Chrome 1. Create the folder structure above. 2. Save `manifest.json` and `rules.json`. 3. Open Chrome and go to: ```text chrome://extensions/ ``` 4. Enable **Developer mode**. 5. Click **Load unpacked**. 6. Below is a practical starting point for a **low-latency trading platform skeleton** designed to be **fast now** and **scalable later**.

## Important note
A real low-latency trading system is not just “some code.” It requires:
- careful architecture
- deterministic performance
- risk controls
- exchange-specific adapters
- observability
- fault tolerance
- compliance and auditability

So instead of pretending a single file is enough, I’ll give you a **production-oriented architecture** plus **code skeletons** you can build on.

---

# Recommended architecture

For low latency and future scaling, split the system into these services:

1. **Market Data Gateway**
   - Connects to exchanges
   - Normalizes market data
   - Publishes to internal bus

2. **Strategy Engine**
   - Consumes normalized market data
   - Generates signals/orders
   - Stateless if possible for easy scaling

3. **Risk Engine**
   - Pre-trade checks
   - Position limits
   - Kill switch
   - Can be colocated for latency or isolated for safety

4. **Order Management System (OMS)**
   - Tracks order lifecycle
   - Handles idempotency
   - Correlates exchange acks/fills/rejects

5. **Execution Gateway**
   - Exchange-specific order routing
   - Session management
   - Retries/reconnects

6. **Position Service**
   - Maintains positions, PnL, exposure
   - Event-sourced if possible

7. **Event Bus**
   - For scale: NATS, Kafka, Redpanda, Aeron, or Chronicle Queue
   - For ultra-low latency in-process: lock-free ring buffer

8. **Observability**
   - Metrics
   - Structured logs
   - Tracing where appropriate

---

# Technology choices

## If you want lowest latency
Use:
- **C++ or Rust** for execution path
- kernel/network tuning
- lock-free queues
- memory pools
- CPU pinning

## If you want fast development with decent performance
Use:
- **Go** for gateways/services
- **Rust/C++** for critical path later

A common approach:
- **Go** for orchestration, OMS, risk, APIs
- **Rust/C++** for market data parsing and execution path

- event-driven architecture

# 2. In-memory event bus

This is a simple pub/sub abstraction. Later you can replace it with NATS/Kafka/Aeron without changing business logic.

## `internal/bus/bus.go`

```go
package bus

import "sync"

type Handler[T any] func(T)

type Topic[T any] struct {
	mu       sync.RWMutex
	handlers []Handler[T]
}

func NewTopic[T any]() *Topic[T] {
	return &Topic[T]{handlers: make([]Handler[T], 0, 8)}
}

func (t *Topic[T]) Subscribe(h Handler[T]) {
	t.mu.Lock()
	defer t.mu.Unlock()
	t.handlers = append(t.handlers, h)
}

func (t *Topic[T]) Publish(msg T) {
	t.mu.RLock()
	handlers := append([]Handler[T](nil), t.handlers...)
	t.mu.RUnlock()

	for _, h := range handlers {
		h(msg)
	}
}
```

For true low latency, you would replace this with:
- single-producer/single-consumer ring buffer
- preallocated message structs
- no interface boxing
- no heap churn

But this abstraction keeps the design clean.

# 4. Risk engine

## `internal/risk/engine.go`

```go
package risk

import (
	"errors"
	"sync"

	"trading-platform/internal/model"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidQty     = errors.New("invalid quantity")
	ErrMaxOrderQty    = errors.New("max order quantity exceeded")
	ErrMaxPosition    = errors.New("max position exceeded")
	ErrInvalidPrice   = errors.New("invalid price")
	ErrTradingBlocked = errors.New("trading blocked")
)

type Limits struct {
	MaxOrderQty int64
	MaxPosition int64
}

type Engine struct {
	mu        sync.RWMutex
	limits    map[string]Limits
	positions map[string]int64
	blocked   bool
}

func NewEngine() *Engine {
	return &Engine{
		limits:    make(map[string]Limits),
		positions: make(map[string]int64),
	}
}

func (e *Engine) SetLimits(symbol string, l Limits) {
	e.mu.Lock()
	defer e.mu.Unlock()
	e.limits[symbol] = l
}

func (e *Engine) UpdatePosition(symbol string, pos int64) {
	e.mu.Lock()
	defer e.mu.Unlock()
	e.positions[symbol] = pos
}

func (e *Engine) BlockTrading(block bool) {
	e.mu.Lock()
	defer e.mu.Unlock()
	e.blocked = block
}

func (e *Engine) Check(req model.OrderRequest) error {
	e.mu.RLock()
	defer e.mu.RUnlock()

	if e.blocked {
		return ErrTradingBlocked
	}
	if req.Qty <= 0 {
		return ErrInvalidQty
	}
	if req.Type == model.Limit && req.Price <= 0 {
		return ErrInvalidPrice
	}

	lim, ok := e.limits[req.Symbol]
	if !ok {
		lim = Limits{
			MaxOrderQty: 1000,
			MaxPosition: 10000,
		}
	}

	if req.Qty > lim.MaxOrderQty {
		return ErrMaxOrderQty
	}

	curPos := e.positions[req.Symbol]
	projected := curPos
	if req.Side == model.Buy {
		projected += req.Qty
	} else {
		projected -= req.Qty
	}

	if projected > lim.MaxPosition || projected < -lim.MaxPosition {
		return ErrMaxPosition
	}

	return nil
}
```

```go
package position

import (
	"sync"

	"trading-platform/internal/model"
)

type Service struct {
	mu        sync.RWMutex
	positions map[string]int64
}

func NewService() *Service {
	return &Service{
		positions: make(map[string]int64),
	}
}

func (s *Service) ApplyExecution(er model.ExecutionReport, side model.Side) {
	if er.LastFillQty <= 0 {
		return
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()

	if side == model.Buy {
		s.positions[er.Symbol] += er.LastFillQty
	} else {
		s.positions[er.Symbol] -= er.LastFillQty
	}
}

func (s *Service) Get(symbol string) int64 {
	s.mu.RLock()
	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
	return s.positions[symbol]
}
```

# 6. OMS

## `internal/oms/oms.go`

```go
package oms

import (
	"errors"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"trading-platform/internal/model"
)

var ErrOrderNotFound = errors.New("order not found")

type Service struct {
	mu     sync.RWMutex
	orders map[string]*model.Order
}

func NewService() *Service {
	return &Service{
		orders: make(map[string]*model.Order),
	}
}

func (s *Service) Create(req model.OrderRequest) *model.Order {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()

	o := &model.Order{
		OrderID:    req.OrderID,
		StrategyID: req.StrategyID,
		Symbol:     req.Symbol,
		Side:       req.Side,
		Qty:        req.Qty,
		LeavesQty:  req.Qty,
		Price:      req.Price,
		Type:       req.Type,
		Status:     model.PendingSend,
		CreatedAt:  time.Now(),
		UpdatedAt:  time.Now(),
	}
	s.orders[o.OrderID] = o
	return o
}

func (s *Service) Get(orderID string) (*model.Order, error) {
	s.mu.RLock()
	defer s.mu.RUnlock()

	o, ok := s.orders[orderID]
	if !ok {
		return nil, ErrOrderNotFound
	}
	return o, nil
}

func (s *Service) ApplyExecutionReport(er model.ExecutionReport) (*model.Order, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()

	o, ok := s.orders[er.OrderID]
	if !ok {
		return nil, ErrOrderNotFound
	}

	o.ExchangeOrdID = er.ExchangeOrdID
	o.Status = er.Status
	o.FilledQty = er.FilledQty
	o.LeavesQty = er.LeavesQty
	o.UpdatedAt = er.Timestamp

	return o, nil
}
```

```go
package execution

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"trading-platform/internal/model"
)

type ReportHandler func(model.ExecutionReport)

type PaperGateway struct {
	onReport ReportHandler
}

func NewPaperGateway(onReport ReportHandler) *PaperGateway {
	return &PaperGateway{onReport: onReport}
}

func (g *PaperGateway) Send(order *model.Order) error {
	now := time.Now()

	g.onReport(model.ExecutionReport{
		OrderID:       order.OrderID,
		ExchangeOrdID: fmt.Sprintf("ex-%s", order.OrderID),
		Symbol:        order.Symbol,
		Status:        model.Accepted,
		FilledQty:     0,
		LeavesQty:     order.Qty,
		LastFillQty:   0,
		LastFillPrice: 0,
		Timestamp:     now,
	})

	fillPrice := order.Price
	if order.Type == model.Market && fillPrice == 0 {
		fillPrice = 100.0
	}

	g.onReport(model.ExecutionReport{
		OrderID:       order.OrderID,
		ExchangeOrdID: fmt.Sprintf("ex-%s", order.OrderID),
		Symbol:        order.Symbol,
		Status:        model.Filled,
		FilledQty:     order.Qty,
		LeavesQty:     0,
		LastFillQty:   order.Qty,
		LastFillPrice: fillPrice,
		Timestamp:     now.Add(1 * time.Millisecond),
	})

	return nil
}
```

```go
package strategy

import (
	"time"

	"trading-platform/internal/model"
)

type SimpleCrossStrategy struct {
	StrategyID string
	Threshold  float64
}

func (s *SimpleCrossStrategy) OnTick(tick model.MarketTick) *model.Signal {
	mid := (tick.Bid + tick.Ask) / 2.0
	if tick.Last < mid-s.Threshold {
		return &model.Signal{
			StrategyID: s.StrategyID,
			Symbol:     tick.Symbol,
			Side:       model.Buy,
			Qty:        10,
			Price:      tick.Ask,
			Type:       model.Limit,
			Timestamp:  time.Now(),
		}
	}
	if tick.Last > mid+s.Threshold {
		return &model.Signal{
			StrategyID: s.StrategyID,
			Symbol:     tick.Symbol,
			Side:       model.Sell,
			Qty:        10,
			Price:      tick.Bid,
			Type:       model.Limit,
			Timestamp:  time.Now(),
		}
	}
	return nil
}
```

```go
package marketdata

import (
	"math/rand"
	"time"

	"trading-platform/internal/model"
)

type TickHandler func(model.MarketTick)

type Gateway struct {
	symbol  string
	onTick  TickHandler
	last    float64
	spread  float64
	running bool
}

func NewGateway(symbol string, startPrice float64, spread float64, onTick TickHandler) *Gateway {
	return &Gateway{
		symbol: symbol,
		onTick: onTick,
		last:   startPrice,
		spread: spread,
	}
}

func (g *Gateway) Start() {
	g.running = true
	go func() {
		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
		defer ticker.Stop()

		for g.running {
			<-ticker.C
			move := (rand.Float64() - 0.5) * 0.2
			g.last += move
			bid := g.last - g.spread/2
			ask := g.last + g.spread/2

			g.onTick(model.MarketTick{
				Symbol:    g.symbol,
				Bid:       bid,
				Ask:       ask,
				Last:      g.last,
				Timestamp: time.Now(),
			})
		}
	}()
}

func (g *Gateway) Stop() {
	g.running = false
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"time"

	"trading-platform/internal/bus"
	"trading-platform/internal/execution"
	"trading-platform/internal/marketdata"
	"trading-platform/internal/model"
	"trading-platform/internal/oms"
	"trading-platform/internal/position"
	"trading-platform/internal/risk"
	"trading-platform/internal/strategy"
	"trading-platform/internal/util"
)

func main() {
	tickTopic := bus.NewTopic[model.MarketTick]()
	signalTopic := bus.NewTopic[model.Signal]()
	reportTopic := bus.NewTopic[model.ExecutionReport]()

	riskEngine := risk.NewEngine()
	riskEngine.SetLimits("AAPL", risk.Limits{
		MaxOrderQty: 100,
		MaxPosition: 1000,
	})

	omsSvc := oms.NewService()
	posSvc := position.NewService()

	strat := &strategy.SimpleCrossStrategy{
		StrategyID: "strat-1",
		Threshold:  0.03,
	}

	execGateway := execution.NewPaperGateway(func(er model.ExecutionReport) {
		reportTopic.Publish(er)
	})

	tickTopic.Subscribe(func(tick model.MarketTick) {
		sig := strat.OnTick(tick)
		if sig != nil {
			signalTopic.Publish(*sig)
		}
	})

	signalTopic.Subscribe(func(sig model.Signal) {
		req := model.OrderRequest{
			OrderID:    util.NextOrderID(),
			StrategyID: sig.StrategyID,
			Symbol:     sig.Symbol,
			Side:       sig.Side,
			Qty:        sig.Qty,
			Price:      sig.Price,
			Type:       sig.Type,
			Timestamp:  time.Now(),
		}

		if err := riskEngine.Check(req); err != nil {
			log.Printf("risk reject order=%s symbol=%s err=%v", req.OrderID, req.Symbol, err)
			return
		}

		order := omsSvc.Create(req)
		if err := execGateway.Send(order); err != nil {
			log.Printf("execution send failed order=%s err=%v", order.OrderID, err)
			return
		}
	})

	reportTopic.Subscribe(func(er model.ExecutionReport) {
		order, err := omsSvc.ApplyExecutionReport(er)
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("apply execution report failed order=%s err=%v", er.OrderID, err)
			return
		}

		if er.LastFillQty > 0 {
			posSvc.ApplyExecution(er, order.Side)
			riskEngine.UpdatePosition(order.Symbol, posSvc.Get(order.Symbol))
		}

		fmt.Printf(
			"ER order=%s status=%s symbol=%s filled=%d leaves=%d pos=%d\n",
			er.OrderID,
			er.Status,
			er.Symbol,
			er.FilledQty,
			er.LeavesQty,
			posSvc.Get(er.Symbol),
		)
	})

	md := marketdata.NewGateway("AAPL", 100.0, 0.02, func(tick model.MarketTick) {
		tickTopic.Publish(tick)
	})

	md.Start()
	defer md.Stop()

	time.Sleep(5 * time.Second)
}
```

# Why this design scales

This design scales because each component is isolated behind interfaces:

- **Strategy** can be scaled horizontally
- **Execution gateways** can be per-exchange
- **Risk engine** can become a dedicated service
- **Bus** can move from in-memory to distributed messaging
- **OMS** can move from in-memory to persistent/event-sourced storage

---

# What to improve for real low latency

If your goal is serious low latency, here’s what you should do next.

## 1. Remove avoidable allocations
- avoid copying messages
- use object pools carefully
- preallocate buffers
- avoid `fmt.Sprintf` in hot path

## 2. Replace mutex-heavy structures
- use sharded maps
- use lock-free queues where appropriate
- single-thread ownership model per symbol/session

## 3. Use a ring buffer
Replace the generic bus with:
- Disruptor-style ring buffer
- Aeron/Chronicle Queue
- SPSC/MPMC queues

## 4. Partition by symbol
To scale:
- one worker per symbol group
- deterministic routing
- no shared mutable state across partitions

## 5. Add persistence and replay
You need:
- append-only event log
- order journal
- execution journal
- recovery on restart

## 6. Add exchange adapters
Real exchange gateways need:
- FIX/FAST/ITCH/OUCH/WebSocket/TCP/UDP support
- heartbeat/session recovery
- sequence numbers
- resend logic
- drop copy support

## 7. Add risk controls
Must-have:
- fat-finger checks
- max notional
- duplicate order detection
- self-trade prevention
- circuit breakers
- kill switch

## 8. Add observability
- Prometheus metrics
- p50/p99 latency histograms
- queue depth
- dropped message counters
- GC pause monitoring

## 9. Tune Go runtime if staying in Go
- minimize GC pressure
- benchmark with `pprof`
- pin critical goroutines if needed
- avoid excessive channels in hot path

## `internal/bus/bus.go`

A simple in-process pub/sub bus. For very low latency, you may later replace this with a ring buffer.

```go
package bus

import (
	"sync"

	"trading-platform/internal/model"
)

type Bus struct {
	mu          sync.RWMutex
	subscribers map[model.EventType][]chan model.Event
}

func New() *Bus {
	return &Bus{
		subscribers: make(map[model.EventType][]chan model.Event),
	}
}

func (b *Bus) Subscribe(eventType model.EventType, buffer int) <-chan model.Event {
	ch := make(chan model.Event, buffer)

	b.mu.Lock()
	b.subscribers[eventType] = append(b.subscribers[eventType], ch)
	b.mu.Unlock()

	return ch
}

func (b *Bus) Publish(evt model.Event) {
	b.mu.RLock()
	subs := b.subscribers[evt.Type]
	b.mu.RUnlock()

	for _, ch := range subs {
		select {
		case ch <- evt:
		default:
			// Drop on backpressure for now.
			// In production, use metrics, ring buffers, or explicit policies.
		}
	}
}
```

## `internal/risk/engine.go`

```go
package risk

import (
	"fmt"
	"sync"

	"trading-platform/internal/model"
)

type Engine struct {
	mu           sync.RWMutex
	maxOrderQty  int64
	maxPosition  int64
	positions    map[string]int64
	enabled      bool
}

func New(maxOrderQty, maxPosition int64) *Engine {
	return &Engine{
		maxOrderQty: maxOrderQty,
		maxPosition: maxPosition,
		positions:   make(map[string]int64),
		enabled:     true,
	}
}

func (e *Engine) Enable(v bool) {
	e.mu.Lock()
	e.enabled = v
	e.mu.Unlock()
}

func (e *Engine) UpdatePosition(fill *model.Fill) {
	e.mu.Lock()
	defer e.mu.Unlock()

	qty := fill.Qty
	if fill.Side == model.Sell {
		qty = -qty
	}
	e.positions[fill.Symbol] += qty
}

func (e *Engine) Check(order *model.NewOrder) error {
	e.mu.RLock()
	defer e.mu.RUnlock()

	if !e.enabled {
		return fmt.Errorf("trading disabled")
	}

	if order.Qty <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid quantity")
	}

	if order.Qty > e.maxOrderQty {
		return fmt.Errorf("order quantity exceeds limit")
	}

	current := e.positions[order.Symbol]
	projected := current
	if order.Side == model.Buy {
		projected += order.Qty
	} else {
		projected -= order.Qty
	}

	if projected > e.maxPosition || projected < -e.maxPosition {
		return fmt.Errorf("position limit exceeded")
	}

	return nil
}
```

## `internal/oms/oms.go`

```go
package oms

import (
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"

	"trading-platform/internal/model"
	"trading-platform/internal/risk"
)

type Status uint8

const (
	PendingNew Status = iota + 1
	Acked
	Filled
	Rejected
)

type OrderRecord struct {
	Order  model.NewOrder
	Status Status
}

type OMS struct {
	idSeq  atomic.Uint64
	mu     sync.RWMutex
	orders map[uint64]*OrderRecord
	risk   *risk.Engine
}

func New(r *risk.Engine) *OMS {
	return &OMS{
		orders: make(map[uint64]*OrderRecord),
		risk:   r,
	}
}

func (o *OMS) CreateOrder(symbol string, side model.Side, typ model.OrderType, qty int64, price float64) (*model.NewOrder, error) {
	id := o.idSeq.Add(1)

	order := &model.NewOrder{
		OrderID:   id,
		Symbol:    symbol,
		Side:      side,
		Type:      typ,
		Qty:       qty,
		Price:     price,
		Timestamp: time.Now(),
	}

	if err := o.risk.Check(order); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	o.mu.Lock()
	o.orders[id] = &OrderRecord{
		Order:  *order,
		Status: PendingNew,
	}
	o.mu.Unlock()

	return order, nil
}

func (o *OMS) OnAck(ack *model.OrderAck) {
	o.mu.Lock()
	defer o.mu.Unlock()

	if rec, ok := o.orders[ack.OrderID]; ok {
		rec.Status = Acked
	}
}

func (o *OMS) OnFill(fill *model.Fill) {
	o.mu.Lock()
	defer o.mu.Unlock()

	if rec, ok := o.orders[fill.OrderID]; ok {
		rec.Status = Filled
	}
}

func (o *OMS) OnReject(rej *model.Reject) {
	o.mu.Lock()
	defer o.mu.Unlock()

	if rec, ok := o.orders[rej.OrderID]; ok {
		rec.Status = Rejected
	}
}
```

```go
				Timestamp: time.Now(),
			},
		})
	}()
}
```

```go
package strategy

import (
	"log"

	"trading-platform/internal/bus"
	"trading-platform/internal/execution"
	"trading-platform/internal/model"
	"trading-platform/internal/oms"
)

type Engine struct {
	bus       *bus.Bus
	oms       *oms.OMS
	exec      *execution.Gateway
	symbol    string
	threshold float64
}

func New(b *bus.Bus, o *oms.OMS, e *execution.Gateway, symbol string, threshold float64) *Engine {
	return &Engine{
		bus:       b,
		oms:       o,
		exec:      e,
		symbol:    symbol,
		threshold: threshold,
	}
}

func (s *Engine) Start() {
	ch := s.bus.Subscribe(model.EventMarketData, 1024)

	go func() {
		for evt := range ch {
			md := evt.MarketData
			if md == nil || md.Symbol != s.symbol {
				continue
			}

			if md.Last < s.threshold {
				order, err := s.oms.CreateOrder(s.symbol, model.Buy, model.Limit, 10, md.Ask)
				if err != nil {
					log.Printf("strategy order rejected by risk: %v", err)
					continue
				}

				s.bus.Publish(model.Event{
					Type:     model.EventNewOrder,
					NewOrder: order,
				})

				s.exec.Send(order)
			}
		}
	}()
}
```

# What to improve next for real low latency

The above is a skeleton. For a serious platform, I would improve it in this order:

## 1. Replace generic event structs with typed pipelines
Current `Event` uses pointers and a tagged union style. That’s flexible but not ideal for latency.

Better:
- dedicated channels per message type
- or a preallocated ring buffer
- or SPSC queues where possible

## 2. Partition by symbol
To scale:
- assign symbols to workers
- each worker owns its own state
- avoid shared locks across symbols

Example:
- worker 1: AAPL, MSFT
- worker 2: NVDA, AMD

This reduces contention dramatically.

## 3. Single-writer principle
For hot state like:
- order books
- positions
- strategy state

Prefer one goroutine/thread owning the state rather than many goroutines locking it.

## 4. Preallocate memory / reduce GC pressure
In Go:
- use object pools carefully
- reuse buffers
- avoid excessive JSON in hot path
- keep audit logging asynchronous

## 5. Add a proper order state machine
Support:
- partial fills
- cancel pending
- canceled
- replace/amend
- expired
- rejected by venue
- duplicate/external events

## 6. Add persistence and recovery
Need:
- write-ahead event log
- snapshots
- replay on restart

## 7. Add real risk controls
Examples:
- fat-finger checks
- notional limits
- per-symbol limits
- per-strategy limits
- max loss / drawdown
- duplicate order throttles
- market state checks

## 8. Add observability
Need:
- p50/p99/p999 latency
- queue depth
- dropped event counts
- order reject reasons
- exchange round-trip timing

## 9. Add exchange adapters
Implement:
- FIX for brokers
- native binary protocols for low latency venues
- reconnect/session management
- sequence numbers
- resend/recovery

## 10. Benchmark and tune
You cannot call it low-latency without measuring:
- market data ingest latency
- strategy decision latency
- risk check latency
- order send latency
- ack/fill processing latency

- Avoid unnecessary locks
- Use preallocated objects where possible
- Use async I/O for network operations
- Keep hot path minimal
- Separate latency-sensitive path from persistence/logging path
- Prefer binary protocols internally if needed later
- Minimize GC pressure

For scalability:

- Use **message-driven architecture**
- Decouple components with interfaces
- Keep strategy/risk/execution as separate services/modules
- Make exchange adapters pluggable
- Add horizontal scaling where possible:
  - multiple market data consumers
  - multiple strategy workers

This is an in-memory async event bus. Later you can swap this with Kafka/NATS/Aeron.

```python
import asyncio
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Callable, Awaitable, Dict, List, Type

from core.events import Event, EventType


Handler = Callable[[Event], Awaitable[None]]


class EventBus:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._subscribers: Dict[EventType, List[Handler]] = defaultdict(list)

    def subscribe(self, event_type: EventType, handler: Handler) -> None:
        self._subscribers[event_type].append(handler)

    async def publish(self, event: Event) -> None:
        handlers = self._subscribers.get(event.event_type, [])
        if not handlers:
            return
        await asyncio.gather(*(handler(event) for handler in handlers))
```

```python
import time
from collections import defaultdict

from core.events import (
    EventType,
    SignalEvent,
    OrderRequestEvent,
    OrderRejectedEvent,
)
from core.bus import EventBus


class RiskEngine:
    def __init__(self, bus: EventBus, max_order_qty: float = 1000, max_position: float = 5000):
        self.bus = bus
        self.max_order_qty = max_order_qty
        self.max_position = max_position
        self.positions = defaultdict(float)

    def register(self) -> None:
        self.bus.subscribe(EventType.SIGNAL, self.on_signal)

    async def on_signal(self, event: SignalEvent) -> None:
        signed_qty = event.quantity if event.side == "BUY" else -event.quantity
        projected_pos = self.positions[event.symbol] + signed_qty

        if event.quantity > self.max_order_qty:
            await self.bus.publish(OrderRejectedEvent(
                event_type=EventType.ORDER_REJECTED,
                timestamp_ns=time.time_ns(),
                order_id="N/A",
                symbol=event.symbol,
                reason=f"Order qty {event.quantity} exceeds max {self.max_order_qty}"
            ))
            return

        if abs(projected_pos) > self.max_position:
            await self.bus.publish(OrderRejectedEvent(
                event_type=EventType.ORDER_REJECTED,
                timestamp_ns=time.time_ns(),
                order_id="N/A",
                symbol=event.symbol,
                reason=f"Projected position {projected_pos} exceeds max {self.max_position}"
            ))
            return

        order_id = f"{event.strategy_id}-{event.symbol}-{event.timestamp_ns}"
        await self.bus.publish(OrderRequestEvent(
            event_type=EventType.ORDER_REQUEST,
            timestamp_ns=time.time_ns(),
            order_id=order_id,
            symbol=event.symbol,
            side=event.side,
            quantity=event.quantity,
            price=event.price,
            order_type="LIMIT" if event.price is not None else "MARKET",
            strategy_id=event.strategy_id
        ))
```
