```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

type Message struct {
	ID        uint64
	Topic     string
	Payload   []byte
	CreatedAt int64 // unix nano
}

type Handler func(Message)

type PublishMode int

const (
	PublishBlock PublishMode = iota
	PublishDropIfFull
)

var (
	ErrTopicNotFound = errors.New("topic not found")
	ErrQueueFull     = errors.New("queue full")
	ErrClosed        = errors.New("router closed")
)

type Metrics struct {
	Published uint64 `json:"published"`
	Routed    uint64 `json:"routed"`
	Dropped   uint64 `json:"dropped"`
	Processed uint64 `json:"processed"`
	Failed    uint64 `json:"failed"`

	IngressLatencyNsP50 uint64 `json:"ingress_latency_ns_p50"`
	IngressLatencyNsP95 uint64 `json:"ingress_latency_ns_p95"`
	IngressLatencyNsP99 uint64 `json:"ingress_latency_ns_p99"`

	ProcessingLatencyNsP50 uint64 `json:"processing_latency_ns_p50"`
	ProcessingLatencyNsP95 uint64 `json:"processing_latency_ns_p95"`
	ProcessingLatencyNsP99 uint64 `json:"processing_latency_ns_p99"`
}

type latencyWindow struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	samples []uint64
	index   int
	filled  bool
}

func newLatencyWindow(size int) *latencyWindow {
	return &latencyWindow{
		samples: make([]uint64, size),
	}
}

func (w *latencyWindow) Record(v uint64) {
	w.mu.Lock()
	w.samples[w.index] = v
	w.index++
	if w.index >= len(w.samples) {
		w.index = 0
		w.filled = true
	}
	w.mu.Unlock()
}

func (w *latencyWindow) SnapshotPercentiles() (p50, p95, p99 uint64) {
	w.mu.Lock()
	var n int
	if w.filled {
		n = len(w.samples)
	} else {
		n = w.index
	}
	if n == 0 {
		w.mu.Unlock()
		return 0, 0, 0
	}
	cp := make([]uint64, n)
	copy(cp, w.samples[:n])
	w.mu.Unlock()

	quickSort(cp, 0, len(cp)-1)

	p50 = cp[(50*n)/100]
	p95 = cp[(95*n)/100]
	p99 = cp[(99*n)/100]
	if (50*n)/100 >= n {
		p50 = cp[n-1]
	}
	if (95*n)/100 >= n {
		p95 = cp[n-1]
	}
	if (99*n)/100 >= n {
		p99 = cp[n-1]
	}
	return
}

func quickSort(a []uint64, lo, hi int) {
	if lo >= hi {
		return
	}
	p := partition(a, lo, hi)
	quickSort(a, lo, p-1)
	quickSort(a, p+1, hi)
}

func partition(a []uint64, lo, hi int) int {
	pivot := a[hi]
	i := lo
	for j := lo; j < hi; j++ {
		if a[j] < pivot {
			a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
			i++
		}
	}
	a[i], a[hi] = a[hi], a[i]
	return i
}

type topicWorker struct {
	name    string
	queue   chan Message
	handler Handler
	router  *Router
	wg      sync.WaitGroup
}

func (tw *topicWorker) start(workerCount int) {
	for i := 0; i < workerCount; i++ {
		tw.wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer tw.wg.Done()
			for msg := range tw.queue {
				start := time.Now().UnixNano()
				ingressLatency := uint64(start - msg.CreatedAt)
				tw.router.ingressLatency.Record(ingressLatency)

				func() {
					defer func() {
						if r := recover(); r != nil {
							atomic.AddUint64(&tw.router.failed, 1)
						}
					}()
					tw.handler(msg)
				}()

				end := time.Now().UnixNano()
				processingLatency := uint64(end - start)
				tw.router.processingLatency.Record(processingLatency)
				atomic.AddUint64(&tw.router.processed, 1)
			}
		}()
	}
}

func (tw *topicWorker) stop() {
	close(tw.queue)
	tw.wg.Wait()
}

type Router struct {
	topics sync.Map // map[string]*topicWorker

	published uint64
	routed    uint64
	dropped   uint64
	processed uint64
	failed    uint64

	ingressLatency    *latencyWindow
	processingLatency *latencyWindow

	closed atomic.Bool
	msgID  atomic.Uint64
}

func NewRouter(latencySampleWindow int) *Router {
	return &Router{
		ingressLatency:    newLatencyWindow(latencySampleWindow),
		processingLatency: newLatencyWindow(latencySampleWindow),
	}
}

func (r *Router) RegisterTopic(name string, queueSize int, workerCount int, handler Handler) error {
	if r.closed.Load() {
		return ErrClosed
	}
	if name == "" {
		return errors.New("topic name required")
	}
	if queueSize <= 0 {
		return errors.New("queueSize must be > 0")
	}
	if workerCount <= 0 {
		return errors.New("workerCount must be > 0")
	}
	if handler == nil {
		return errors.New("handler required")
	}

	tw := &topicWorker{
		name:    name,
		queue:   make(chan Message, queueSize),
		handler: handler,
		router:  r,
	}
	actual, loaded := r.topics.LoadOrStore(name, tw)
	if loaded {
		_ = actual
		return fmt.Errorf("topic already exists: %s", name)
	}
	tw.start(workerCount)
	return nil
}

func (r *Router) Publish(topic string, payload []byte, mode PublishMode) error {
	if r.closed.Load() {
		return ErrClosed
	}

	v, ok := r.topics.Load(topic)
	if !ok {
		return ErrTopicNotFound
	}
	tw := v.(*topicWorker)

	msg := Message{
		ID:        r.msgID.Add(1),
		Topic:     topic,
		Payload:   payload,
		CreatedAt: time.Now().UnixNano(),
	}

	atomic.AddUint64(&r.published, 1)

	switch mode {
	case PublishBlock:
		tw.queue <- msg
		atomic.AddUint64(&r.routed, 1)
		return nil
	case PublishDropIfFull:
		select {
		case tw.queue <- msg:
			atomic.AddUint64(&r.routed, 1)
			return nil
		default:
			atomic.AddUint64(&r.dropped, 1)
			return ErrQueueFull
		}
	default:
		return errors.New("invalid publish mode")
	}
}

func (r *Router) Metrics() Metrics {
	p50In, p95In, p99In := r.ingressLatency.SnapshotPercentiles()
	p50Proc, p95Proc, p99Proc := r.processingLatency.SnapshotPercentiles()

	return Metrics{
		Published: atomic.LoadUint64(&r.published),
		Routed:    atomic.LoadUint64(&r.routed),
		Dropped:   atomic.LoadUint64(&r.dropped),
		Processed: atomic.LoadUint64(&r.processed),
		Failed:    atomic.LoadUint64(&r.failed),

		IngressLatencyNsP50: p50In,
		IngressLatencyNsP95: p95In,
		IngressLatencyNsP99: p99In,

		ProcessingLatencyNsP50: p50Proc,
		ProcessingLatencyNsP95: p95Proc,
		ProcessingLatencyNsP99: p99Proc,
	}
}

func (r *Router) Close() {
	if !r.closed.CompareAndSwap(false, true) {
		return
	}
	r.topics.Range(func(_, value any) bool {
		tw := value.(*topicWorker)
		tw.stop()
		return true
	})
}

func metricsHandler(router *Router) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(router.Metrics())
	}
}

func publishHandler(router *Router) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
		if req.Method != http.MethodPost {
			http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
			return
		}

		topic := req.URL.Query().Get("topic")
		modeStr := req.URL.Query().Get("mode")
		if topic == "" {
			http.Error(w, "missing topic", http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}

		mode := PublishBlock
		if modeStr != "" {
			v, err := strconv.Atoi(modeStr)
			if err == nil {
				mode = PublishMode(v)
			}
		}

		defer req.Body.Close()
		payload := make([]byte, req.ContentLength)
		_, _ = req.Body.Read(payload)

		err := router.Publish(topic, payload, mode)
		if err != nil {
			switch err {
			case ErrTopicNotFound:
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			case ErrQueueFull:
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusTooManyRequests)
			case ErrClosed:
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
			default:
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
			}
			return
		}

		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusAccepted)
	}
}

func main() {
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(runtime.NumCPU())

	router := NewRouter(100000)

	err := router.RegisterTopic("orders", 1_000_000, runtime.NumCPU(), func(msg Message) {
		// Simulate lightweight processing
		_ = len(msg.Payload)
	})
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}

	err = router.RegisterTopic("payments", 1_000_000, runtime.NumCPU(), func(msg Message) {
		_ = len(msg.Payload)
	})
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}

	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.Handle("/metrics", metricsHandler(router))
	mux.Handle("/publish", publishHandler(router))

	server := &http.Server{
		Addr:    ":8080",
		Handler: mux,
	}

	go func() {
		log.Println("server listening on :8080")
		if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
			log.Fatal(err)
		}
	}()

	// Example internal high-throughput publisher
	go func() {
		payload := []byte("example-message")
		for i := 0; ; i++ {
			topic := "orders"
			if i%2 == 0 {
				topic = "payments"
			}
			_ = router.Publish(topic, payload, PublishDropIfFull)
		}
	}()

	waitForShutdown(server, router)
}

func waitForShutdown(server *http.Server, router *Router) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()

	sigCh := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		// Placeholder for signal handling
		time.Sleep(30 * time.Second)
		close(sigCh)
	}()

	<-sigCh
	log.Println("shutting down...")

	shutdownCtx, shutdownCancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
	defer shutdownCancel()

	_ = server.Shutdown(shutdownCtx)
	router.Close()

	log.Printf("final metrics: %+v\n", router.Metrics())
}
```

# What this implementation does

## 1. Topic-based routing
Each topic gets:

- a bounded channel queue
- a configurable number of workers
- a handler function

Messages published to a topic are pushed into that topic’s queue and processed by workers.

## 2. High-throughput characteristics
This design is fast because it uses:

- in-memory channels
- atomic counters
- pre-sized bounded queues
- minimal synchronization on hot paths
- no per-message JSON parsing in the core router

## 3. Latency monitoring
Two latency types are tracked:

- **Ingress latency**: time from publish to worker pickup
- **Processing latency**: time spent inside the handler

Percentiles tracked:

- p50
- p95
- p99

## 4. Metrics endpoint
`GET /metrics`

Example response:

```json
{
  "published": 1200344,
  "routed": 1199988,
  "dropped": 356,
  "processed": 1199500,
  "failed": 0,
  "ingress_latency_ns_p50": 1200,
  "ingress_latency_ns_p95": 8200,
  "ingress_latency_ns_p99": 21000,
  "processing_latency_ns_p50": 300,
  "processing_latency_ns_p95": 900,
  "processing_latency_ns_p99": 2500
}
```

# Important issues in this initial version

This is a good starting point, but for true production-grade “millions/sec” systems, several things should be improved.

## 1. HTTP publish path is not optimal
This line is not safe or efficient enough:

```go
payload := make([]byte, req.ContentLength)
_, _ = req.Body.Read(payload)
```

Problems:

- `Read` may not fill the full buffer
- `ContentLength` may be `-1`
- allocates per request

Better:

- use `io.ReadAll` for correctness in a simple version
- later move to a binary TCP/UDP/custom protocol
- use buffer pools

## 2. Latency percentile calculation is expensive
Current percentile calculation:

- copies the sample window
- sorts it on every metrics request

For production:

- use HDR Histogram
- use DDSketch
- use Prometheus histograms
- maintain lock-free rolling histograms

## 3. sync.Map may not be ideal for all workloads
If topics are mostly static, a better approach is:

- initialize topics once
- store them in a regular map protected during setup only
- use immutable routing tables

## 4. No backpressure strategy beyond drop/block
You may want:

- retry queues
- overflow queues
- priority queues
- dead-letter topics
- adaptive throttling

## 5. No persistence
This is currently:

- in-memory only
- no replay
- no durability

To extend:

- append-only commit log
- mmap or sequential disk writes
- segment rotation
- consumer offsets

## 6. No replication / clustering
For distributed scale:

- shard by topic or key
- use consistent hashing
- replicate partitions
- leader/follower model

## 7. Payload ownership is not enforced
`payload []byte` is passed through directly. If caller mutates it after publish, behavior is unsafe.

Options:

- copy payload on publish
- document immutable ownership contract
- use pooled buffers with reference discipline

## 8. Graceful shutdown is simplistic
Current shutdown:

- stops after a timer placeholder
- not real OS signal handling

Should use:

- `os/signal`
- `syscall.SIGINT`, `SIGTERM`

# Architecture

## Core ideas

- **Producers** publish messages into an ingress queue.
- A **router** dispatches messages to topic subscribers.
- **Subscribers** consume messages through buffered channels.

```go
package broker

import (
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type Message struct {
	ID          uint64
	Topic       string
	Payload     []byte
	CreatedAtNs int64
	RoutedAtNs  int64
}

var messagePool = sync.Pool{
	New: func() any {
		return &Message{}
	},
}

func AcquireMessage() *Message {
	return messagePool.Get().(*Message)
}

func ReleaseMessage(m *Message) {
	m.ID = 0
	m.Topic = ""
	m.Payload = nil
	m.CreatedAtNs = 0
	m.RoutedAtNs = 0
	messagePool.Put(m)
}

func NowNs() int64 {
	return time.Now().UnixNano()
}
```

```go
package broker

import (
	"sync/atomic"
)

type Metrics struct {
	Published uint64
	Routed    uint64
	Dropped   uint64
	Delivered uint64

	IngressLatencyNsTotal uint64
	EndToEndLatencyNsTotal uint64

	IngressLatencyMaxNs uint64
	EndToEndLatencyMaxNs uint64
}

func (m *Metrics) IncPublished() {
	atomic.AddUint64(&m.Published, 1)
}

func (m *Metrics) IncRouted() {
	atomic.AddUint64(&m.Routed, 1)
}

func (m *Metrics) IncDropped() {
	atomic.AddUint64(&m.Dropped, 1)
}

func (m *Metrics) IncDelivered() {
	atomic.AddUint64(&m.Delivered, 1)
}

func (m *Metrics) AddIngressLatency(ns uint64) {
	atomic.AddUint64(&m.IngressLatencyNsTotal, ns)
	updateMax(&m.IngressLatencyMaxNs, ns)
}

func (m *Metrics) AddEndToEndLatency(ns uint64) {
	atomic.AddUint64(&m.EndToEndLatencyNsTotal, ns)
	updateMax(&m.EndToEndLatencyMaxNs, ns)
}

func updateMax(addr *uint64, val uint64) {
	for {
		cur := atomic.LoadUint64(addr)
		if val <= cur {
			return
		}
		if atomic.CompareAndSwapUint64(addr, cur, val) {
			return
		}
	}
}

type Snapshot struct {
	Published             uint64
	Routed                uint64
	Dropped               uint64
	Delivered             uint64
	IngressLatencyAvgNs   uint64
	EndToEndLatencyAvgNs  uint64
	IngressLatencyMaxNs   uint64
	EndToEndLatencyMaxNs  uint64
}

func (m *Metrics) Snapshot() Snapshot {
	published := atomic.LoadUint64(&m.Published)
	routed := atomic.LoadUint64(&m.Routed)
	delivered := atomic.LoadUint64(&m.Delivered)

	ingTotal := atomic.LoadUint64(&m.IngressLatencyNsTotal)
	e2eTotal := atomic.LoadUint64(&m.EndToEndLatencyNsTotal)

	var ingAvg uint64
	if routed > 0 {
		ingAvg = ingTotal / routed
	}

	var e2eAvg uint64
	if delivered > 0 {
		e2eAvg = e2eTotal / delivered
	}

	return Snapshot{
		Published:            published,
		Routed:               routed,
		Dropped:              atomic.LoadUint64(&m.Dropped),
		Delivered:            delivered,
		IngressLatencyAvgNs:  ingAvg,
		EndToEndLatencyAvgNs: e2eAvg,
		IngressLatencyMaxNs:  atomic.LoadUint64(&m.IngressLatencyMaxNs),
		EndToEndLatencyMaxNs: atomic.LoadUint64(&m.EndToEndLatencyMaxNs),
	}
}
```

## `broker/broker.go`

```go
package broker

import (
	"errors"
	"hash/fnv"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
)

var ErrIngressFull = errors.New("ingress queue full")
var ErrSubscriberFull = errors.New("subscriber queue full")

type Handler func(*Message)

type subscriber struct {
	ch      chan *Message
	handler Handler
}

type Broker struct {
	ingress chan *Message
	workers int

	topMu sync.RWMutex
	topics map[string][]*subscriber

	metrics Metrics
	nextID  uint64

	wg      sync.WaitGroup
	stopCh  chan struct{}
}

func NewBroker(ingressSize int, workers int) *Broker {
	if workers <= 0 {
		workers = runtime.NumCPU()
	}
	b := &Broker{
		ingress: make(chan *Message, ingressSize),
		workers: workers,
		topics:  make(map[string][]*subscriber),
		stopCh:  make(chan struct{}),
	}
	b.start()
	return b
}

func (b *Broker) start() {
	for i := 0; i < b.workers; i++ {
		b.wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer b.wg.Done()
			for {
				select {
				case msg := <-b.ingress:
					if msg != nil {
						b.route(msg)
					}
				case <-b.stopCh:
					return
				}
			}
		}()
	}
}

func (b *Broker) Publish(topic string, payload []byte) error {
	msg := AcquireMessage()
	msg.ID = atomic.AddUint64(&b.nextID, 1)
	msg.Topic = topic
	msg.Payload = payload
	msg.CreatedAtNs = NowNs()

	b.metrics.IncPublished()

	select {
	case b.ingress <- msg:
		return nil
	default:
		b.metrics.IncDropped()
		ReleaseMessage(msg)
		return ErrIngressFull
	}
}

func (b *Broker) Subscribe(topic string, buffer int, handler Handler) {
	sub := &subscriber{
		ch:      make(chan *Message, buffer),
		handler: handler,
	}

	b.topMu.Lock()
	b.topics[topic] = append(b.topics[topic], sub)
	b.topMu.Unlock()

	b.wg.Add(1)
	go func() {
		defer b.wg.Done()
		for {
			select {
			case msg := <-sub.ch:
				if msg == nil {
					continue
				}
				b.metrics.IncDelivered()
				b.metrics.AddEndToEndLatency(SinceNs(msg.CreatedAtNs))
				handler(msg)
				ReleaseMessage(msg)
			case <-b.stopCh:
				return
			}
		}
	}()
}

func (b *Broker) route(msg *Message) {
	msg.RoutedAtNs = NowNs()
	b.metrics.IncRouted()
	b.metrics.AddIngressLatency(SinceNs(msg.CreatedAtNs))

	b.topMu.RLock()
	subs := b.topics[msg.Topic]
	b.topMu.RUnlock()

	if len(subs) == 0 {
		ReleaseMessage(msg)
		return
	}

	delivered := false
	for _, sub := range subs {
		cloned := AcquireMessage()
		*cloned = *msg

		select {
		case sub.ch <- cloned:
			delivered = true
		default:
			b.metrics.IncDropped()
			ReleaseMessage(cloned)
		}
	}

	ReleaseMessage(msg)

	if !delivered {
		// all subscriber queues were full
	}
}

func (b *Broker) Metrics() Snapshot {
	return b.metrics.Snapshot()
}

func (b *Broker) Stop() {
	close(b.stopCh)
	b.wg.Wait()
}

func HashTopic(topic string) uint32 {
	h := fnv.New32a()
	_, _ = h.Write([]byte(topic))
	return h.Sum32()
}
```

# How it works

## Publish path
1. Acquire message from pool
2. Stamp creation timestamp
3. Push into ingress queue
4. Worker picks it up and routes by topic

## Route path
1. Record routed timestamp
2. Update ingress latency
3. Lookup subscribers
4. Clone message per subscriber
5. Non-blocking send to subscriber queue

## Delivery path
1. Subscriber goroutine receives message
2. Record end-to-end latency
3. Invoke handler
4. Return message to pool

---

# Performance notes

This implementation is optimized for a strong starting point, but to truly reach **millions of messages/sec** in production, you would likely need:

## 1. Sharded routing
Instead of one shared ingress queue, use:
- N ingress shards
- topic hash to shard
- dedicated worker per shard

This reduces contention.

## 2. Avoid per-subscriber cloning
Right now, each subscriber gets a cloned `Message`. Better options:
- reference-counted immutable message
- arena allocation
- zero-copy payload ownership rules

## 3. Better latency histograms
Current metrics only track:
- average
- max

Production systems usually need:
- p50
- p95
- p99
- p99.9

Use:
- HDR Histogram
- DDSketch
- Prometheus histogram buckets

## 4. CPU affinity / batching
For ultra-low latency:
- batch ingress reads
- batch subscriber dispatch
- pin workers to CPUs where possible
- reduce scheduler churn

## 5. Backpressure strategy
Current behavior drops when queues are full. Alternatives:
- block publishers
- priority queues
- per-topic quotas
- dead-letter queues

## 6. Network support
To make this a real messaging system:
- TCP/UDP/QUIC ingress
- binary framing
- topic registration protocol
- consumer acknowledgements

```go
package router

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

type LatencyHistogram struct {
	buckets []time.Duration
	counts  []uint64
	sumNs   atomic.Uint64
	total   atomic.Uint64
}

func NewLatencyHistogram(buckets []time.Duration) *LatencyHistogram {
	sorted := append([]time.Duration(nil), buckets...)
	sort.Slice(sorted, func(i, j int) bool { return sorted[i] < sorted[j] })

	return &LatencyHistogram{
		buckets: sorted,
		counts:  make([]uint64, len(sorted)+1),
	}
}

func (h *LatencyHistogram) Observe(d time.Duration) {
	ns := uint64(d.Nanoseconds())
	h.sumNs.Add(ns)
	h.total.Add(1)

	for i, b := range h.buckets {
		if d <= b {
			atomic.AddUint64(&h.counts[i], 1)
			return
		}
	}
	atomic.AddUint64(&h.counts[len(h.counts)-1], 1)
}

func (h *LatencyHistogram) RenderPrometheus(name, help string) string {
	var sb strings.Builder
	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("# HELP %s %s\n", name, help))
	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("# TYPE %s histogram\n", name))

	var cumulative uint64
	for i, b := range h.buckets {
		c := atomic.LoadUint64(&h.counts[i])
		cumulative += c
		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s_bucket{le=\"%f\"} %d\n", name, b.Seconds(), cumulative))
	}
	last := atomic.LoadUint64(&h.counts[len(h.counts)-1])
	cumulative += last
	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s_bucket{le=\"+Inf\"} %d\n", name, cumulative))
	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s_sum %f\n", name, float64(h.sumNs.Load())/1e9))
	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s_count %d\n", name, h.total.Load()))
	return sb.String()
}

type Metrics struct {
	Received atomic.Uint64
	Routed   atomic.Uint64
	Dropped  atomic.Uint64
	Errors   atomic.Uint64

	queueDepths []atomic.Int64

	IngressLatency *LatencyHistogram
	HandlerLatency *LatencyHistogram

	mu sync.Mutex
}

func NewMetrics(workerCount int) *Metrics {
	return &Metrics{
		queueDepths: make([]atomic.Int64, workerCount),
		IngressLatency: NewLatencyHistogram([]time.Duration{
			10 * time.Microsecond,
			50 * time.Microsecond,
			100 * time.Microsecond,
			250 * time.Microsecond,
			500 * time.Microsecond,
			1 * time.Millisecond,
			2 * time.Millisecond,
			5 * time.Millisecond,
			10 * time.Millisecond,
			25 * time.Millisecond,
			50 * time.Millisecond,
			100 * time.Millisecond,
			250 * time.Millisecond,
			500 * time.Millisecond,
			1 * time.Second,
		}),
		HandlerLatency: NewLatencyHistogram([]time.Duration{
			1 * time.Microsecond,
			5 * time.Microsecond,
			10 * time.Microsecond,
			25 * time.Microsecond,
			50 * time.Microsecond,
			100 * time.Microsecond,
			250 * time.Microsecond,
			500 * time.Microsecond,
			1 * time.Millisecond,
			2 * time.Millisecond,
			5 * time.Millisecond,
			10 * time.Millisecond,
			25 * time.Millisecond,
			50 * time.Millisecond,
			100 * time.Millisecond,
		}),
	}
}

func (m *Metrics) SetQueueDepth(worker int, depth int64) {
	m.queueDepths[worker].Store(depth)
}

func (m *Metrics) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
	var sb strings.Builder

	sb.WriteString("# HELP hfmsg_received_total Total messages received\n")
	sb.WriteString("# TYPE hfmsg_received_total counter\n")
	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("hfmsg_received_total %d\n", m.Received.Load()))

	sb.WriteString("# HELP hfmsg_routed_total Total messages routed\n")
	sb.WriteString("# TYPE hfmsg_routed_total counter\n")
	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("hfmsg_routed_total %d\n", m.Routed.Load()))

	sb.WriteString("# HELP hfmsg_dropped_total Total messages dropped\n")
	sb.WriteString("# TYPE hfmsg_dropped_total counter\n")
	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("hfmsg_dropped_total %d\n", m.Dropped.Load()))

	sb.WriteString("# HELP hfmsg_errors_total Total handler errors\n")
	sb.WriteString("# TYPE hfmsg_errors_total counter\n")
	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("hfmsg_errors_total %d\n", m.Errors.Load()))

	sb.WriteString("# HELP hfmsg_worker_queue_depth Current queue depth per worker\n")
	sb.WriteString("# TYPE hfmsg_worker_queue_depth gauge\n")
	for i := range m.queueDepths {
		sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("hfmsg_worker_queue_depth{worker=\"%d\"} %d\n", i, m.queueDepths[i].Load()))
	}

	sb.WriteString(m.IngressLatency.RenderPrometheus(
		"hfmsg_ingress_latency_seconds",
		"Latency from message receipt to processing start",
	))
	sb.WriteString(m.HandlerLatency.RenderPrometheus(
		"hfmsg_handler_latency_seconds",
		"Latency spent in handler execution",
	))

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/plain; version=0.0.4")
	_, _ = w.Write([]byte(sb.String()))
}
```

```go
package router

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"hash/fnv"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type Handler interface {
	Handle(ctx context.Context, msg Message) error
}

type HandlerFunc func(ctx context.Context, msg Message) error

func (f HandlerFunc) Handle(ctx context.Context, msg Message) error {
	return f(ctx, msg)
}

type worker struct {
	id    int
	queue chan Message
}

type Router struct {
	workers []worker
	handler Handler
	metrics *Metrics

	ctx    context.Context
	cancel context.CancelFunc
	wg     sync.WaitGroup
}

func NewRouter(workerCount, queueSize int, handler Handler) *Router {
	if workerCount <= 0 {
		workerCount = runtime.NumCPU()
	}
	if queueSize <= 0 {
		queueSize = 65536
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())

	r := &Router{
		workers: make([]worker, workerCount),
		handler: handler,
		metrics: NewMetrics(workerCount),
		ctx:     ctx,
		cancel:  cancel,
	}

	for i := 0; i < workerCount; i++ {
		r.workers[i] = worker{
			id:    i,
			queue: make(chan Message, queueSize),
		}
		r.wg.Add(1)
		go r.runWorker(r.workers[i])
	}

	return r
}

func (r *Router) Metrics() *Metrics {
	return r.metrics
}

func (r *Router) Publish(msg Message) error {
	r.metrics.Received.Add(1)

	msg.EnqueuedAt = time.Now()
	idx := r.partition(msg.Key)
	w := r.workers[idx]

	select {
	case w.queue <- msg:
		r.metrics.Routed.Add(1)
		r.metrics.SetQueueDepth(idx, int64(len(w.queue)))
		return nil
	default:
		r.metrics.Dropped.Add(1)
		r.metrics.SetQueueDepth(idx, int64(len(w.queue)))
		return errors.New("worker queue full")
	}
}

func (r *Router) partition(key string) int {
	h := fnv.New32a()
	_, _ = h.Write([]byte(key))
	return int(h.Sum32() % uint32(len(r.workers)))
}

func (r *Router) runWorker(w worker) {
	defer r.wg.Done()

	for {
		select {
		case <-r.ctx.Done():
			return
		case msg := <-w.queue:
			r.metrics.SetQueueDepth(w.id, int64(len(w.queue)))

			msg.StartedAt = time.Now()
			r.metrics.IngressLatency.Observe(msg.StartedAt.Sub(msg.ReceivedAt))

			err := r.handler.Handle(r.ctx, msg)

			msg.FinishedAt = time.Now()
			r.metrics.HandlerLatency.Observe(msg.FinishedAt.Sub(msg.StartedAt))

			if err != nil {
				r.metrics.Errors.Add(1)
			}
		}
	}
}

func (r *Router) Shutdown() {
	r.cancel()
	r.wg.Wait()
}
```

# Notes on this implementation

## Strengths

- simple and fast
- lock-free hot counters via atomics
- partitioned worker queues
- Prometheus-compatible metrics
- preserves per-key ordering within a partition
- easy to extend

## Current limitations

### 1. `time.Now()` overhead
Calling `time.Now()` per message is expensive at millions/sec. For a real HFT-style system, you may want:

- sampling instead of timing every message
- batched timestamping
- TSC-based timing where appropriate
- optional latency tracking modes

### 2. Hashing alloc/cost
`fnv.New32a()` per message is not ideal. Replace with:

- a zero-allocation custom hash
- xxhash
- precomputed partition keys
- numeric routing keys

A faster version:

```go
func fastHash(s string) uint32 {
	var h uint32 = 2166136261
	for i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {
		h ^= uint32(s[i])
		h *= 16777619
	}
	return h
}
```

Then:

```go
func (r *Router) partition(key string) int {
	return int(fastHash(key) % uint32(len(r.workers)))
}
```

### 3. Queue depth monitoring cost
Using `len(chan)` on every publish is useful but not free. In a true high-frequency path:

- sample queue depth periodically
- maintain approximate counters
- avoid per-message gauge updates

### 4. Shutdown bug risk
The worker loop:

```go
case msg := <-w.queue:
```

does not check channel closure. Since we use context cancellation and never close queues, this is acceptable for now, but graceful draining is not implemented.

### 5. Backpressure strategy
Current behavior is **drop on full queue**. Alternatives:

- block publisher
- retry with timeout
- overflow queues
- dead-letter handling
- adaptive load shedding

- use a faster hash

# `router/router.go`

```go
package router

import (
	"context"
	"hash/fnv"
	"strconv"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

type Handler func(msg *Message)

type partition struct {
	id      int
	queue   chan *Message
	handler Handler
	metrics *Metrics
}

type Router struct {
	partitions []partition
	metrics    *Metrics
	nextID     atomic.Uint64
}

type Config struct {
	NumPartitions int
	QueueSize     int
	Handler       Handler
	Metrics       *Metrics
}

func NewRouter(cfg Config) *Router {
	if cfg.NumPartitions <= 0 {
		cfg.NumPartitions = 64
	}
	if cfg.QueueSize <= 0 {
		cfg.QueueSize = 65536
	}
	if cfg.Handler == nil {
		cfg.Handler = func(msg *Message) {}
	}
	if cfg.Metrics == nil {
		cfg.Metrics = NewMetrics()
	}

	r := &Router{
		partitions: make([]partition, cfg.NumPartitions),
		metrics:    cfg.Metrics,
	}

	for i := 0; i < cfg.NumPartitions; i++ {
		r.partitions[i] = partition{
			id:      i,
			queue:   make(chan *Message, cfg.QueueSize),
			handler: cfg.Handler,
			metrics: cfg.Metrics,
		}
	}

	return r
}

func (r *Router) Start(ctx context.Context) {
	for i := range r.partitions {
		p := &r.partitions[i]
		go p.run(ctx)
	}
}

func (p *partition) run(ctx context.Context) {
	label := strconv.Itoa(p.id)

	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case msg := <-p.queue:
			start := time.Now()
			p.metrics.QueueDepth.WithLabelValues(label).Set(float64(len(p.queue)))

			p.handler(msg)

			msg.ProcessedAt = time.Now()
			p.metrics.MessagesRouted.Inc()
			p.metrics.ProcessLatency.Observe(time.Since(start).Seconds())
			p.metrics.EndToEndLatency.Observe(msg.ProcessedAt.Sub(msg.CreatedAt).Seconds())
		}
	}
}

func (r *Router) Route(msg *Message) bool {
	if msg == nil {
		return false
	}

	r.metrics.MessagesInTotal.Inc()

	if msg.ID == 0 {
		msg.ID = r.nextID.Add(1)
	}
	if msg.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
		msg.CreatedAt = time.Now()
	}

	idx := int(hashUint64(msg.Key) % uint64(len(r.partitions)))
	msg.EnqueuedAt = time.Now()
	r.metrics.EnqueueLatency.Observe(msg.EnqueuedAt.Sub(msg.CreatedAt).Seconds())

	p := &r.partitions[idx]
	label := strconv.Itoa(p.id)

	select {
	case p.queue <- msg:
		p.metrics.QueueDepth.WithLabelValues(label).Set(float64(len(p.queue)))
		return true
	default:
		r.metrics.MessagesDropped.Inc()
		return false
	}
}

func hashUint64(v uint64) uint64 {
	h := fnv.New64a()
	var b [8]byte
	b[0] = byte(v)
	b[1] = byte(v >> 8)
	b[2] = byte(v >> 16)
	b[3] = byte(v >> 24)
	b[4] = byte(v >> 32)
	b[5] = byte(v >> 40)
	b[6] = byte(v >> 48)
	b[7] = byte(v >> 56)
	_, _ = h.Write(b[:])
	return h.Sum64()
}
```

# How it works

## Routing
Each message is assigned to a partition using:

```go
idx := int(hashUint64(msg.Key) % uint64(len(r.partitions)))
```

This gives:

- stable routing for the same key
- reduced synchronization overhead
- per-partition ordering

## Backpressure
Each partition has a bounded queue:

```go
queue: make(chan *Message, cfg.QueueSize)
```

If the queue is full, the message is dropped:

```go
default:
    r.metrics.MessagesDropped.Inc()
    return false
```

This is a common strategy in ultra-low-latency systems where blocking producers is undesirable.

## Latency monitoring
Three histograms are tracked:

- **enqueue latency**: time from creation to enqueue attempt
- **process latency**: time spent in handler
- **end-to-end latency**: creation to processed

# Important performance notes

This initial implementation is good for a prototype, but to truly reach **millions/sec**, you will likely want to improve:

## 1. Avoid `time.Now()` too often
`time.Now()` is relatively expensive at very high rates. Consider:

- sampling timestamps
- batching time reads
- using a coarse clock updated periodically

## 2. Avoid per-message Prometheus histogram updates if needed
Prometheus histograms can become expensive under extreme throughput. Options:

- sample only 1/N messages
- aggregate in-memory and flush periodically
- use lock-free counters for hot path metrics

## 3. Replace channels with lock-free ring buffers
Go channels are excellent, but for extreme throughput, a custom MPSC/SPSC ring buffer may perform better.

## 4. Batch processing
Instead of processing one message at a time:

- dequeue batches of 32/64/256 messages
- amortize metric and scheduling overhead

## 5. Memory reuse
Use `sync.Pool` or slab allocators for:

- `Message` objects
- payload buffers

## 6. CPU affinity / NUMA awareness
For very high throughput:

- pin workers to cores
- isolate hot partitions
- consider NUMA-local queues

## 7. Better load generation
The sample generator is simplistic and not suitable for benchmarking. Use:

- multiple producer goroutines
- preallocated messages
- controlled rate generation

```go
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"hash/fnv"
	"log"
	"math/rand"
	"net/http"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

type Message struct {
	ID        uint64
	Key       string
	Payload   []byte
	CreatedAt int64 // unix nano
}

type Stats struct {
	Produced uint64
	Routed   uint64
	Processed uint64
	Dropped  uint64

	LatencyNsTotal uint64
	LatencyNsMax   uint64

	Lt10us   uint64
	Lt50us   uint64
	Lt100us  uint64
	Lt500us  uint64
	Lt1ms    uint64
	Lt5ms    uint64
	Gte5ms   uint64
}

func (s *Stats) recordLatency(ns uint64) {
	atomic.AddUint64(&s.LatencyNsTotal, ns)

	for {
		old := atomic.LoadUint64(&s.LatencyNsMax)
		if ns <= old || atomic.CompareAndSwapUint64(&s.LatencyNsMax, old, ns) {
			break
		}
	}

	switch {
	case ns < 10_000:
		atomic.AddUint64(&s.Lt10us, 1)
	case ns < 50_000:
		atomic.AddUint64(&s.Lt50us, 1)
	case ns < 100_000:
		atomic.AddUint64(&s.Lt100us, 1)
	case ns < 500_000:
		atomic.AddUint64(&s.Lt500us, 1)
	case ns < 1_000_000:
		atomic.AddUint64(&s.Lt1ms, 1)
	case ns < 5_000_000:
		atomic.AddUint64(&s.Lt5ms, 1)
	default:
		atomic.AddUint64(&s.Gte5ms, 1)
	}
}

type Router struct {
	shards []chan Message
	stats  *Stats
}

func NewRouter(numShards int, queueSize int, stats *Stats) *Router {
	r := &Router{
		shards: make([]chan Message, numShards),
		stats:  stats,
	}
	for i := range r.shards {
		r.shards[i] = make(chan Message, queueSize)
	}
	return r
}

func (r *Router) shardFor(key string) int {
	h := fnv.New32a()
	_, _ = h.Write([]byte(key))
	return int(h.Sum32()) % len(r.shards)
}

func (r *Router) Route(msg Message) bool {
	idx := r.shardFor(msg.Key)
	select {
	case r.shards[idx] <- msg:
		atomic.AddUint64(&r.stats.Routed, 1)
		return true
	default:
		atomic.AddUint64(&r.stats.Dropped, 1)
		return false
	}
}

func worker(id int, ch <-chan Message, stats *Stats) {
	for msg := range ch {
		now := time.Now().UnixNano()
		latency := uint64(now - msg.CreatedAt)

		// Simulated processing.
		_ = msg.Payload

		stats.recordLatency(latency)
		atomic.AddUint64(&stats.Processed, 1)
	}
}

func startWorkers(r *Router) {
	for i, ch := range r.shards {
		go worker(i, ch, r.stats)
	}
}

func startProducer(r *Router, ratePerSec int) {
	go func() {
		var id uint64
		if ratePerSec <= 0 {
			// Unlimited producer
			for {
				id = atomic.AddUint64(&id, 1)
				msg := Message{
					ID:        id,
					Key:       strconv.Itoa(rand.Intn(100000)),
					Payload:   []byte("x"),
					CreatedAt: time.Now().UnixNano(),
				}
				atomic.AddUint64(&r.stats.Produced, 1)
				r.Route(msg)
			}
		}

		ticker := time.NewTicker(time.Second / time.Duration(ratePerSec))
		defer ticker.Stop()

		for range ticker.C {
			id = atomic.AddUint64(&id, 1)
			msg := Message{
				ID:        id,
				Key:       strconv.Itoa(rand.Intn(100000)),
				Payload:   []byte("x"),
				CreatedAt: time.Now().UnixNano(),
			}
			atomic.AddUint64(&r.stats.Produced, 1)
			r.Route(msg)
		}
	}()
}

func metricsHandler(stats *Stats, start time.Time) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		processed := atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.Processed)
		totalLatency := atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.LatencyNsTotal)

		avgLatency := uint64(0)
		if processed > 0 {
			avgLatency = totalLatency / processed
		}

		resp := map[string]interface{}{
			"uptime_sec":        time.Since(start).Seconds(),
			"produced":          atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.Produced),
			"routed":            atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.Routed),
			"processed":         processed,
			"dropped":           atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.Dropped),
			"avg_latency_ns":    avgLatency,
			"max_latency_ns":    atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.LatencyNsMax),
			"latency_buckets": map[string]uint64{
				"<10us":   atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.Lt10us),
				"<50us":   atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.Lt50us),
				"<100us":  atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.Lt100us),
				"<500us":  atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.Lt500us),
				"<1ms":    atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.Lt1ms),
				"<5ms":    atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.Lt5ms),
				">=5ms":   atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.Gte5ms),
			},
			"goroutines": runtime.NumGoroutine(),
		}

		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
	}
}

func main() {
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(runtime.NumCPU())

	stats := &Stats{}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"hash/fnv"
	"runtime"
	"sort"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

const (
	NumShards         = 16
	QueueSize         = 1 << 16
	NumProducers      = 8
	MessagePayloadLen = 32
	RunDuration       = 10 * time.Second
	ReportInterval    = 1 * time.Second
	SampleLatencies   = 200000
)

type Message struct {
	Key       uint64
	CreatedAt int64 // unix nano
	Payload   [MessagePayloadLen]byte
}

type Router struct {
	shards   []chan Message
	received uint64
	routed   uint64
	dropped  uint64
}

func NewRouter(numShards, queueSize int) *Router {
	r := &Router{
		shards: make([]chan Message, numShards),
	}
	for i := range r.shards {
		r.shards[i] = make(chan Message, queueSize)
	}
	return r
}

func (r *Router) Route(msg Message) {
	atomic.AddUint64(&r.received, 1)
	idx := shardFor(msg.Key, len(r.shards))

	select {
	case r.shards[idx] <- msg:
		atomic.AddUint64(&r.routed, 1)
	default:
		atomic.AddUint64(&r.dropped, 1)
	}
}

func shardFor(key uint64, n int) int {
	h := fnv.New64a()
	var b [8]byte
	for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
		b[i] = byte(key >> (8 * i))
	}
	_, _ = h.Write(b[:])
	return int(h.Sum64() % uint64(n))
}

type LatencyStore struct {
	mu   sync.Mutex
	data []int64
	max  int
}

func NewLatencyStore(max int) *LatencyStore {
	return &LatencyStore{
		data: make([]int64, 0, max),
		max:  max,
	}
}

func (l *LatencyStore) Add(ns int64) {
	l.mu.Lock()
	if len(l.data) < l.max {
		l.data = append(l.data, ns)
	}
	l.mu.Unlock()
}

func (l *LatencyStore) SnapshotAndReset() []int64 {
	l.mu.Lock()
	out := make([]int64, len(l.data))
	copy(out, l.data)
	l.data = l.data[:0]
	l.mu.Unlock()
	return out
}

type Worker struct {
	id        int
	ch        <-chan Message
	processed uint64
	latencies *LatencyStore
}

func NewWorker(id int, ch <-chan Message, latencies *LatencyStore) *Worker {
	return &Worker{
		id:        id,
		ch:        ch,
		latencies: latencies,
	}
}

func (w *Worker) Run(stop <-chan struct{}, wg *sync.WaitGroup) {
	defer wg.Done()
	for {
		select {
		case msg := <-w.ch:
			now := time.Now().UnixNano()
			lat := now - msg.CreatedAt
			w.latencies.Add(lat)
			atomic.AddUint64(&w.processed, 1)

			// Simulated processing:
			_ = msg.Payload[0]

		case <-stop:
			return
		}
	}
}

func producer(id int, r *Router, stop <-chan struct{}, wg *sync.WaitGroup) {
	defer wg.Done()
	var seq uint64
	payload := [MessagePayloadLen]byte{}
	for i := 0; i < MessagePayloadLen; i++ {
		payload[i] = byte(i)
	}

	for {
		select {
		case <-stop:
			return
		default:
			seq++
			msg := Message{
				Key:       uint64(id)<<32 | seq,
				CreatedAt: time.Now().UnixNano(),
				Payload:   payload,
			}
			r.Route(msg)
		}
	}
}

func percentile(sorted []int64, p float64) int64 {
	if len(sorted) == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	idx := int(float64(len(sorted)-1) * p)
	return sorted[idx]
}

func reportMetrics(r *Router, workers []*Worker, latencies *LatencyStore, stop <-chan struct{}, done chan<- struct{}) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(ReportInterval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	defer close(done)

	var lastReceived uint64
	var lastRouted uint64
	var lastDropped uint64
	lastProcessed := make([]uint64, len(workers))

	for {
		select {
		case <-ticker.C:
			received := atomic.LoadUint64(&r.received)
			routed := atomic.LoadUint64(&r.routed)
			dropped := atomic.LoadUint64(&r.dropped)

			var processed uint64
			perWorkerProcessed := make([]uint64, len(workers))
			for i, w := range workers {
				p := atomic.LoadUint64(&w.processed)
				perWorkerProcessed[i] = p
				processed += p
			}

			lat := latencies.SnapshotAndReset()
			sort.Slice(lat, func(i, j int) bool { return lat[i] < lat[j] })

			p50 := percentile(lat, 0.50)
			p95 := percentile(lat, 0.95)
			p99 := percentile(lat, 0.99)

			fmt.Printf(
				"recv=%d/s routed=%d/s dropped=%d/s processed=%d/s total_recv=%d total_drop=%d lat(ns): p50=%d p95=%d p99=%d samples=%d\n",
				received-lastReceived,
				routed-lastRouted,
				dropped-lastDropped,
				processed-sum(lastProcessed),
				received,
				dropped,
				p50,
				p95,
				p99,
				len(lat),
			)

			lastReceived = received
			lastRouted = routed
			lastDropped = dropped
			copy(lastProcessed, perWorkerProcessed)

		case <-stop:
			return
		}
	}
}

func sum(v []uint64) uint64 {
	var s uint64
	for _, x := range v {
		s += x
	}
	return s
}

func main() {
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(runtime.NumCPU())

	router := NewRouter(NumShards, QueueSize)
	latencies := NewLatencyStore(SampleLatencies)

	stop := make(chan struct{})
	var wg sync.WaitGroup

	workers := make([]*Worker, 0, NumShards)
	for i := 0; i < NumShards; i++ {
		w := NewWorker(i, router.shards[i], latencies)
		workers = append(workers, w)
		wg.Add(1)
		go w.Run(stop, &wg)
	}

	for i := 0; i < NumProducers; i++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go producer(i, router, stop, &wg)
	}

	reportDone := make(chan struct{})
	go reportMetrics(router, workers, latencies, stop, reportDone)

	time.Sleep(RunDuration)
	close(stop)
	wg.Wait()
	<-reportDone

	var totalProcessed uint64
	for _, w := range workers {
		totalProcessed += atomic.LoadUint64(&w.processed)
	}

	fmt.Println("---- final ----")
	fmt.Printf("total received:  %d\n", atomic.LoadUint64(&router.received))
	fmt.Printf("total routed:    %d\n", atomic.LoadUint64(&router.routed))
	fmt.Printf("total dropped:   %d\n", atomic.LoadUint64(&router.dropped))
	fmt.Printf("total processed: %d\n", totalProcessed)
}
```

```python
import threading
import queue
import time
import itertools
import random
from collections import defaultdict, deque

# ----------------------------
# Message model
# ----------------------------

class Message:
    __slots__ = ("id", "topic", "payload", "created_ns")

    def __init__(self, msg_id, topic, payload, created_ns):
        self.id = msg_id
        self.topic = topic
        self.payload = payload
        self.created_ns = created_ns


# ----------------------------
# Latency monitor
# ----------------------------

class LatencyMonitor:
    def __init__(self, max_samples=200000):
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.samples_ns = deque(maxlen=max_samples)
        self.routed = 0
        self.delivered = 0
        self.dropped = 0
        self.last_report_time = time.time()
        self.last_routed = 0
        self.last_delivered = 0

    def record_route(self):
        with self.lock:
            self.routed += 1

    def record_delivery(self, latency_ns):
        with self.lock:
            self.delivered += 1
            self.samples_ns.append(latency_ns)

    def record_drop(self):
        with self.lock:
            self.dropped += 1

    def snapshot(self):
        with self.lock:
            samples = list(self.samples_ns)
            routed = self.routed
            delivered = self.delivered
            dropped = self.dropped

        now = time.time()
        dt = max(now - self.last_report_time, 1e-9)
        routed_rate = (routed - self.last_routed) / dt
        delivered_rate = (delivered - self.last_delivered) / dt

        self.last_report_time = now
        self.last_routed = routed
        self.last_delivered = delivered

        if samples:
            samples.sort()
            p50 = samples[int(len(samples) * 0.50)] / 1_000
            p95 = samples[int(len(samples) * 0.95)] / 1_000
            p99 = samples[int(len(samples) * 0.99)] / 1_000
            avg = (sum(samples) / len(samples)) / 1_000
        else:
            p50 = p95 = p99 = avg = 0.0

        return {
            "routed_total": routed,
            "delivered_total": delivered,
            "dropped_total": dropped,
            "routed_per_sec": routed_rate,
            "delivered_per_sec": delivered_rate,
            "latency_us_avg": avg,
            "latency_us_p50": p50,
            "latency_us_p95": p95,
            "latency_us_p99": p99,
        }


# ----------------------------
# Consumer
# ----------------------------

class Consumer(threading.Thread):
    def __init__(self, name, monitor, max_queue=100000):
        super().__init__(daemon=True)
        self.name = name
        self.monitor = monitor
        self.inbox = queue.SimpleQueue() if max_queue is None else queue.Queue(maxsize=max_queue)
        self.running = True
        self.processed = 0

    def submit(self, msg):
        try:
            if isinstance(self.inbox, queue.SimpleQueue):
                self.inbox.put(msg)
                return True
            else:
                self.inbox.put_nowait(msg)
                return True
        except queue.Full:
            self.monitor.record_drop()
            return False

    def run(self):
        while self.running:
            try:
                msg = self.inbox.get(timeout=0.1) if hasattr(self.inbox, "get") else self.inbox.get()
                now_ns = time.perf_counter_ns()
                latency_ns = now_ns - msg.created_ns
                self.monitor.record_delivery(latency_ns)
                self.processed += 1
            except queue.Empty:
                continue

    def stop(self):
        self.running = False


# ----------------------------
# Router
# ----------------------------

class MessageRouter(threading.Thread):
    def __init__(self, monitor, ingress_maxsize=200000):
        super().__init__(daemon=True)
        self.monitor = monitor
        self.ingress = queue.Queue(maxsize=ingress_maxsize)
        self.subscribers = defaultdict(list)
        self.running = True

    def subscribe(self, topic, consumer):
        self.subscribers[topic].append(consumer)

    def publish(self, msg):
        try:
            self.ingress.put_nowait(msg)
            return True
        except queue.Full:
            self.monitor.record_drop()
            return False

    def run(self):
        while self.running:
            try:
                msg = self.ingress.get(timeout=0.1)
                self.monitor.record_route()
                consumers = self.subscribers.get(msg.topic, [])
                for consumer in consumers:
                    consumer.submit(msg)
            except queue.Empty:
                continue

    def stop(self):
        self.running = False


# ----------------------------
# Producer
# ----------------------------

class Producer(threading.Thread):
    def __init__(self, name, router, topics, rate_limit=None):
        super().__init__(daemon=True)
        self.name = name
        self.router = router
        self.topics = topics
        self.rate_limit = rate_limit
        self.running = True
        self.counter = itertools.count()

    def run(self):
        next_emit = time.perf_counter()
        while self.running:
            msg_id = next(self.counter)
            topic = random.choice(self.topics)
            msg = Message(
                msg_id=msg_id,
                topic=topic,
                payload=b"x" * 32,
                created_ns=time.perf_counter_ns(),
            )
            self.router.publish(msg)

            if self.rate_limit:
                next_emit += 1.0 / self.rate_limit
                while time.perf_counter() < next_emit:
                    pass

    def stop(self):
        self.running = False


# ----------------------------
# Stats reporter
# ----------------------------

class StatsReporter(threading.Thread):
    def __init__(self, monitor, interval=1.0):
        super().__init__(daemon=True)
        self.monitor = monitor
        self.interval = interval
        self.running = True

    def run(self):
        while self.running:
            time.sleep(self.interval)
            s = self.monitor.snapshot()
            print(
                f"[stats] routed={s['routed_total']} "
                f"delivered={s['delivered_total']} "
                f"dropped={s['dropped_total']} "
                f"routed/s={s['routed_per_sec']:.0f} "
                f"delivered/s={s['delivered_per_sec']:.0f} "
                f"lat_us(avg/p50/p95/p99)="
                f"{s['latency_us_avg']:.1f}/"
                f"{s['latency_us_p50']:.1f}/"
                f"{s['latency_us_p95']:.1f}/"
                f"{s['latency_us_p99']:.1f}"
            )

    def stop(self):
        self.running = False


# ----------------------------
# Main
# ----------------------------

def main():
    monitor = LatencyMonitor()

    router = MessageRouter(monitor)
    consumers = [
        Consumer("consumer-A", monitor),
        Consumer("consumer-B", monitor),
        Consumer("consumer-C", monitor),
    ]

    topics = ["orders", "trades", "quotes"]

    router.subscribe("orders", consumers[0])
    router.subscribe("orders", consumers[1])
    router.subscribe("trades", consumers[1])
    router.subscribe("quotes", consumers[2])

    for c in consumers:
        c.start()

    router.start()

    producers = [
        Producer("producer-1", router, topics),
        Producer("producer-2", router, topics),
        Producer("producer-3", router, topics),
        Producer("producer-4", router, topics),
    ]

    for p in producers:
        p.start()

    reporter = StatsReporter(monitor, interval=1.0)
    reporter.start()

    try:
        time.sleep(10)
    finally:
        for p in producers:
            p.stop()
        router.stop()
        for c in consumers:
            c.stop()
        reporter.stop()

        for p in producers:
            p.join(timeout=1)
        router.join(timeout=1)
        for c in consumers:
            c.join(timeout=1)
        reporter.join(timeout=1)

        print("Shutdown complete.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"hash/fnv"
	"math/rand"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

type Message struct {
	ID        uint64
	Key       string
	Payload   []byte
	CreatedAt int64 // unix nano
}

type Metrics struct {
	Received      atomic.Uint64
	Routed        atomic.Uint64
	Processed     atomic.Uint64
	Dropped       atomic.Uint64
	TotalLatency  atomic.Uint64 // nanoseconds
	MaxLatency    atomic.Uint64 // nanoseconds
}

type Router struct {
	shards  []chan Message
	metrics *Metrics
	wg      sync.WaitGroup
}

func NewRouter(numShards, shardBuffer int, metrics *Metrics) *Router {
	r := &Router{
		shards:  make([]chan Message, numShards),
		metrics: metrics,
	}

	for i := 0; i < numShards; i++ {
		r.shards[i] = make(chan Message, shardBuffer)
		r.wg.Add(1)
		go r.worker(i, r.shards[i])
	}

	return r
}

func (r *Router) worker(id int, ch <-chan Message) {
	defer r.wg.Done()

	for msg := range ch {
		now := time.Now().UnixNano()
		latency := uint64(now - msg.CreatedAt)

		r.metrics.Processed.Add(1)
		r.metrics.TotalLatency.Add(latency)
		updateMax(&r.metrics.MaxLatency, latency)

		// Simulate lightweight processing
		_ = msg.ID
	}
}

func (r *Router) Route(msg Message) {
	r.metrics.Received.Add(1)

	idx := shardForKey(msg.Key, len(r.shards))
	select {
	case r.shards[idx] <- msg:
		r.metrics.Routed.Add(1)
	default:
		r.metrics.Dropped.Add(1)
	}
}

func (r *Router) Close() {
	for _, ch := range r.shards {
		close(ch)
	}
	r.wg.Wait()
}

func shardForKey(key string, n int) int {
	h := fnv.New32a()
	_, _ = h.Write([]byte(key))
	return int(h.Sum32() % uint32(n))
}

func updateMax(a *atomic.Uint64, v uint64) {
	for {
		cur := a.Load()
		if v <= cur {
			return
		}
		if a.CompareAndSwap(cur, v) {
			return
		}
	}
}

func printMetrics(m *Metrics, interval time.Duration) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	defer ticker.Stop()

	var lastProcessed uint64

	for range ticker.C {
		received := m.Received.Load()
		routed := m.Routed.Load()
		processed := m.Processed.Load()
		dropped := m.Dropped.Load()
		totalLatency := m.TotalLatency.Load()
		maxLatency := m.MaxLatency.Load()

		deltaProcessed := processed - lastProcessed
		lastProcessed = processed

		throughput := float64(deltaProcessed) / interval.Seconds()

		avgLatencyUs := 0.0
		if processed > 0 {
			avgLatencyUs = float64(totalLatency) / float64(processed) / 1000.0
		}

		fmt.Printf(
			"recv=%d routed=%d processed=%d dropped=%d throughput=%.0f msg/s avg_lat=%.2fµs max_lat=%.2fµs\n",
			received,
			routed,
			processed,
			dropped,
			throughput,
			avgLatencyUs,
			float64(maxLatency)/1000.0,
		)
	}
}

func main() {
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(runtime.NumCPU())

	metrics := &Metrics{}
	numShards := runtime.NumCPU() * 4
	shardBuffer := 65536

	router := NewRouter(numShards, shardBuffer, metrics)
	defer router.Close()

	go printMetrics(metrics, 1*time.Second)
```

# Why this works

## Routing
Each message is hashed by key into a shard. This preserves per-key ordering within a shard and spreads work across workers.

## Throughput
Buffered channels and multiple producer goroutines reduce contention. Sharding avoids a single global queue bottleneck.

## Latency monitoring
Each message carries a creation timestamp. When processed, the worker computes end-to-end in-process latency and updates atomic metrics.

```go
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"

	"hash/fnv"
	"log"

	"sync/atomic"
	"time"

type Message struct {
	ID        uint64
	Key       string
	Payload   []byte
	CreatedAt int64
}

type Metrics struct {
	Received uint64
	Processed uint64
	Dropped uint64

	TotalEndToEndLatencyNs uint64
	TotalProcessingNs      uint64
}

type Router struct {
	workers []chan Message
	metrics *Metrics
}

func NewRouter(numWorkers int, queueSize int, metrics *Metrics) *Router {
	r := &Router{
		workers: make([]chan Message, numWorkers),
		metrics: metrics,
	}

	for i := 0; i < numWorkers; i++ {
		ch := make(chan Message, queueSize)
		r.workers[i] = ch
		go workerLoop(i, ch, metrics)
	}

	return r
}

func (r *Router) Route(msg Message) {
	atomic.AddUint64(&r.metrics.Received, 1)

	idx := shardForKey(msg.Key, len(r.workers))
	select {
	case r.workers[idx] <- msg:
	default:
		atomic.AddUint64(&r.metrics.Dropped, 1)
	}
}

func shardForKey(key string, n int) int {
	h := fnv.New32a()
	_, _ = h.Write([]byte(key))
	return int(h.Sum32()) % n
}

func workerLoop(id int, ch <-chan Message, metrics *Metrics) {
	for msg := range ch {
		start := time.Now()

		// Simulated processing
		_ = msg.Payload

		procNs := uint64(time.Since(start).Nanoseconds())
		endToEndNs := uint64(time.Now().UnixNano() - msg.CreatedAt)

		atomic.AddUint64(&metrics.Processed, 1)
		atomic.AddUint64(&metrics.TotalProcessingNs, procNs)
		atomic.AddUint64(&metrics.TotalEndToEndLatencyNs, endToEndNs)
	}
}

func metricsHandler(metrics *Metrics) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		received := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.Received)
		processed := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.Processed)
		dropped := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.Dropped)
		totalProc := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.TotalProcessingNs)
		totalE2E := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.TotalEndToEndLatencyNs)

		var avgProc float64
		var avgE2E float64
		if processed > 0 {
			avgProc = float64(totalProc) / float64(processed) / 1e6
			avgE2E = float64(totalE2E) / float64(processed) / 1e6
		}

		resp := map[string]interface{}{
			"received":                 received,
			"processed":                processed,
			"dropped":                  dropped,
			"avg_processing_latency_ms": avgProc,
			"avg_end_to_end_latency_ms": avgE2E,
			"goroutines":               runtime.NumGoroutine(),
		}

		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
	}
}

	queueSize := 65536
```

```go
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"hash/fnv"
	"log"
	"math/rand"
	"net/http"
	"runtime"
	"sort"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

type Message struct {
	Key       string
	Payload   []byte
	CreatedAt int64 // unix nano
}

type Metrics struct {
	Received      uint64
	Processed     uint64
	Dropped       uint64
	LatencyNanos  uint64
	LastSecondTPS uint64
}

type LatencyWindow struct {
	mu       sync.Mutex
	samples  []int64
	capacity int
}

func NewLatencyWindow(capacity int) *LatencyWindow {
	return &LatencyWindow{
		samples:  make([]int64, 0, capacity),
		capacity: capacity,
	}
}

func (lw *LatencyWindow) Add(v int64) {
	lw.mu.Lock()
	if len(lw.samples) < lw.capacity {
		lw.samples = append(lw.samples, v)
	} else {
		// simple ring-like overwrite
		idx := rand.Intn(lw.capacity)
		lw.samples[idx] = v
	}
	lw.mu.Unlock()
}

func (lw *LatencyWindow) Snapshot() []int64 {
	lw.mu.Lock()
	defer lw.mu.Unlock()
	cp := make([]int64, len(lw.samples))
	copy(cp, lw.samples)
	return cp
}

type Router struct {
	shards   []chan Message
	metrics  *Metrics
	latency  *LatencyWindow
	stopChan chan struct{}
}

func NewRouter(numShards, shardBuffer int, metrics *Metrics, latency *LatencyWindow) *Router {
	r := &Router{
		shards:   make([]chan Message, numShards),
		metrics:  metrics,
		latency:  latency,
		stopChan: make(chan struct{}),
	}
	for i := 0; i < numShards; i++ {
		r.shards[i] = make(chan Message, shardBuffer)
		go r.worker(i, r.shards[i])
	}
	return r
}

func (r *Router) worker(id int, ch <-chan Message) {
	for {
		select {
		case msg := <-ch:
			// simulate ultra-fast processing
			_ = msg.Payload

			latency := time.Now().UnixNano() - msg.CreatedAt
			atomic.AddUint64(&r.metrics.Processed, 1)
			atomic.AddUint64(&r.metrics.LatencyNanos, uint64(latency))
			r.latency.Add(latency)

		case <-r.stopChan:
			return
		}
	}
}

func (r *Router) Route(msg Message) {
	atomic.AddUint64(&r.metrics.Received, 1)
	idx := shardFor(msg.Key, len(r.shards))
	select {
	case r.shards[idx] <- msg:
	default:
		atomic.AddUint64(&r.metrics.Dropped, 1)
	}
}

func (r *Router) Stop() {
	close(r.stopChan)
}

func shardFor(key string, n int) int {
	h := fnv.New32a()
	_, _ = h.Write([]byte(key))
	return int(h.Sum32()) % n
}

func startProducer(r *Router, rateHint int) {
	payload := make([]byte, 128)
	for i := range payload {
		payload[i] = byte(i % 256)
	}

	go func() {
		var i uint64
		for {
			msg := Message{
				Key:       fmt.Sprintf("key-%d", i%1024),
				Payload:   payload,
				CreatedAt: time.Now().UnixNano(),
			}
			r.Route(msg)
			i++

			// Optional pacing; set rateHint <= 0 for max speed
			if rateHint > 0 && i%uint64(rateHint) == 0 {
				runtime.Gosched()
			}
		}
	}()
}

func startMetricsReporter(metrics *Metrics, latency *LatencyWindow) {
	go func() {
		ticker := time.NewTicker(1 * time.Second)
		defer ticker.Stop()

		var lastProcessed uint64
		for range ticker.C {
			current := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.Processed)
			tps := current - lastProcessed
			lastProcessed = current
			atomic.StoreUint64(&metrics.LastSecondTPS, tps)

			samples := latency.Snapshot()
			p50, p95, p99 := percentiles(samples)

			received := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.Received)
			processed := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.Processed)
			dropped := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.Dropped)
			totalLatency := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.LatencyNanos)

			avgLatencyMicros := 0.0
			if processed > 0 {
				avgLatencyMicros = float64(totalLatency) / float64(processed) / 1000.0
			}

			log.Printf(
				"recv=%d processed=%d dropped=%d tps=%d avg=%.2fus p50=%.2fus p95=%.2fus p99=%.2fus",
				received,
				processed,
				dropped,
				tps,
				avgLatencyMicros,
				float64(p50)/1000.0,
				float64(p95)/1000.0,
				float64(p99)/1000.0,
			)
		}
	}()
}

func percentiles(samples []int64) (p50, p95, p99 int64) {
	if len(samples) == 0 {
		return 0, 0, 0
	}
	sort.Slice(samples, func(i, j int) bool { return samples[i] < samples[j] })
	p50 = samples[(len(samples)*50)/100]
	p95 = samples[(len(samples)*95)/100]
	p99 = samples[(len(samples)*99)/100]
	return
}

func startHTTP(metrics *Metrics, latency *LatencyWindow) {
	http.HandleFunc("/metrics", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		samples := latency.Snapshot()
		p50, p95, p99 := percentiles(samples)

		received := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.Received)
		processed := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.Processed)
		dropped := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.Dropped)
		totalLatency := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.LatencyNanos)
		tps := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.LastSecondTPS)

		avgLatencyMicros := 0.0
		if processed > 0 {
			avgLatencyMicros = float64(totalLatency) / float64(processed) / 1000.0
		}

		resp := map[string]interface{}{
			"received":            received,
			"processed":           processed,
			"dropped":             dropped,
			"last_second_tps":     tps,
			"avg_latency_us":      avgLatencyMicros,
			"p50_latency_us":      float64(p50) / 1000.0,
			"p95_latency_us":      float64(p95) / 1000.0,
			"p99_latency_us":      float64(p99) / 1000.0,
			"latency_sample_size": len(samples),
			"num_cpu":             runtime.NumCPU(),
			"go_max_procs":        runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0),
		}

		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
	})

	go func() {
		log.Println("metrics server listening on :8080")
		log.Fatal(http.ListenAndServe(":8080", nil))
	}()
}

func main() {
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(runtime.NumCPU())

	metrics := &Metrics{}
	latency := NewLatencyWindow(100000)

	numShards := runtime.NumCPU() * 4
	shardBuffer := 65536

	router := NewRouter(numShards, shardBuffer, metrics, latency)

	startProducer(router, 10000)
	startMetricsReporter(metrics, latency)
	startHTTP(metrics, latency)

	select {}
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"hash/fnv"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

type Message struct {
	Key       uint64
	CreatedAt int64 // unix nano
	Payload   [32]byte
}

type Metrics struct {
	Produced uint64
	Routed   uint64
	Consumed uint64
	Dropped  uint64

	LatencyCount uint64
	LatencyTotal uint64
	LatencyMax   uint64
}

type Router struct {
	shards  []chan Message
	metrics *Metrics
}

func NewRouter(numShards, shardBuffer int, metrics *Metrics) *Router {
	r := &Router{
		shards:  make([]chan Message, numShards),
		metrics: metrics,
	}
	for i := range r.shards {
		r.shards[i] = make(chan Message, shardBuffer)
	}
	return r
}

func (r *Router) shardFor(key uint64) int {
	// Fast enough for a minimal example.
	h := fnv.New32a()
	var b [8]byte
	b[0] = byte(key)
	b[1] = byte(key >> 8)
	b[2] = byte(key >> 16)
	b[3] = byte(key >> 24)
	b[4] = byte(key >> 32)
	b[5] = byte(key >> 40)
	b[6] = byte(key >> 48)
	b[7] = byte(key >> 56)
	_, _ = h.Write(b[:])
	return int(h.Sum32()) % len(r.shards)
}

func (r *Router) Route(msg Message) {
	idx := r.shardFor(msg.Key)
	select {
	case r.shards[idx] <- msg:
		atomic.AddUint64(&r.metrics.Routed, 1)
	default:
		atomic.AddUint64(&r.metrics.Dropped, 1)
	}
}

func worker(id int, ch <-chan Message, metrics *Metrics, stop <-chan struct{}, wg *sync.WaitGroup) {
	defer wg.Done()
	for {
		select {
		case msg := <-ch:
			now := time.Now().UnixNano()
			latency := uint64(now - msg.CreatedAt)

			atomic.AddUint64(&metrics.Consumed, 1)
			atomic.AddUint64(&metrics.LatencyCount, 1)
			atomic.AddUint64(&metrics.LatencyTotal, latency)

			for {
				oldMax := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.LatencyMax)
				if latency <= oldMax {
					break
				}
				if atomic.CompareAndSwapUint64(&metrics.LatencyMax, oldMax, latency) {
					break
				}
			}
		case <-stop:
			return
		}
	}
}

func producer(id int, router *Router, stop <-chan struct{}, wg *sync.WaitGroup) {
	defer wg.Done()
	var seq uint64 = uint64(id) << 48

	for {
		select {
		case <-stop:
			return
		default:
			msg := Message{
				Key:       seq,
				CreatedAt: time.Now().UnixNano(),
			}
			router.Route(msg)
			atomic.AddUint64(&router.metrics.Produced, 1)
			seq++
		}
	}
}

func report(metrics *Metrics, interval time.Duration, stop <-chan struct{}, wg *sync.WaitGroup) {
	defer wg.Done()

	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	defer ticker.Stop()

	var lastProduced, lastRouted, lastConsumed, lastDropped uint64

	for {
		select {
		case <-ticker.C:
			p := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.Produced)
			r := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.Routed)
			c := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.Consumed)
			d := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.Dropped)

			lc := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.LatencyCount)
			lt := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.LatencyTotal)
			lm := atomic.LoadUint64(&metrics.LatencyMax)

			dp := p - lastProduced
			dr := r - lastRouted
			dc := c - lastConsumed
			dd := d - lastDropped

			lastProduced, lastRouted, lastConsumed, lastDropped = p, r, c, d

			avgLatencyUs := 0.0
			if lc > 0 {
				avgLatencyUs = float64(lt) / float64(lc) / 1000.0
			}

			fmt.Printf(
				"rate produced=%d/s routed=%d/s consumed=%d/s dropped=%d/s total produced=%d consumed=%d avg_latency=%.2fµs max_latency=%.2fµs\n",
				dp/int64(interval/time.Second),
				dr/int64(interval/time.Second),
				dc/int64(interval/time.Second),
				dd/int64(interval/time.Second),
				p,
				c,
				avgLatencyUs,
				float64(lm)/1000.0,
			)

		case <-stop:
			return
		}
	}
}

func main() {
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(runtime.NumCPU())

	numShards := runtime.NumCPU() * 2
	shardBuffer := 65536
	numProducers := runtime.NumCPU()

	metrics := &Metrics{}
	router := NewRouter(numShards, shardBuffer, metrics)

	stop := make(chan struct{})
	var wg sync.WaitGroup

	for i := 0; i < numShards; i++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go worker(i, router.shards[i], metrics, stop, &wg)
	}

	for i := 0; i < numProducers; i++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go producer(i, router, stop, &wg)
	}

	wg.Add(1)
	go report(metrics, time.Second, stop, &wg)

	runFor := 10 * time.Second
	time.Sleep(runFor)

	close(stop)
	wg.Wait()

	fmt.Println("done")
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
	"sort"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

type Message struct {
	ID        uint64
	Topic     int
	CreatedAt int64 // UnixNano
	Payload   [64]byte
}

type Consumer struct {
	ID    int
	Topic int
	Ch    chan Message
}

type Router struct {
	inbound   chan Message
	topics    map[int][]*Consumer
	dropped   uint64
	routed    uint64
	processed uint64

	latMu      sync.Mutex
	latencies  []int64
	latCap     int
}

func NewRouter(inboundSize int, latCap int) *Router {
	return &Router{
		inbound:   make(chan Message, inboundSize),
		topics:    make(map[int][]*Consumer),
		latencies: make([]int64, 0, latCap),
		latCap:    latCap,
	}
}

func (r *Router) Subscribe(topic int, c *Consumer) {
	r.topics[topic] = append(r.topics[topic], c)
}

func (r *Router) Publish(msg Message) bool {
	select {
	case r.inbound <- msg:
		return true
	default:
		atomic.AddUint64(&r.dropped, 1)
		return false
	}
}

func (r *Router) Run(stop <-chan struct{}) {
	for {
		select {
		case msg := <-r.inbound:
			subs := r.topics[msg.Topic]
			if len(subs) == 0 {
				atomic.AddUint64(&r.dropped, 1)
				continue
			}
			for _, c := range subs {
				select {
				case c.Ch <- msg:
					atomic.AddUint64(&r.routed, 1)
				default:
					atomic.AddUint64(&r.dropped, 1)
				}
			}
		case <-stop:
			return
		}
	}
}

func (c *Consumer) Run(r *Router, stop <-chan struct{}) {
	for {
		select {
		case msg := <-c.Ch:
			lat := time.Now().UnixNano() - msg.CreatedAt
			r.recordLatency(lat)
			atomic.AddUint64(&r.processed, 1)
		case <-stop:
			return
		}
	}
}

func (r *Router) recordLatency(ns int64) {
	r.latMu.Lock()
	if len(r.latencies) < r.latCap {
		r.latencies = append(r.latencies, ns)
	} else {
		// ring-like overwrite for minimal implementation
		idx := time.Now().UnixNano() % int64(r.latCap)
		r.latencies[idx] = ns
	}
	r.latMu.Unlock()
}

func (r *Router) snapshotLatencies() []int64 {
	r.latMu.Lock()
	defer r.latMu.Unlock()
	cp := make([]int64, len(r.latencies))
	copy(cp, r.latencies)
	return cp
}

func percentile(sorted []int64, p float64) int64 {
	if len(sorted) == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	idx := int(float64(len(sorted)-1) * p)
	return sorted[idx]
}

func metricsLoop(r *Router, stop <-chan struct{}) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(1 * time.Second)
	defer ticker.Stop()

	var lastRouted uint64
	var lastProcessed uint64
	var lastDropped uint64

	for {
		select {
		case <-ticker.C:
			routed := atomic.LoadUint64(&r.routed)
			processed := atomic.LoadUint64(&r.processed)
			dropped := atomic.LoadUint64(&r.dropped)

			dr := routed - lastRouted
			dp := processed - lastProcessed
			dd := dropped - lastDropped

			lastRouted = routed
			lastProcessed = processed
			lastDropped = dropped

			lats := r.snapshotLatencies()
			sort.Slice(lats, func(i, j int) bool { return lats[i] < lats[j] })

			p50 := percentile(lats, 0.50)
			p95 := percentile(lats, 0.95)
			p99 := percentile(lats, 0.99)

			fmt.Printf(
				"throughput routed=%d msg/s processed=%d msg/s dropped=%d msg/s total_routed=%d total_processed=%d total_dropped=%d latency_us p50=%.2f p95=%.2f p99=%.2f\n",
				dr, dp, dd,
				routed, processed, dropped,
				float64(p50)/1000.0,
				float64(p95)/1000.0,
				float64(p99)/1000.0,
			)
		case <-stop:
			return
		}
	}
}

func producer(id int, r *Router, topicCount int, stop <-chan struct{}, sent *uint64) {
	var msgID uint64
	for {
		select {
		case <-stop:
			return
		default:
			msgID++
			msg := Message{
				ID:        uint64(id)<<48 | msgID,
				Topic:     int(msgID % uint64(topicCount)),
				CreatedAt: time.Now().UnixNano(),
			}
			if r.Publish(msg) {
				atomic.AddUint64(sent, 1)
			}
		}
	}
}

func main() {
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(runtime.NumCPU())

	const (
		topicCount      = 8
		producerCount   = 8
		consumerPerTopic = 2
		inboundSize     = 1 << 16
		consumerBufSize = 1 << 14
		latencySamples  = 1 << 20
		runFor          = 10 * time.Second
	)

	router := NewRouter(inboundSize, latencySamples)
	stop := make(chan struct{})

	// Consumers
	for topic := 0; topic < topicCount; topic++ {
		for i := 0; i < consumerPerTopic; i++ {
			c := &Consumer{
				ID:    topic*100 + i,
				Topic: topic,
				Ch:    make(chan Message, consumerBufSize),
			}
			router.Subscribe(topic, c)
			go c.Run(router, stop)
		}
	}

	// Router
	go router.Run(stop)

	// Metrics
	go metricsLoop(router, stop)

	// Producers
	var sent uint64
	for i := 0; i < producerCount; i++ {
		go producer(i, router, topicCount, stop, &sent)
	}

	time.Sleep(runFor)
	close(stop)

	time.Sleep(1 * time.Second)
	fmt.Printf("sent=%d routed=%d processed=%d dropped=%d\n",
		atomic.LoadUint64(&sent),
		atomic.LoadUint64(&router.routed),
		atomic.LoadUint64(&router.processed),
		atomic.LoadUint64(&router.dropped),
	)
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"hash/fnv"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

type Message struct {
	ID        uint64
	Topic     string
	Payload   []byte
	CreatedAt int64 // unix nano
}

type Subscriber chan Message

type Router struct {
	shards      []chan Message
	subscribers sync.Map // map[string][]Subscriber

	received uint64
	routed   uint64
	dropped  uint64

	latencyCount uint64
	latencySumNs uint64
	latencyMaxNs uint64
}

func NewRouter(numShards, shardBuffer int) *Router {
	r := &Router{
		shards: make([]chan Message, numShards),
	}
	for i := 0; i < numShards; i++ {
		r.shards[i] = make(chan Message, shardBuffer)
		go r.runShard(i, r.shards[i])
	}
	return r
}

func (r *Router) Subscribe(topic string, sub Subscriber) {
	val, _ := r.subscribers.LoadOrStore(topic, &[]Subscriber{})
	ptr := val.(*[]Subscriber)

	// copy-on-write update
	newSubs := append(append([]Subscriber{}, (*ptr)...), sub)
	r.subscribers.Store(topic, &newSubs)
}

func (r *Router) Publish(msg Message) bool {
	atomic.AddUint64(&r.received, 1)
	shard := r.pickShard(msg.Topic)

	select {
	case r.shards[shard] <- msg:
		return true
	default:
		atomic.AddUint64(&r.dropped, 1)
		return false
	}
}

func (r *Router) pickShard(topic string) int {
	h := fnv.New32a()
	_, _ = h.Write([]byte(topic))
	return int(h.Sum32()) % len(r.shards)
}

func (r *Router) runShard(id int, ch chan Message) {
	for msg := range ch {
		now := time.Now().UnixNano()
		latency := uint64(now - msg.CreatedAt)

		atomic.AddUint64(&r.latencyCount, 1)
		atomic.AddUint64(&r.latencySumNs, latency)

		for {
			oldMax := atomic.LoadUint64(&r.latencyMaxNs)
			if latency <= oldMax {
				break
			}
			if atomic.CompareAndSwapUint64(&r.latencyMaxNs, oldMax, latency) {
				break
			}
		}

		val, ok := r.subscribers.Load(msg.Topic)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		subs := *(val.(*[]Subscriber))
		for _, sub := range subs {
			select {
			case sub <- msg:
				atomic.AddUint64(&r.routed, 1)
			default:
				atomic.AddUint64(&r.dropped, 1)
			}
		}
	}
}

func (r *Router) Stats() string {
	received := atomic.LoadUint64(&r.received)
	routed := atomic.LoadUint64(&r.routed)
	dropped := atomic.LoadUint64(&r.dropped)
	latCount := atomic.LoadUint64(&r.latencyCount)
	latSum := atomic.LoadUint64(&r.latencySumNs)
	latMax := atomic.LoadUint64(&r.latencyMaxNs)

	avgLatency := uint64(0)
	if latCount > 0 {
		avgLatency = latSum / latCount
	}

	return fmt.Sprintf(
		"received=%d routed=%d dropped=%d avg_latency_us=%.2f max_latency_us=%.2f",
		received,
		routed,
		dropped,
		float64(avgLatency)/1000.0,
		float64(latMax)/1000.0,
	)
}

func consumer(name string, sub Subscriber, consumed *uint64) {
	for range sub {
		atomic.AddUint64(consumed, 1)
	}
}

func main() {
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(runtime.NumCPU())

	numShards := runtime.NumCPU() * 2
	shardBuffer := 65536
	router := NewRouter(numShards, shardBuffer)

	topics := []string{"orders", "trades", "quotes", "risk"}

	var consumed uint64

	// Create subscribers
	for _, topic := range topics {
		sub := make(Subscriber, 65536)
		router.Subscribe(topic, sub)
		go consumer(topic+"-consumer", sub, &consumed)
	}

	// Metrics printer
	go func() {
		ticker := time.NewTicker(1 * time.Second)
		defer ticker.Stop()

		var lastReceived uint64
		var lastRouted uint64
		var lastConsumed uint64

		for range ticker.C {
			received := atomic.LoadUint64(&router.received)
			routed := atomic.LoadUint64(&router.routed)
			cons := atomic.LoadUint64(&consumed)

			fmt.Printf(
				"[1s] in=%d msg/s out=%d msg/s consumed=%d msg/s | %s\n",
				received-lastReceived,
				routed-lastRouted,
				cons-lastConsumed,
				router.Stats(),
			)

			lastReceived = received
			lastRouted = routed
			lastConsumed = cons
		}
	}()

	// Load generator
	var msgID uint64
	producers := runtime.NumCPU() * 4

	for p := 0; p < producers; p++ {
		go func(pid int) {
			payload := make([]byte, 128)
			for {
				id := atomic.AddUint64(&msgID, 1)
				topic := topics[id%uint64(len(topics))]
				msg := Message{
					ID:        id,
					Topic:     topic,
					Payload:   payload,
					CreatedAt: time.Now().UnixNano(),
				}
				router.Publish(msg)
			}
		}(p)
	}

	select {}
}
```

# Why this works

## 1. Sharding
Messages are distributed across multiple worker shards by topic hash:

```go
return int(h.Sum32()) % len(r.shards)
```

This reduces contention and allows parallel routing.

## 2. Non-blocking publish
Publish drops instead of blocking when a shard is full:

```go
select {
case r.shards[shard] <- msg:
    return true
default:
    atomic.AddUint64(&r.dropped, 1)
    return false
}
```

This is common in high-frequency systems where bounded latency matters more than guaranteed delivery.

## 3. Copy-on-write subscribers
Subscriptions are rarely updated compared to message flow, so reads stay cheap.

## 4. Lock-free metrics
Hot-path counters use atomics.

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"hash/fnv"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

type Message struct {
	ID        uint64
	Key       string
	Payload   []byte
	CreatedAt int64 // UnixNano
}

type Stats struct {
	processed    uint64
	totalLatency uint64 // nanoseconds
	maxLatency   uint64
}

type Router struct {
	workers []chan Message
	stats   *Stats
	wg      sync.WaitGroup
}

func NewRouter(numWorkers, bufferSize int, stats *Stats) *Router {
	r := &Router{
		workers: make([]chan Message, numWorkers),
		stats:   stats,
	}

	for i := 0; i < numWorkers; i++ {
		ch := make(chan Message, bufferSize)
		r.workers[i] = ch
		r.wg.Add(1)
		go r.worker(ch)
	}

	return r
}

func (r *Router) worker(ch <-chan Message) {
	defer r.wg.Done()
	for msg := range ch {
		now := time.Now().UnixNano()
		latency := uint64(now - msg.CreatedAt)

		atomic.AddUint64(&r.stats.processed, 1)
		atomic.AddUint64(&r.stats.totalLatency, latency)

		for {
			currentMax := atomic.LoadUint64(&r.stats.maxLatency)
			if latency <= currentMax {
				break
			}
			if atomic.CompareAndSwapUint64(&r.stats.maxLatency, currentMax, latency) {
				break
			}
		}

		// Simulated processing
		_ = msg.Payload
	}
}

func (r *Router) Route(msg Message) {
	idx := shard(msg.Key, len(r.workers))
	r.workers[idx] <- msg
}

func (r *Router) Close() {
	for _, ch := range r.workers {
		close(ch)
	}
	r.wg.Wait()
}

func shard(key string, n int) int {
	h := fnv.New32a()
	_, _ = h.Write([]byte(key))
	return int(h.Sum32()) % n
}

func producer(router *Router, stop <-chan struct{}) {
	var id uint64
	payload := make([]byte, 128)

	for {
		select {
		case <-stop:
			return
		default:
			id++
			msg := Message{
				ID:        id,
				Key:       fmt.Sprintf("user-%d", id%1024),
				Payload:   payload,
				CreatedAt: time.Now().UnixNano(),
			}
			router.Route(msg)
		}
	}
}

func monitor(stats *Stats, stop <-chan struct{}) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(1 * time.Second)
	defer ticker.Stop()

	var lastProcessed uint64

	for {
		select {
		case <-stop:
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
			processed := atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.processed)
			totalLatency := atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.totalLatency)
			maxLatency := atomic.LoadUint64(&stats.maxLatency)

			delta := processed - lastProcessed
			lastProcessed = processed

			avgLatency := uint64(0)
			if processed > 0 {
				avgLatency = totalLatency / processed
			}

			fmt.Printf(
				"throughput=%d msg/s total=%d avg_latency=%s max_latency=%s\n",
				delta,
				processed,
				time.Duration(avgLatency),
				time.Duration(maxLatency),
			)
		}
	}
}

func main() {
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(runtime.NumCPU())

	stats := &Stats{}
	router := NewRouter(
		runtime.NumCPU()*2, // workers
		65536,              // buffer per worker
		stats,
	)

	stop := make(chan struct{})

	go producer(router, stop)
	go monitor(stats, stop)

	runFor := 10 * time.Second
	time.Sleep(runFor)

	close(stop)
	router.Close()

	fmt.Println("shutdown complete")
}
```
