```python
# Player
# ----------------------------
class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 36, 48)
        self.vel_x = 0
        self.vel_y = 0
        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        # Animation frames
        self.idle_right = [make_frame((70, 170, 255), eye_offset=0)]
        self.run_right = [
            make_frame((70, 170, 255), eye_offset=0),
            make_frame((90, 190, 255), eye_offset=1),
            make_frame((70, 170, 255), eye_offset=-1),
            make_frame((50, 150, 235), eye_offset=0),
        ]
        self.jump_right = [make_frame((255, 180, 70), eye_offset=0)]

        self.idle_left = flip_frames(self.idle_right)
        self.run_left = flip_frames(self.run_right)
        self.jump_left = flip_frames(self.jump_right)

        self.animation_timer = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.15
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.current_image = self.idle_right[0]

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel_x = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel_x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel_x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True
        if (keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_UP] or keys[pygame.K_w]) and self.on_ground:
            self.vel_y = JUMP_STRENGTH
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel_y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel_y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel_y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += self.vel_x
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform):
                if self.vel_x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.left
                elif self.vel_x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.right

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel_y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform):
                if self.vel_y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.top
                    self.vel_y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.bottom
                    self.vel_y = 0

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            frames = self.jump_right if self.facing_right else self.jump_left
        elif self.vel_x != 0:
            frames = self.run_right if self.facing_right else self.run_left
        else:
            frames = self.idle_right if self.facing_right else self.idle_left

        self.animation_timer += self.animation_speed * dt
        if self.animation_timer >= 1:
            self.animation_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        if self.frame_index >= len(frames):
            self.frame_index = 0

        self.current_image = frames[self.frame_index]

    def update(self, keys, platforms, dt):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        surface.blit(self.current_image, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y))

# ----------------------------
# Camera
# ----------------------------
class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        self.x = 0
        self.y = 0

    def update(self, target_rect):
        self.x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        self.x = max(0, min(self.x, self.width - SCREEN_WIDTH))
        self.y = max(0, min(self.y, self.height - SCREEN_HEIGHT))

# ----------------------------
# Drawing
# ----------------------------
def draw_background(surface, camera_x, camera_y):
    surface.fill((135, 206, 235))

    # Simple parallax hills
    for i in range(6):
        hill_x = i * 300 - (camera_x * 0.3)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (100, 190, 100), (hill_x, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 180, 280, 140))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (80, 170, 80), (hill_x + 80, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 150, 260, 120))

def draw_platforms(surface, platforms, camera_x, camera_y):
    for rect in platforms:
        draw_rect = pygame.Rect(rect.x - camera_x, rect.y - camera_y, rect.width, rect.height)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (110, 80, 50), draw_rect)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (80, 200, 120), (draw_rect.x, draw_rect.y, draw_rect.width, 10))
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (0, 0, 0), draw_rect, 2)

def draw_ui(surface, player):
    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 28)
    text = font.render(f"Pos: ({player.rect.x}, {player.rect.y})", True, (20, 20, 20))
    surface.blit(text, (12, 12))

# ----------------------------
# Game setup
# ----------------------------
player = Player(100, 100)
camera = Camera(world_width, world_height)

# ----------------------------
# Main loop
# ----------------------------
while True:
    dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 16.67  # normalized around 60 FPS

    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            pygame.quit()
            sys.exit()

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()

    player.update(keys, platforms, dt)
    camera.update(player.rect)

    draw_background(screen, camera.x, camera.y)
    draw_platforms(screen, platforms, camera.x, camera.y)
    player.draw(screen, camera.x, camera.y)
    draw_ui(screen, player)

    pygame.display.flip()
```

```python
def make_player_frames():
    """Create simple animated player frames."""
    frames_idle = []
    frames_run = []
    frames_jump = []

    # Idle frames
    for i in range(2):
        surf = pygame.Surface((36, 48), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        body_color = BLUE if i == 0 else (90, 140, 255)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (8, 10, 20, 28), border_radius=6)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 224, 189), (18, 8), 8)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLACK, (10, 38, 6, 8))
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLACK, (20, 38, 6, 8))
        frames_idle.append(surf)

    # Run frames
    for i in range(4):
        surf = pygame.Surface((36, 48), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLUE, (8, 10, 20, 28), border_radius=6)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 224, 189), (18, 8), 8)

        # Legs alternate
        if i % 2 == 0:
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLACK, (8, 38, 6, 8))
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLACK, (22, 36, 6, 10))
        else:
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLACK, (10, 36, 6, 10))
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLACK, (20, 38, 6, 8))

        # Arms alternate
        if i < 2:
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, PURPLE, (4, 16, 6, 14))
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, PURPLE, (26, 12, 6, 14))
        else:
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, PURPLE, (4, 12, 6, 14))
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, PURPLE, (26, 16, 6, 14))

        frames_run.append(surf)

    # Jump frame
    surf = pygame.Surface((36, 48), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLUE, (8, 10, 20, 28), border_radius=6)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 224, 189), (18, 8), 8)
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLACK, (10, 38, 6, 8))
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLACK, (20, 38, 6, 8))
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, PURPLE, (4, 12, 6, 14))
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, PURPLE, (26, 12, 6, 14))
    frames_jump.append(surf)

    return {
        "idle": frames_idle,
        "run": frames_run,
        "jump": frames_jump
    }

def make_enemy_frames():

class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h, color=BROWN):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)

                         (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y, self.rect.w, self.rect.h))
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (80, 50, 20),
                         (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y, self.rect.w, self.rect.h), 2)

class Coin:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 20, 20)
        self.collected = False
        self.t = 0

    def update(self):
        self.t += 0.15

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x):
        if self.collected:
            return
        bob = math.sin(self.t) * 4
        cx = self.rect.x - camera_x + self.rect.w // 2
        cy = self.rect.y + self.rect.h // 2 + bob
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, (int(cx), int(cy)), 10)
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (200, 160, 0), (int(cx), int(cy)), 10, 2)

class Enemy:
    def __init__(self, x, y, left_bound, right_bound):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 34, 34)
        self.vx = 2
        self.left_bound = left_bound
        self.right_bound = right_bound
        self.frames = make_enemy_frames()
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.anim_timer = 0

    def update(self):
        self.rect.x += self.vx
        if self.rect.left <= self.left_bound or self.rect.right >= self.right_bound:
            self.vx *= -1

        self.anim_timer += 1
        if self.anim_timer >= 20:
            self.anim_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(self.frames)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x):
        frame = self.frames[self.frame_index]
        if self.vx < 0:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)
        surface.blit(frame, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y))

class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 36, 48)
        self.vx = 0
        self.vy = 0
        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = make_player_frames()
        self.state = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.anim_timer = 0

        self.spawn_x = x
        self.spawn_y = y
        self.score = 0
        self.lives = 3

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vx = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vx = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vx = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vy = JUMP_STRENGTH
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vy += GRAVITY
        if self.vy > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vy = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def update_animation(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.state = "jump"
        elif self.vx != 0:
            self.state = "run"
        else:
            self.state = "idle"

        speed = 8 if self.state == "run" else 20
        self.anim_timer += 1
        if self.anim_timer >= speed:
            self.anim_timer = 0
            frames = self.animations[self.state]
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        if self.frame_index >= len(self.animations[self.state]):
            self.frame_index = 0

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += self.vx
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vx > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vx < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += int(self.vy)
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vy > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vy = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vy < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vy = 0

    def respawn(self):
        self.rect.x = self.spawn_x
        self.rect.y = self.spawn_y
        self.vx = 0
        self.vy = 0

    def update(self, platforms):
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation()

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x):
        frame = self.animations[self.state][self.frame_index]
        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)
        surface.blit(frame, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y))

    Platform(580, 300, 140, 20),
    Platform(780, 240, 140, 20),
    Platform(980, 340, 160, 20),
    Platform(1180, 260, 120, 20),
]

coins = [
    Coin(220, 380),
    Coin(420, 320),
    Coin(620, 260),
    Coin(820, 200),
    Coin(1030, 300),
    Coin(1220, 220),
]

enemies = [
    Enemy(450, 326, 380, 520),
    Enemy(1010, 306, 980, 1140),
]

player = Player(80, 440)

world_width = 1400
camera_x = 0

# -----------------------------
# Main loop

while running:
    dt = clock.tick(FPS)

    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False

        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                player.jump()

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    player.handle_input(keys)
    player.update(platforms)

    # Coins
    for coin in coins:
        coin.update()
        if not coin.collected and player.rect.colliderect(coin.rect):
            coin.collected = True
            player.score += 1

    # Enemies
    for enemy in enemies:
        enemy.update()
        if player.rect.colliderect(enemy.rect):
            player.lives -= 1
            player.respawn()
            if player.lives <= 0:
                # Reset game
                player.lives = 3
                player.score = 0
                for coin in coins:
                    coin.collected = False

    # Fall off map
    if player.rect.top > SCREEN_HEIGHT + 200:
        player.lives -= 1
        player.respawn()
        if player.lives <= 0:
            player.lives = 3
            player.score = 0
            for coin in coins:
                coin.collected = False

    # Camera follow
    camera_x = player.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
    camera_x = max(0, min(camera_x, world_width - SCREEN_WIDTH))

    # -----------------------------
    # Draw

    screen.fill(SKY)

    pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (90, 170, 90), (520 - camera_x * 0.2, 390, 420, 170))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (80, 160, 80), (900 - camera_x * 0.2, 370, 420, 190))

    for platform in platforms:
        platform.draw(screen, camera_x)

    for coin in coins:
        coin.draw(screen, camera_x)

    for enemy in enemies:
        enemy.draw(screen, camera_x)

    player.draw(screen, camera_x)

    # UI
    draw_text(screen, f"Score: {player.score}", 20, 20)
    draw_text(screen, f"Lives: {player.lives}", 20, 50)
    draw_text(screen, "Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: Space/W/Up", 20, 85)

    pygame.display.flip()
```

```python
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLUE, (8, 8, 16, 24), border_radius=6)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 224, 189), (16, 8), 8)
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLACK, (10, 34, 5, 8))
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLACK, (17, 34, 5, 8))
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, PURPLE, (5, 12, 4, 10))
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, PURPLE, (23, 12, 4, 10))
    frames["jump"].append(surf)

    return frames

def make_enemy_frames():
    frames = []
    for i in range(2):
        surf = pygame.Surface((32, 32), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, RED, (4, 8, 24, 20), border_radius=8)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, WHITE, (12, 16), 3)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, WHITE, (20, 16), 3)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, BLACK, (12, 16), 1)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, BLACK, (20, 16), 1)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLACK, (8, 28, 5, 3 + i))
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLACK, (19, 28, 5, 4 - i))
        frames.append(surf)
    return frames

PLAYER_FRAMES = make_player_frames()
ENEMY_FRAMES = make_enemy_frames()

# ----------------------------
# Game objects
# ----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w=TILE_SIZE, h=TILE_SIZE):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        r = self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, BROWN, r, border_radius=4)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, GREEN, (r.x, r.y, r.w, 10), border_radius=4)

class Coin:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x + 12, y + 12, 24, 24)
        self.collected = False
        self.anim_time = 0

    def update(self):
        self.anim_time += 0.12

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        if self.collected:
            return
        r = self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y)
        bob = int(math.sin(self.anim_time) * 4)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, YELLOW, (r.x, r.y + bob, r.w, r.h))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (255, 245, 150), (r.x + 6, r.y + 4 + bob, 8, 14))

class Enemy:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x + 8, y + 16, 32, 32)
        self.vel_x = 2
        self.vel_y = 0
        self.on_ground = False
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.anim_timer = 0

    def update(self, platforms):
        self.vel_y += GRAVITY
        self.vel_y = min(self.vel_y, MAX_FALL_SPEED)

        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += self.vel_x
        hit_wall = False
        for p in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(p.rect):
                hit_wall = True
                if self.vel_x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = p.rect.left
                else:
                    self.rect.left = p.rect.right
                self.vel_x *= -1

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += self.vel_y
        self.on_ground = False
        for p in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(p.rect):
                if self.vel_y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = p.rect.top
                    self.vel_y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = p.rect.bottom
                    self.vel_y = 0

        # Turn around at edges
        front_x = self.rect.centerx + (20 if self.vel_x > 0 else -20)
        foot_y = self.rect.bottom + 2
        support = False
        for p in platforms:
            if p.rect.collidepoint(front_x, foot_y):
                support = True
                break
        if self.on_ground and not support:
            self.vel_x *= -1

        self.anim_timer += 1
        if self.anim_timer >= 20:
            self.anim_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(ENEMY_FRAMES)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frame = ENEMY_FRAMES[self.frame_index]
        if self.vel_x < 0:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)
        surface.blit(frame, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y))

class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x + 8, y + 4, 32, 44)
        self.vel_x = 0
        self.vel_y = 0
        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True
        self.score = 0
        self.alive = True
        self.spawn = (x + 8, y + 4)

        self.anim_state = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.anim_timer = 0

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel_x = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel_x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel_x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel_y = JUMP_FORCE
            self.on_ground = False

    def update(self, platforms, coins, enemies):
        # Gravity
        self.vel_y += GRAVITY
        self.vel_y = min(self.vel_y, MAX_FALL_SPEED)

        # Horizontal move
        self.rect.x += self.vel_x
        for p in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(p.rect):
                if self.vel_x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = p.rect.left
                elif self.vel_x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = p.rect.right

        # Vertical move
        self.rect.y += self.vel_y
        self.on_ground = False
        for p in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(p.rect):
                if self.vel_y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = p.rect.top
                    self.vel_y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = p.rect.bottom
                    self.vel_y = 0

        # Collect coins
        for coin in coins:
            if not coin.collected and self.rect.colliderect(coin.rect):
                coin.collected = True
                self.score += 1

        # Enemy collisions
        for enemy in enemies:
            if self.rect.colliderect(enemy.rect):
                # Stomp enemy if falling onto it
                if self.vel_y > 0 and self.rect.bottom - enemy.rect.top < 20:
                    enemies.remove(enemy)
                    self.vel_y = -10
                    self.score += 5
                    break
                else:
                    self.respawn()

        # Fall out of world
        if self.rect.top > WORLD_HEIGHT + 200:
            self.respawn()

        self.update_animation()

    def respawn(self):
        self.rect.topleft = self.spawn
        self.vel_x = 0
        self.vel_y = 0
        self.score = max(0, self.score - 1)

    def update_animation(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.anim_state = "jump"
        elif self.vel_x != 0:
            self.anim_state = "run"
        else:
            self.anim_state = "idle"

        self.anim_timer += 1

        if self.anim_state == "run":
            if self.anim_timer >= 8:
                self.anim_timer = 0
                self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(PLAYER_FRAMES["run"])
        elif self.anim_state == "idle":
            if self.anim_timer >= 25:
                self.anim_timer = 0
                self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(PLAYER_FRAMES["idle"])
        else:
            self.frame_index = 0

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frame = PLAYER_FRAMES[self.anim_state][self.frame_index]
        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)
        surface.blit(frame, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y))

# ----------------------------
# Build level
# ----------------------------
platforms = []
coins = []
enemies = []
player = None

for row_idx, row in enumerate(level_map):
    for col_idx, cell in enumerate(row):
        x = col_idx * TILE_SIZE
        y = row_idx * TILE_SIZE

        if cell == "X":
            platforms.append(Platform(x, y))
        elif cell == "C":
            coins.append(Coin(x, y))
        elif cell == "E":
            enemies.append(Enemy(x, y))
        elif cell == "P":
            player = Player(x, y)

if player is None:
    player = Player(100, 100)

# ----------------------------
# Main loop
# ----------------------------
running = True

while running:
    dt = clock.tick(FPS)

    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False

        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                player.jump()

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    player.handle_input(keys)

    # Update
    player.update(platforms, coins, enemies)

    for coin in coins:
        coin.update()

    for enemy in enemies:
        enemy.update(platforms)

    # Camera
    camera_x = player.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
    camera_y = player.rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2
    camera_x = clamp(camera_x, 0, max(0, WORLD_WIDTH - SCREEN_WIDTH))
    camera_y = clamp(camera_y, 0, max(0, WORLD_HEIGHT - SCREEN_HEIGHT))

    # Draw background
    screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # Parallax clouds
    for i in range(6):
        cloud_x = (i * 220 - camera_x * 0.3) % (SCREEN_WIDTH + 300) - 150
        cloud_y = 60 + (i % 3) * 50
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, WHITE, (cloud_x, cloud_y, 90, 40))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, WHITE, (cloud_x + 25, cloud_y - 15, 70, 45))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, WHITE, (cloud_x + 50, cloud_y, 90, 40))

    # Draw world

    for enemy in enemies:

    player.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

    # UI
    score_text = font.render(f"Score: {player.score}", True, BLACK)
    controls_text = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: Space/W/Up", True, BLACK)
    screen.blit(score_text, (20, 20))
```

```python
import pygame
import sys

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960

PLATFORM_COLOR = (100, 100, 100)

# ----------------------------
# Helper functions
# ----------------------------
def make_frame(size, body_color, accent_color, offset=0):
    """Create a simple placeholder sprite frame."""
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    w, h = size

    # Body
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (8, 8, w - 16, h - 16), border_radius=8)

    # Face / accent to simulate animation
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, accent_color, (w // 2 + offset, h // 3), 5)
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (w // 3, h - 18, w // 3, 6), border_radius=3)

    return surf

def clamp(value, min_value, max_value):
    return max(min_value, min(value, max_value))

# ----------------------------
# Platform class
# ----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x):
        pygame.draw.rect(
            surface,
            PLATFORM_COLOR,
            pygame.Rect(self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y, self.rect.width, self.rect.height),
            border_radius=4
        )

# ----------------------------
# Player class

class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 48, 64)
        self.vel_x = 0
        self.vel_y = 0
        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        # Animation frames
        self.idle_frames = [
            make_frame((48, 64), (255, 180, 50), (40, 40, 40), 0),
            make_frame((48, 64), (255, 190, 70), (40, 40, 40), 1),
        ]
        self.run_frames = [
            make_frame((48, 64), (255, 140, 50), (20, 20, 20), -3),
            make_frame((48, 64), (255, 160, 50), (20, 20, 20), 0),
            make_frame((48, 64), (255, 180, 50), (20, 20, 20), 3),
            make_frame((48, 64), (255, 160, 50), (20, 20, 20), 0),
        ]
        self.jump_frame = make_frame((48, 64), (255, 100, 100), (0, 0, 0), 0)

        self.anim_timer = 0
        self.anim_speed = 0.12
        self.anim_index = 0

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel_x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel_x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel_x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

        if (keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_UP] or keys[pygame.K_w]) and self.on_ground:
            self.vel_y = JUMP_STRENGTH
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel_y += GRAVITY
        self.vel_y = min(self.vel_y, MAX_FALL_SPEED)

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += self.vel_x
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel_x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel_y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel_y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel_y = 0

    def update_animation(self):
        moving = self.vel_x != 0

        if not self.on_ground:
            current = self.jump_frame
        elif moving:
            self.anim_timer += self.anim_speed
            if self.anim_timer >= 1:
                self.anim_timer = 0
                self.anim_index = (self.anim_index + 1) % len(self.run_frames)
            current = self.run_frames[self.anim_index]
        else:
            self.anim_timer += self.anim_speed * 0.5
            if self.anim_timer >= 1:
                self.anim_timer = 0
                self.anim_index = (self.anim_index + 1) % len(self.idle_frames)
            current = self.idle_frames[self.anim_index % len(self.idle_frames)]

        if not self.facing_right:
            current = pygame.transform.flip(current, True, False)

        self.current_sprite = current

    def update(self, keys, platforms):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation()

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x):
        surface.blit(self.current_sprite, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y))

# ----------------------------
# Level setup
# ----------------------------
def create_level():
    platforms = [
        Platform(-200, 500, 2000, 50),  # ground
        Platform(250, 420, 140, 20),
        Platform(470, 360, 140, 20),
        Platform(700, 300, 140, 20),
        Platform(950, 430, 180, 20),
        Platform(1200, 350, 160, 20),
        Platform(1450, 280, 180, 20),
    ]
    return platforms

# ----------------------------
# Main game
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 28)

    player = Player(100, 200)
    platforms = create_level()

    camera_x = 0
    running = True

    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(keys, platforms)

        # Camera follows player
        camera_x = player.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        camera_x = max(0, camera_x)

        # Draw background
        screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

        # Draw simple distant hills
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (120, 190, 120), (-100 - camera_x * 0.2, 380, 400, 180))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (110, 180, 110), (250 - camera_x * 0.2, 360, 500, 200))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (100, 170, 100), (700 - camera_x * 0.2, 390, 450, 170))

        # Draw platforms
        for platform in platforms:
            platform.draw(screen, camera_x)

        # Draw player
        player.draw(screen, camera_x)

        # UI
        info = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: Space/W/Up", True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(info, (20, 20))

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()

if __name__ == "__main__":
```

```python
        # Horizontal movement

        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel_x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += self.vel_y
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel_y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel_y = 0

    def update_animation(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.current_animation = "jump"
        elif self.vel_x != 0:
            self.current_animation = "run"
        else:
            self.current_animation = "idle"

        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]

        if self.current_animation in ("run", "idle"):
            self.animation_timer += self.animation_speed
            if self.animation_timer >= 1:
                self.animation_timer = 0
                self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)
        else:
            self.frame_index = 0

    def update(self, keys, platforms):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation()

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        image = frames[self.frame_index]

        if not self.facing_right:
            image = pygame.transform.flip(image, True, False)

        surface.blit(image, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y))
```

```python
        if self.rect.x > self.start_x + self.range:
            self.direction = -1
        elif self.rect.x < self.start_x - self.range:

            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(self.frames)

class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.spawn = (x, y)
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 36, 44)

        self.vel_x = 0
        self.vel_y = 0

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.idle_frames = make_animation_frames(BLUE, WHITE, (36, 44))
        self.run_frames = make_animation_frames(PURPLE, WHITE, (36, 44))
        self.jump_frames = make_animation_frames(YELLOW, WHITE, (36, 44))

        self.anim_timer = 0
        self.frame_index = 0

    def respawn(self):
        self.rect.topleft = self.spawn
        self.vel_x = 0
        self.vel_y = 0

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel_x -= MOVE_ACCEL
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel_x += MOVE_ACCEL
            self.facing_right = True

        self.vel_x = clamp(self.vel_x, -MAX_RUN_SPEED, MAX_RUN_SPEED)

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel_y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_physics(self):
        self.vel_y += GRAVITY
        self.vel_y = min(self.vel_y, MAX_FALL_SPEED)

        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel_x *= GROUND_FRICTION
        else:
            self.vel_x *= AIR_FRICTION

        if abs(self.vel_x) < 0.1:
            self.vel_x = 0

    def move_and_collide(self, tiles):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += int(self.vel_x)
        for tile in tiles:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile.rect):
                if self.vel_x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = tile.rect.left
                elif self.vel_x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = tile.rect.right
                self.vel_x = 0

        # Vertical movement
        self.on_ground = False
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel_y)
        for tile in tiles:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile.rect):
                if self.vel_y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = tile.rect.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = tile.rect.bottom
                self.vel_y = 0

    def update_animation(self):
        self.anim_timer += 1
        if self.anim_timer >= 8:
            self.anim_timer = 0
            self.frame_index += 1

        current_frames = self.get_current_frames()
        if self.frame_index >= len(current_frames):
            self.frame_index = 0

    def get_current_frames(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            return self.jump_frames
        elif abs(self.vel_x) > 0.5:
            return self.run_frames
        else:
            return self.idle_frames

    def update(self, tiles):
        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_physics()
        self.move_and_collide(tiles)
        self.update_animation()

        if self.rect.top > LEVEL_HEIGHT + 200:
            self.respawn()

        frame = frames[self.frame_index % len(frames)]

            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        surface.blit(frame, pos)
```

```python
        for x in range(0, sheet_width, frame_width):

            frame.blit(sheet, (0, 0), (x, y, frame_width, frame_height))

    def update(self, platforms):
        self.vel_y += GRAVITY
        self.rect.x += self.vel_x

        hit_list = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(self, platforms, False)
        if hit_list:
            self.vel_x *= -1
            if self.vel_x > 0:
                self.rect.left = hit_list[0].rect.right
            else:
                self.rect.right = hit_list[0].rect.left

        self.rect.y += self.vel_y
        hit_list = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(self, platforms, False)
        for platform in hit_list:
            if self.vel_y > 0:
                self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                self.vel_y = 0
            elif self.vel_y < 0:
                self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                self.vel_y = 0

class Player(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__()

        # Try to load a real sprite sheet; fallback to generated one
        try:
            self.frames = load_sprite_sheet("player_spritesheet.png", 32, 32, scale=2)
        except:
            sheet = make_placeholder_sheet()
            self.frames = slice_sheet(sheet, 32, 32, scale=2)

        self.idle_frames = self.frames[:2]
        self.run_frames = self.frames
        self.jump_frame = self.frames[0]

        self.frame_index = 0
        self.anim_speed = 0.15
        self.image = self.idle_frames[0]
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True
        self.score = 0
        self.alive = True

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel.x = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_FORCE
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel.y > 15:
            self.vel.y = 15

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal
        self.rect.x += int(self.vel.x)
        hit_list = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(self, platforms, False)
        for platform in hit_list:
            if self.vel.x > 0:
                self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
            elif self.vel.x < 0:
                self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel.y)
        hit_list = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(self, platforms, False)
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in hit_list:
            if self.vel.y > 0:
                self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                self.vel.y = 0
                self.on_ground = True
            elif self.vel.y < 0:
                self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                self.vel.y = 0

    def animate(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            frame = self.jump_frame
        elif self.vel.x != 0:
            self.frame_index += self.anim_speed
            if self.frame_index >= len(self.run_frames):
                self.frame_index = 0
            frame = self.run_frames[int(self.frame_index)]
        else:
            self.frame_index += self.anim_speed * 0.5
            if self.frame_index >= len(self.idle_frames):
                self.frame_index = 0
            frame = self.idle_frames[int(self.frame_index)]

        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        self.image = frame

    def update(self, platforms):
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.animate()

# ----------------------------
# Build level
# ----------------------------
platforms = pygame.sprite.Group()
coins = pygame.sprite.Group()
enemies = pygame.sprite.Group()
all_sprites = pygame.sprite.Group()

player = None

for row_index, row in enumerate(level_map):
    for col_index, cell in enumerate(row):
        x = col_index * TILE_SIZE
        y = row_index * TILE_SIZE

        if cell == "#":
            p = Platform(x, y)
            platforms.add(p)
            all_sprites.add(p)
        elif cell == "P":
            player = Player(x, y)
            all_sprites.add(player)
        elif cell == "C":
            c = Coin(x, y)
            coins.add(c)
            all_sprites.add(c)
        elif cell == "E":
            e = Enemy(x, y)
            enemies.add(e)
            all_sprites.add(e)

camera = Camera(WORLD_WIDTH, WORLD_HEIGHT)

# ----------------------------
# Main loop
# ----------------------------
running = True
while running:
    dt = clock.tick(FPS)

    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False

        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if event.key == pygame.K_SPACE or event.key == pygame.K_UP or event.key == pygame.K_w:
                player.jump()

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    player.handle_input(keys)
    player.update(platforms)

    coins.update()
    for enemy in enemies:
        enemy.update(platforms)

    # Coin collection
    collected = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(player, coins, True)
    player.score += len(collected)

    # Enemy collision
    if pygame.sprite.spritecollide(player, enemies, False):
        player.alive = False

    # Fall out of world
    if player.rect.top > WORLD_HEIGHT:
        player.alive = False

    # Restart if dead
    if not player.alive:
        text = font.render("Game Over! Press R to Restart or ESC to Quit", True, (255, 255, 255))
        screen.fill((20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(text, (SCREEN_WIDTH // 2 - text.get_width() // 2, SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2))
        pygame.display.flip()

        waiting = True
        while waiting:
            clock.tick(FPS)
            for event in pygame.event.get():
                if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                    pygame.quit()
                    sys.exit()
                if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                    if event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                        pygame.quit()
                        sys.exit()
                    if event.key == pygame.K_r:
                        pygame.quit()
                        import subprocess
                        subprocess.Popen([sys.executable] + sys.argv)
                        sys.exit()

    camera.follow(player)

    # ----------------------------
    # Draw
    # ----------------------------
    screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # Parallax clouds
    for i in range(8):
        cloud_x = (i * 220 - camera.offset.x * 0.3) % (WORLD_WIDTH + 300) - 150
        cloud_y = 60 + (i % 3) * 50
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (cloud_x, cloud_y, 100, 40))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (245, 245, 245), (cloud_x + 30, cloud_y - 10, 90, 50))

    # Draw sprites with camera offset
    for sprite in all_sprites:
        draw_pos = sprite.rect.topleft - camera.offset
        screen.blit(sprite.image, draw_pos)

    # HUD
    score_text = font.render(f"Score: {player.score}", True, (20, 20, 20))
    controls_text = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: Space/W/Up", True, (20, 20, 20))
    screen.blit(score_text, (20, 20))
    screen.blit(controls_text, (20, 50))

    pygame.display.flip()

pygame.quit()
sys.exit()
```

```python
import pygame
import sys
import math

# -----------------------------
# Config
# -----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60
TILE = 48
GRAVITY = 0.6
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
JUMP_VELOCITY = -13
BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()
font = pygame.font.SysFont("arial", 24)

# -----------------------------
# Helpers
# -----------------------------
def clamp(value, min_value, max_value):
    return max(min_value, min(value, max_value))

def make_frame(size, body_color, accent_color, pose=0):
    """Generate a simple animated sprite frame."""
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    w, h = size

    # body
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (w * 0.25, h * 0.2, w * 0.5, h * 0.55), border_radius=8)

    # head
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, accent_color, (w // 2, int(h * 0.18)), int(w * 0.16))

    # legs / arms vary by pose
    if pose == 0:
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w * 0.38, h * 0.75), (w * 0.28, h * 0.95), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w * 0.62, h * 0.75), (w * 0.72, h * 0.95), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w * 0.28, h * 0.45), (w * 0.15, h * 0.62), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w * 0.72, h * 0.45), (w * 0.85, h * 0.62), 4)
    elif pose == 1:
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w * 0.38, h * 0.75), (w * 0.35, h * 0.95), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w * 0.62, h * 0.75), (w * 0.78, h * 0.95), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w * 0.28, h * 0.45), (w * 0.10, h * 0.55), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w * 0.72, h * 0.45), (w * 0.88, h * 0.55), 4)
    else:
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w * 0.38, h * 0.75), (w * 0.22, h * 0.95), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w * 0.62, h * 0.75), (w * 0.65, h * 0.95), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w * 0.28, h * 0.45), (w * 0.18, h * 0.68), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w * 0.72, h * 0.45), (w * 0.82, h * 0.68), 4)

    return surf

def make_coin_frames(radius=12, count=6):
    frames = []
    for i in range(count):
        surf = pygame.Surface((radius * 2 + 8, radius * 2 + 8), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        scale_x = abs(math.sin((i / count) * math.pi))
        width = max(4, int(radius * 2 * scale_x))
        rect = pygame.Rect(0, 0, width, radius * 2)
        rect.center = (radius + 4, radius + 4)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surf, (255, 215, 0), rect)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surf, (255, 240, 120), rect.inflate(-4, -4))
        frames.append(surf)
    return frames

# -----------------------------
# Level
# -----------------------------
level_map = [
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "....................C...........................................",
    "..............====..............................................",
    "....................................................C...........",
    ".........................C......................................",
    "...............====......................====...................",
    "............................................................E...",
    "......C.........................................................",
    ".................E..............................................",
    "==========================..............========================",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "################################################################",
]

WORLD_WIDTH = len(level_map[0]) * TILE
WORLD_HEIGHT = len(level_map) * TILE

# -----------------------------
# Classes
# -----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h, color=(90, 70, 50)):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)
        self.color = color

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        r = self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, self.color, r)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (60, 45, 30), r, 2)

class AnimatedSprite:
    def __init__(self, frames, frame_speed=0.15):
        self.frames = frames
        self.frame_speed = frame_speed
        self.frame_index = 0

    def update(self):
        self.frame_index += self.frame_speed
        if self.frame_index >= len(self.frames):
            self.frame_index = 0

    def image(self):
        return self.frames[int(self.frame_index)]

class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 36, 56)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True
        self.score = 0
        self.spawn = (x, y)

        self.idle_anim = AnimatedSprite([
            make_frame((36, 56), (220, 70, 70), (255, 220, 190), 0)
        ], 0.1)

        self.run_anim = AnimatedSprite([
            make_frame((36, 56), (220, 70, 70), (255, 220, 190), 0),
            make_frame((36, 56), (220, 70, 70), (255, 220, 190), 1),
            make_frame((36, 56), (220, 70, 70), (255, 220, 190), 2),
        ], 0.2)

        self.jump_anim = AnimatedSprite([
            make_frame((36, 56), (220, 70, 70), (255, 220, 190), 1)
        ], 0.1)

        self.current_anim = self.idle_anim

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel.x = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        self.vel.y = min(self.vel.y, 16)

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal
        self.rect.x += int(self.vel.x)
        for p in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(p.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = p.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = p.rect.right

        # Vertical
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel.y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for p in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(p.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = p.rect.top
                    self.vel.y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = p.rect.bottom
                    self.vel.y = 0

    def update_animation(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.current_anim = self.jump_anim
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 0:
            self.current_anim = self.run_anim
        else:
            self.current_anim = self.idle_anim
        self.current_anim.update()

    def update(self, platforms):
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation()

        # Respawn if fallen out of world
        if self.rect.top > WORLD_HEIGHT + 200:
            self.rect.topleft = self.spawn
            self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        img = self.current_anim.image()
        if not self.facing_right:
            img = pygame.transform.flip(img, True, False)
        surface.blit(img, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y))

class Coin:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.frames = make_coin_frames()
        self.anim = AnimatedSprite(self.frames, 0.2)
        self.rect = self.frames[0].get_rect(center=(x, y))
        self.collected = False

    def update(self):
        self.anim.update()

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        if not self.collected:
            img = self.anim.image()
            surface.blit(img, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y))

class Enemy:
    def __init__(self, x, y, patrol_width=160):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 36, 40)
        self.start_x = x
        self.patrol_width = patrol_width
        self.vel_x = 2
        self.vel_y = 0
        self.on_ground = False

        self.anim = AnimatedSprite([
            make_frame((36, 40), (70, 70, 220), (220, 220, 255), 0),
            make_frame((36, 40), (70, 70, 220), (220, 220, 255), 1),
        ], 0.12)

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel_y += GRAVITY
        self.vel_y = min(self.vel_y, 14)

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        self.rect.x += self.vel_x
        if self.rect.x < self.start_x:
            self.rect.x = self.start_x
            self.vel_x *= -1
        if self.rect.x > self.start_x + self.patrol_width:
            self.rect.x = self.start_x + self.patrol_width
            self.vel_x *= -1

        for p in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(p.rect):
                if self.vel_x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = p.rect.left
                    self.vel_x *= -1
                else:
                    self.rect.left = p.rect.right
                    self.vel_x *= -1

        self.rect.y += int(self.vel_y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for p in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(p.rect):
                if self.vel_y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = p.rect.top
                    self.vel_y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = p.rect.bottom
                    self.vel_y = 0

    def update(self, platforms):
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.anim.update()

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        img = self.anim.image()
        if self.vel_x < 0:
            img = pygame.transform.flip(img, True, False)
        surface.blit(img, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y))

# -----------------------------
# Build level
# -----------------------------
platforms = []
coins = []
enemies = []
player = Player(100, 100)

for row_idx, row in enumerate(level_map):
    for col_idx, cell in enumerate(row):
        x = col_idx * TILE
        y = row_idx * TILE

        if cell == "#":
            platforms.append(Platform(x, y, TILE, TILE, (100, 180, 100)))
        elif cell == "=":
            platforms.append(Platform(x, y + TILE // 2, TILE, TILE // 2, (140, 100, 70)))
        elif cell == "C":
            coins.append(Coin(x + TILE // 2, y + TILE // 2))
        elif cell == "E":
            enemies.append(Enemy(x, y))

# -----------------------------
# Camera
# -----------------------------
def get_camera(player_rect):
    camera_x = player_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
    camera_y = player_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

    camera_x = clamp(camera_x, 0, max(0, WORLD_WIDTH - SCREEN_WIDTH))
    camera_y = clamp(camera_y, 0, max(0, WORLD_HEIGHT - SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    return camera_x, camera_y

# -----------------------------
# Drawing
# -----------------------------
def draw_background(surface, camera_x, camera_y):
    surface.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # parallax hills
    for i in range(6):
        hill_x = (i * 300) - (camera_x * 0.3 % 300)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (100, 190, 120), (hill_x, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 140, 380, 180))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (80, 170, 100), (hill_x + 120, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 120, 320, 160))

    # clouds
    for i in range(8):
        cx = (i * 220) - (camera_x * 0.15 % 220)
        cy = 50 + (i % 3) * 35
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 255, 255), (int(cx), cy), 22)
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 255, 255), (int(cx + 20), cy - 10), 18)
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 255, 255), (int(cx + 40), cy), 22)

def draw_ui(surface, player):
    text = font.render(f"Score: {player.score}", True, (20, 20, 20))
    surface.blit(text, (20, 20))

# -----------------------------
# Main loop
# -----------------------------
def main():
    running = True

    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS)

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False

            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    player.jump()

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.handle_input(keys)
        player.update(platforms)

        for coin in coins:
            if not coin.collected:
                coin.update()
                if player.rect.colliderect(coin.rect):
                    coin.collected = True
                    player.score += 1

        for enemy in enemies:
            enemy.update(platforms)
            if player.rect.colliderect(enemy.rect):
                # Stomp enemy if falling onto it
                if player.vel.y > 0 and player.rect.bottom - enemy.rect.top < 20:
                    enemies.remove(enemy)
                    player.vel.y = -8
                    break
                else:
                    player.rect.topleft = player.spawn
                    player.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        camera_x, camera_y = get_camera(player.rect)

        draw_background(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

        for p in platforms:
            p.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

        for coin in coins:
            coin.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

        for enemy in enemies:
            enemy.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

        player.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)
        draw_ui(screen, player)

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
import pygame
import sys

# ----------------------------
# Configuration
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60

GRAVITY = 0.6
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
JUMP_STRENGTH = -13
MAX_FALL_SPEED = 14

TILE_SIZE = 64

# ----------------------------
# Helper functions
# ----------------------------
def make_frame(size, body_color, accent_color, leg_offset=0, arm_offset=0):
    """Create a simple animated character frame."""
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    w, h = size

    # Head
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 220, 180), (w // 2, h // 4), 12)

    # Body
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (w // 2 - 10, h // 4 + 12, 20, 28))

    # Arms
    pygame.draw.line(surf, accent_color, (w // 2 - 10, h // 4 + 20), (w // 2 - 20, h // 4 + 30 + arm_offset), 4)
    pygame.draw.line(surf, accent_color, (w // 2 + 10, h // 4 + 20), (w // 2 + 20, h // 4 + 30 - arm_offset), 4)

    # Legs
    pygame.draw.line(surf, (40, 40, 40), (w // 2 - 5, h // 4 + 40), (w // 2 - 10, h - 10 + leg_offset), 4)
    pygame.draw.line(surf, (40, 40, 40), (w // 2 + 5, h // 4 + 40), (w // 2 + 10, h - 10 - leg_offset), 4)

    return surf

def create_player_animations():
    idle = [
        make_frame((40, 60), (70, 140, 255), (255, 255, 255), 0, 0),
        make_frame((40, 60), (70, 140, 255), (255, 255, 255), 1, 1),
    ]
    run = [
        make_frame((40, 60), (70, 200, 120), (255, 255, 255), -4, -2),
        make_frame((40, 60), (70, 200, 120), (255, 255, 255), 4, 2),
        make_frame((40, 60), (70, 200, 120), (255, 255, 255), -2, 1),
        make_frame((40, 60), (70, 200, 120), (255, 255, 255), 2, -1),
    ]
    jump = [
        make_frame((40, 60), (255, 180, 60), (255, 255, 255), 0, 0)
    ]
    fall = [
        make_frame((40, 60), (255, 100, 100), (255, 255, 255), 3, -2)
    ]
    return {
        "idle": idle,
        "run": run,
        "jump": jump,
        "fall": fall,
    }

# ----------------------------
# Platform class
# ----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h, color=(100, 80, 60)):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)
        self.color = color

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        draw_rect = self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, self.color, draw_rect)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (60, 45, 30), draw_rect, 3)

# ----------------------------
# Player class
# ----------------------------
class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 40, 60)
        self.vel_x = 0
        self.vel_y = 0
        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = create_player_animations()
        self.current_animation = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.12

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel_x = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel_x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel_x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel_y = JUMP_STRENGTH
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel_y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel_y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel_y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += self.vel_x
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel_x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel_y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel_y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel_y = 0

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            if self.vel_y < 0:
                self.current_animation = "jump"
            else:
                self.current_animation = "fall"
        else:
            if self.vel_x != 0:
                self.current_animation = "run"
            else:
                self.current_animation = "idle"

        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        self.animation_timer += dt * self.animation_speed * 60

        if len(frames) > 1:
            if self.animation_timer >= 1:
                self.animation_timer = 0
                self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)
        else:
            self.frame_index = 0

    def update(self, keys, platforms, dt):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        image = frames[self.frame_index]

        if not self.facing_right:
            image = pygame.transform.flip(image, True, False)

        draw_pos = (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y)
        surface.blit(image, draw_pos)

        # Optional debug hitbox
        # pygame.draw.rect(surface, (255, 0, 0), self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y), 2)

# ----------------------------
# Level creation
# ----------------------------
def create_level():
    platforms = []

    # Ground
    platforms.append(Platform(-400, 460, 2200, 100, (90, 140, 90)))

    # Floating platforms
    platforms.append(Platform(200, 360, 180, 24))
    platforms.append(Platform(460, 300, 180, 24))
    platforms.append(Platform(720, 240, 180, 24))
    platforms.append(Platform(1020, 340, 180, 24))
    platforms.append(Platform(1320, 280, 220, 24))
    platforms.append(Platform(1650, 200, 180, 24))

    return platforms

# ----------------------------
# Background drawing
# ----------------------------
def draw_background(screen, camera_x):
    screen.fill((135, 206, 235))  # sky

    # Parallax hills
    for i in range(6):
        hill_x = i * 350 - (camera_x * 0.3) % 350
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (110, 180, 110), (hill_x, 320, 300, 180))

    # Far ground strip
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (80, 160, 80), (0, 430, SCREEN_WIDTH, 110))

# ----------------------------
# Main game
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 28)

    player = Player(100, 200)
    platforms = create_level()

    camera_x = 0
    camera_y = 0

    running = True
    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0

        # Events
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False

            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    player.jump()

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(keys, platforms, dt)

        # Camera follows player
        camera_x = player.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        camera_y = 0

        # Draw
        draw_background(screen, camera_x)

        for platform in platforms:
            platform.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

        player.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

        # UI
        info = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: W/Up/Space", True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(info, (20, 20))

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
        # Run frames
```

```python
            surf = pygame.Surface((36, 52), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            body_color = (100, 220 - i * 10, 120 + i * 10)
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (8, 10, 20, 30), border_radius=6)
            pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 220, 180), (18, 8), 8)

            leg_offset = 4 if i % 2 == 0 else -4
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, (50, 50, 70), (10, 40, 6, 10 + leg_offset), border_radius=3)
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, (50, 50, 70), (20, 40, 6, 10 - leg_offset), border_radius=3)

            arm_offset = 3 if i % 2 == 0 else -3
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, (50, 50, 70), (4, 16, 6, 12 + arm_offset), border_radius=3)
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, (50, 50, 70), (26, 16, 6, 12 - arm_offset), border_radius=3)

            animations["run"].append(surf)

        # Jump frame
        surf = pygame.Surface((36, 52), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (255, 180, 80), (8, 10, 20, 30), border_radius=6)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 220, 180), (18, 8), 8)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (50, 50, 70), (10, 40, 6, 8), border_radius=3)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (50, 50, 70), (20, 40, 6, 8), border_radius=3)
        animations["jump"].append(surf)

        # Fall frame
        surf = pygame.Surface((36, 52), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (255, 100, 100), (8, 10, 20, 30), border_radius=6)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 220, 180), (18, 8), 8)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (50, 50, 70), (10, 40, 6, 12), border_radius=3)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (50, 50, 70), (20, 40, 6, 12), border_radius=3)
        animations["fall"].append(surf)

        return animations

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        elif keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True
        else:
            self.vel.x *= FRICTION
            if abs(self.vel.x) < 0.2:
                self.vel.x = 0

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_FORCE
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        self.vel.y = clamp(self.vel.y, -100, MAX_FALL_SPEED)

    def update_state(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            if self.vel.y < 0:
                self.state = "jump"
            else:
                self.state = "fall"
        else:
            if abs(self.vel.x) > 0.5:
                self.state = "run"
            else:
                self.state = "idle"

    def animate(self):
        frames = self.animations[self.state]
        self.animation_timer += self.animation_speed

        if self.animation_timer >= 1:
            self.animation_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        image = frames[self.frame_index]

        if not self.facing_right:
            image = pygame.transform.flip(image, True, False)

        self.image = image

    def horizontal_collisions(self, platforms):
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)
        hits = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(self, platforms, False)
        for platform in hits:
            if self.vel.x > 0:
                self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x
            elif self.vel.x < 0:
                self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x

    def vertical_collisions(self, platforms):
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)
        hits = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(self, platforms, False)
        self.on_ground = False

        for platform in hits:
            if self.vel.y > 0:
                self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                self.vel.y = 0
                self.on_ground = True
            elif self.vel.y < 0:
                self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                self.vel.y = 0

    def update(self, platforms, keys):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity()

        self.pos.x += self.vel.x
        self.horizontal_collisions(platforms)

        self.pos.y += self.vel.y
        self.vertical_collisions(platforms)

        self.update_state()
        self.animate()

# ----------------------------
# Camera
# ----------------------------
class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.offset = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.width = width
        self.height = height

    def follow(self, target):
        self.offset.x = target.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.offset.y = target.rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        self.offset.x = clamp(self.offset.x, 0, self.width - SCREEN_WIDTH)
        self.offset.y = clamp(self.offset.y, 0, self.height - SCREEN_HEIGHT)

# ----------------------------
# Build level
# ----------------------------
def build_level():
    platforms = pygame.sprite.Group()
    player = None

    for row_index, row in enumerate(LEVEL_MAP):
        for col_index, cell in enumerate(row):
            x = col_index * TILE_SIZE
            y = row_index * TILE_SIZE

            if cell == "X":
                platforms.add(Platform(x, y))
            elif cell == "P":
                player = Player(x, y)

    level_width = len(LEVEL_MAP[0]) * TILE_SIZE
    level_height = len(LEVEL_MAP) * TILE_SIZE
    return platforms, player, level_width, level_height

# ----------------------------
# Drawing
# ----------------------------
def draw_background(screen, camera):
    screen.fill((135, 206, 235))

    # Parallax hills
    for i in range(8):
        hill_x = i * 300 - camera.offset.x * 0.3
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (110, 180, 110), (hill_x, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 180, 320, 140))

    # Clouds
    for i in range(10):
        cloud_x = i * 220 - camera.offset.x * 0.15
        cloud_y = 60 + (i % 3) * 40
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (cloud_x, cloud_y, 80, 40))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (cloud_x + 20, cloud_y - 15, 70, 50))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (cloud_x + 45, cloud_y, 80, 40))

def draw_scene(screen, player, platforms, camera):
    draw_background(screen, camera)

    for platform in platforms:
        screen.blit(platform.image, platform.rect.topleft - camera.offset)

    screen.blit(player.image, player.rect.topleft - camera.offset)

# ----------------------------
# Main
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    platforms, player, level_width, level_height = build_level()
    camera = Camera(level_width, level_height)

    while True:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                pygame.quit()
                sys.exit()
            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    player.jump()

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(platforms, keys)
        camera.follow(player)

        draw_scene(screen, player, platforms, camera)

        # UI
        font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 28)
        text = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: Space/W/Up", True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(text, (20, 20))

        pygame.display.flip()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
