import pygame
import sys

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60

TILE_SIZE = 64
GRAVITY = 0.6
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
JUMP_VELOCITY = -14
MAX_FALL_SPEED = 16
FRICTION = 0.8

# ----------------------------
# Init
# ----------------------------
pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

# ----------------------------
# Helper functions
# ----------------------------
def create_animation_frames(size, colors, label_prefix=""):
    """
    Create simple colored placeholder frames for animation.
    Replace this with real sprite loading if desired.
    """
    frames = []
    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 24)
    for i, color in enumerate(colors):
        surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
        surf.fill(color)

        # Draw a simple face/body marker so animation is visible
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (20, 20, 20), (8, 8, size[0]-16, size[1]-16), 2)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 255, 255), (size[0]//2, size[1]//3), 6)
        text = font.render(f"{label_prefix}{i}", True, (0, 0, 0))
        surf.blit(text, (6, size[1] - 24))
        frames.append(surf)
    return frames

# ----------------------------
# Level
# ----------------------------
level_map = [
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "......................###.......................................",
    "..............................................###...............",
    "..............###...............................................",
    "..................................####..........................",
    ".........................###....................................",
    ".............####...............................................",
    "......................................................###.......",
    "....................###.........................................",
    "...............................................................#",
    "############################################################....",
]

platforms = []

for row_index, row in enumerate(level_map):
    for col_index, cell in enumerate(row):
        if cell == "#":
            rect = pygame.Rect(
                col_index * TILE_SIZE,
                row_index * TILE_SIZE,
                TILE_SIZE,
                TILE_SIZE
            )
            platforms.append(rect)

# ----------------------------
# Player class
# ----------------------------
class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 40, 56)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        # Animation setup
        self.animations = {
            "idle": create_animation_frames((40, 56), [(100, 200, 255), (120, 220, 255)], "I"),
            "run": create_animation_frames((40, 56), [(100, 255, 100), (80, 220, 80), (60, 200, 60), (80, 220, 80)], "R"),
            "jump": create_animation_frames((40, 56), [(255, 200, 100)], "J"),
        }
        self.current_animation = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.12

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        moving = False

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
            moving = True
        elif keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True
            moving = True
        else:
            self.vel.x *= FRICTION
            if abs(self.vel.x) < 0.2:
                self.vel.x = 0

        if (keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_UP] or keys[pygame.K_w]) and self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

        # Set animation state
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.current_animation = "jump"
        elif moving:
            self.current_animation = "run"
        else:
            self.current_animation = "idle"

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel.y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel.y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += int(self.vel.x)
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.right

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel.y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.top
                    self.vel.y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.bottom
                    self.vel.y = 0

    def update_animation(self):
        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        self.animation_timer += self.animation_speed
        if self.animation_timer >= 1:
            self.animation_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        # Reset frame index if current animation has fewer frames
        if self.frame_index >= len(frames):
            self.frame_index = 0

    def update(self, platforms, keys):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation()

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        image = frames[self.frame_index]

        if not self.facing_right:
            image = pygame.transform.flip(image, True, False)

        surface.blit(image, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y))

# ----------------------------
# Camera
# ----------------------------
class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        self.x = 0
        self.y = 0

    def update(self, target_rect):
        self.x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        max_x = self.width - SCREEN_WIDTH
        max_y = self.height - SCREEN_HEIGHT

        self.x = max(0, min(self.x, max_x))
        self.y = max(0, min(self.y, max_y))

# ----------------------------
# World dimensions
# ----------------------------
WORLD_WIDTH = len(level_map[0]) * TILE_SIZE
WORLD_HEIGHT = len(level_map) * TILE_SIZE

player = Player(100, 100)
camera = Camera(WORLD_WIDTH, WORLD_HEIGHT)

# ----------------------------
# Main loop
# ----------------------------
def draw_background(surface, camera_x, camera_y):
    surface.fill((135, 206, 235))  # sky blue

    # Simple parallax hills
    for i in range(6):
        hill_x = i * 300 - (camera_x * 0.3)
        hill_y = 350
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (100, 180, 100), (hill_x, hill_y, 300, 180))

def draw_platforms(surface, camera_x, camera_y):
    for platform in platforms:
        draw_rect = pygame.Rect(
            platform.x - camera_x,
            platform.y - camera_y,
            platform.width,
            platform.height
        )
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (110, 80, 50), draw_rect)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (70, 200, 70), (draw_rect.x, draw_rect.y, draw_rect.width, 12))

def draw_ui(surface, player):
    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 28)
    text = font.render(
        f"Pos: ({player.rect.x}, {player.rect.y})  Vel: ({player.vel.x:.1f}, {player.vel.y:.1f})",
        True,
        (20, 20, 20)
    )
    surface.blit(text, (20, 20))

while True:
    dt = clock.tick(FPS)

    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            pygame.quit()
            sys.exit()

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()

    player.update(platforms, keys)
    camera.update(player.rect)

    draw_background(screen, camera.x, camera.y)
    draw_platforms(screen, camera.x, camera.y)
    player.draw(screen, camera.x, camera.y)
    draw_ui(screen, player)

    pygame.display.flip()

def load_frames(paths, size=None):
    frames = []
    for path in paths:
        img = pygame.image.load(path).convert_alpha()
        if size:
            img = pygame.transform.scale(img, size)
        frames.append(img)
    return frames

BROWN = (120, 80, 40)

BLUE = (70, 120, 255)
PURPLE = (160, 90, 220)

def make_frame(size, body_color, accent_color, leg_offset=0, eye_shift=0):
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    w, h = size

    # Body
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (8, 8, w - 16, h - 16), border_radius=10)

    # Eyes
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, WHITE, (w // 2 - 8 + eye_shift, 18), 4)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, WHITE, (w // 2 + 8 + eye_shift, 18), 4)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, BLACK, (w // 2 - 8 + eye_shift, 18), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, BLACK, (w // 2 + 8 + eye_shift, 18), 2)

    # Legs
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (12, h - 14, 8, 10 + leg_offset))
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (w - 20, h - 14, 8, 10 - leg_offset))

    return surf


def make_enemy_frame(size, color, eye_angry=False):
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    w, h = size
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, color, (4, 4, w - 8, h - 8), border_radius=8)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, WHITE, (w // 2 - 8, h // 2 - 4), 4)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, WHITE, (w // 2 + 8, h // 2 - 4), 4)
    if eye_angry:
        pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (w // 2 - 12, h // 2 - 10), (w // 2 - 4, h // 2 - 6), 2)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (w // 2 + 12, h // 2 - 10), (w // 2 + 4, h // 2 - 6), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, BLACK, (w // 2 - 8, h // 2 - 4), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, BLACK, (w // 2 + 8, h // 2 - 4), 2)
    return surf


# ----------------------------
# Animation
# ----------------------------
class Animation:
    def __init__(self, frames, frame_duration):
        self.frames = frames
        self.frame_duration = frame_duration
        self.timer = 0
        self.index = 0

    def update(self, dt):
        self.timer += dt
        if self.timer >= self.frame_duration:
            self.timer = 0
            self.index = (self.index + 1) % len(self.frames)

    def get_frame(self):
        return self.frames[self.index]


# ----------------------------
# Camera
# ----------------------------
class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.offset_x = 0
        self.offset_y = 0
        self.level_width = width
        self.level_height = height

    def update(self, target_rect):
        self.offset_x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.offset_y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        self.offset_x = max(0, min(self.offset_x, self.level_width - SCREEN_WIDTH))
        self.offset_y = max(0, min(self.offset_y, self.level_height - SCREEN_HEIGHT))

    def apply(self, rect):
        return pygame.Rect(rect.x - self.offset_x, rect.y - self.offset_y, rect.width, rect.height)

# Game Objects
# ----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h, color=BROWN):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)
        self.color = color

    def draw(self, surface, camera):
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, self.color, camera.apply(self.rect), border_radius=4)
        top = camera.apply(pygame.Rect(self.rect.x, self.rect.y, self.rect.w, 8))
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, GREEN, top, border_radius=4)


class Coin:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 20, 20)
        self.collected = False
        self.bob_time = 0

    def update(self, dt):
        self.bob_time += dt * 0.005

    def draw(self, surface, camera):
        if self.collected:
            return
        draw_rect = camera.apply(self.rect)
        bob = math.sin(self.bob_time) * 4
        center = (draw_rect.centerx, int(draw_rect.centery + bob))
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, center, 10)
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 245, 150), center, 5)


class Enemy:
    def __init__(self, x, y, patrol_distance=120):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 40, 40)
        self.start_x = x
        self.speed = 2
        self.direction = 1
        self.patrol_distance = patrol_distance

        frames = [
            make_enemy_frame((40, 40), RED, False),
            make_enemy_frame((40, 40), PURPLE, True),
        ]
        self.animation = Animation(frames, 200)

    def update(self, dt):
        self.animation.update(dt)
        self.rect.x += self.speed * self.direction

        if self.rect.x > self.start_x + self.patrol_distance:
            self.direction = -1
        elif self.rect.x < self.start_x - self.patrol_distance:
            self.direction = 1

    def draw(self, surface, camera):
        frame = self.animation.get_frame()
        if self.direction < 0:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)
        surface.blit(frame, camera.apply(self.rect))


class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 40, 56)
        self.vel_x = 0
        self.vel_y = 0
        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True
        self.score = 0
        self.spawn = (x, y)

        idle_frames = [
            make_frame((40, 56), BLUE, BLACK, 0, 0),
            make_frame((40, 56), (90, 140, 255), BLACK, 0, 1),
        ]
        run_frames = [
            make_frame((40, 56), BLUE, BLACK, 3, -1),
            make_frame((40, 56), (90, 140, 255), BLACK, -3, 1),
            make_frame((40, 56), BLUE, BLACK, 3, 0),
            make_frame((40, 56), (90, 140, 255), BLACK, -3, 0),
        ]
        jump_frames = [
            make_frame((40, 56), (50, 90, 220), BLACK, -4, 0),
        ]

        self.animations = {
            "idle": Animation(idle_frames, 300),
            "run": Animation(run_frames, 100),
            "jump": Animation(jump_frames, 100),
        }
        self.current_animation = "idle"

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel_x = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel_x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel_x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel_y = JUMP_STRENGTH
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel_y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel_y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel_y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal
        self.rect.x += self.vel_x
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel_x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel_y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel_y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel_y = 0

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.current_animation = "jump"
        elif self.vel_x != 0:
            self.current_animation = "run"
        else:
            self.current_animation = "idle"

        self.animations[self.current_animation].update(dt)

    def update(self, dt, platforms, coins, enemies):
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation(dt)

        for coin in coins:
            if not coin.collected and self.rect.colliderect(coin.rect):
                coin.collected = True
                self.score += 1

        for enemy in enemies:
            if self.rect.colliderect(enemy.rect):
                self.respawn()

        if self.rect.top > 1200:
            self.respawn()

    def respawn(self):
        self.rect.topleft = self.spawn
        self.vel_x = 0
        self.vel_y = 0

    def draw(self, surface, camera):
        frame = self.animations[self.current_animation].get_frame()
        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)
        surface.blit(frame, camera.apply(self.rect))

import pygame
import sys

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60

TILE_SIZE = 48
GRAVITY = 0.7
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
JUMP_VELOCITY = -14
MAX_FALL_SPEED = 16
BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)

# ----------------------------
# Level layout
# X = solid block
# P = player spawn
# ----------------------------
LEVEL_MAP = [
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "....................XXX.........................................",
    "..............................................XXX...............",
    "..............XXX...............................................",
    "...................................XXX..........................",
    "..........XXX...................................................",
    "............................XXX.................................",
    "....P...........................................................",
    "XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
]

# ----------------------------
# Helper functions
# ----------------------------
def make_surface(size, color, alpha=None):
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    if alpha is not None:
        surf.set_alpha(alpha)
    surf.fill(color)
    return surf

def create_player_frames():
    """
    Creates simple placeholder animation frames.
    Replace these with loaded sprite images if desired.
    """
    frames_idle = []
    frames_run = []
    frames_jump = []

    # Idle frames
    for i in range(4):
        surf = pygame.Surface((32, 44), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 50), (8, 4, 16, 36), border_radius=6)   # body
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 220, 180), (16, 10), 8)                   # head
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (70 + i * 10, 120, 255), (8, 16, 16, 18), border_radius=4)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (30, 30, 30), (10, 34, 4, 8))
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (30, 30, 30), (18, 34, 4, 8))
        frames_idle.append(surf)

    # Run frames
    for i in range(6):
        surf = pygame.Surface((32, 44), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 50), (8, 4, 16, 36), border_radius=6)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 220, 180), (16, 10), 8)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (255, 140, 60), (8, 16, 16, 18), border_radius=4)

        leg_offset = 4 if i % 2 == 0 else -4
        arm_offset = -3 if i % 2 == 0 else 3

        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (12, 34), (12 + leg_offset, 42), 3)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (20, 34), (20 - leg_offset, 42), 3)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (10, 22), (6 + arm_offset, 30), 3)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (22, 22), (26 - arm_offset, 30), 3)

        frames_run.append(surf)

    # Jump frames
    for i in range(2):
        surf = pygame.Surface((32, 44), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 50), (8, 4, 16, 36), border_radius=6)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 220, 180), (16, 10), 8)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (120, 255, 120), (8, 16, 16, 18), border_radius=4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (12, 34), (8, 40), 3)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (20, 34), (24, 40), 3)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (10, 22), (6, 18), 3)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (22, 22), (26, 18), 3)
        frames_jump.append(surf)

    return {
        "idle": frames_idle,
        "run": frames_run,
        "jump": frames_jump,
    }

# ----------------------------
# Classes
# ----------------------------
class Platform(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y, size):
        super().__init__()
        self.image = pygame.Surface((size, size))
        self.image.fill((100, 70, 40))
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, (120, 200, 90), (0, 0, size, 10))
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, (80, 50, 30), (0, 10, size, size - 10))
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

class Player(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__()
        self.animations = create_player_frames()
        self.state = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.15
        self.facing_right = True

        self.image = self.animations[self.state][self.frame_index]
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

        self.pos = pygame.Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False

    def handle_input(self):
        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        self.vel.x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True
        if (keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_UP] or keys[pygame.K_w]) and self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel.y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel.y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)

        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x

        # Vertical movement
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)

        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel.y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel.y = 0
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y

    def update_animation(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.state = "jump"
        elif self.vel.x != 0:
            self.state = "run"
        else:
            self.state = "idle"

        frames = self.animations[self.state]
        self.frame_index += self.animation_speed
        if self.frame_index >= len(frames):
            self.frame_index = 0

        frame = frames[int(self.frame_index)]
        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)
        self.image = frame

    def update(self, platforms):
        self.handle_input()
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation()

class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.offset = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.level_width = width
        self.level_height = height

    def follow(self, target_rect):
        self.offset.x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.offset.y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        self.offset.x = max(0, min(self.offset.x, self.level_width - SCREEN_WIDTH))
        self.offset.y = max(0, min(self.offset.y, self.level_height - SCREEN_HEIGHT))

# ----------------------------
# Level building
# ----------------------------
def build_level(level_map):
    platforms = pygame.sprite.Group()
    player = None

    for row_index, row in enumerate(level_map):
        for col_index, cell in enumerate(row):
            x = col_index * TILE_SIZE
            y = row_index * TILE_SIZE

            if cell == "X":
                platforms.add(Platform(x, y, TILE_SIZE))
            elif cell == "P":
                player = Player(x, y)

    level_width = len(level_map[0]) * TILE_SIZE
    level_height = len(level_map) * TILE_SIZE
    return platforms, player, level_width, level_height

# ----------------------------
# Drawing
# ----------------------------
def draw_background(screen, camera):
    screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # Parallax hills
    for i in range(6):
        hill_x = i * 300 - camera.offset.x * 0.3
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (100, 180, 100), (hill_x, 340, 320, 180))

    # Clouds
    for i in range(8):
        cloud_x = i * 220 - camera.offset.x * 0.15
        cloud_y = 60 + (i % 3) * 35
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (cloud_x, cloud_y, 80, 40))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (cloud_x + 20, cloud_y - 15, 70, 50))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (cloud_x + 45, cloud_y, 80, 40))

def draw_text(screen, text, x, y, font, color=(20, 20, 20)):
    img = font.render(text, True, color)
    screen.blit(img, (x, y))

# ----------------------------
# Main game
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("arial", 24)

    platforms, player, level_width, level_height = build_level(LEVEL_MAP)
    camera = Camera(level_width, level_height)

    if player is None:
        print("No player spawn 'P' found in LEVEL_MAP.")
        pygame.quit()
        sys.exit()

    while True:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS)

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                pygame.quit()
                sys.exit()

        player.update(platforms)
        camera.follow(player.rect)

        # Respawn if player falls off map
        if player.rect.top > level_height + 200:
            platforms, player, level_width, level_height = build_level(LEVEL_MAP)
            camera = Camera(level_width, level_height)

        # Draw
        draw_background(screen, camera)

        for platform in platforms:
            screen.blit(platform.image, platform.rect.topleft - camera.offset)

        screen.blit(player.image, player.rect.topleft - camera.offset)

        draw_text(screen, "Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: W/Up/Space", 20, 20, font)
        draw_text(screen, f"FPS: {int(clock.get_fps())}", 20, 50, font)

        pygame.display.flip()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        self.offset.x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.offset.y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        self.offset.x = max(0, min(self.offset.x, self.level_width - SCREEN_WIDTH))
        self.offset.y = max(0, min(self.offset.y, self.level_height - SCREEN_HEIGHT))

class Tile(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y, width, height, color=(100, 70, 40)):
        super().__init__()
        self.image = pygame.Surface((width, height))
        self.image.fill(color)
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, (80, 50, 20), self.image.get_rect(), 3)
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

class Coin(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__()
        self.base_y = y
        self.time = 0
        self.image = pygame.Surface((20, 20), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.circle(self.image, (255, 215, 0), (10, 10), 10)
        pygame.draw.circle(self.image, (255, 240, 100), (10, 10), 10, 3)
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(center=(x + TILE_SIZE // 2, y + TILE_SIZE // 2))

    def update(self):
        self.time += 0.1
        self.rect.y = self.base_y + int(math.sin(self.time) * 5)

class Enemy(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__()
        self.image = pygame.Surface((36, 36), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, (120, 40, 160), (0, 0, 36, 36), border_radius=8)
        pygame.draw.circle(self.image, (255, 255, 255), (12, 14), 4)
        pygame.draw.circle(self.image, (255, 255, 255), (24, 14), 4)
        pygame.draw.circle(self.image, (0, 0, 0), (12, 14), 2)
        pygame.draw.circle(self.image, (0, 0, 0), (24, 14), 2)
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))
        self.direction = 1
        self.speed = 2
        self.start_x = x
        self.range = 120

    def update(self, solids):
        self.rect.x += self.direction * self.speed

        collided = pygame.sprite.spritecollideany(self, solids)
        if collided:
            if self.direction > 0:
                self.rect.right = collided.rect.left
            else:
                self.rect.left = collided.rect.right
            self.direction *= -1

        if abs(self.rect.x - self.start_x) > self.range:
            self.direction *= -1

class Player(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__()

        sheet = create_dummy_sprite_sheet()
        frames = load_sprite_sheet(sheet, 32, 48)
        self.animations = {
            "idle": [pygame.transform.scale(frames[0], (40, 60))],
            "run": [pygame.transform.scale(f, (40, 60)) for f in frames],
            "jump": [pygame.transform.scale(frames[2], (40, 60))]
        }

        self.state = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.15
        self.facing_right = True

        self.image = self.animations["idle"][0]
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

        self.pos = pygame.Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.on_ground = False
        self.spawn = pygame.Vector2(x, y)
        self.score = 0
        self.health = 3

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel.x = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True
        if (keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_UP] or keys[pygame.K_w]) and self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_FORCE
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel.y > 16:
            self.vel.y = 16

    def move_and_collide(self, solids):
        # Horizontal
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)
        collisions = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(self, solids, False)
        for tile in collisions:
            if self.vel.x > 0:
                self.rect.right = tile.rect.left
            elif self.vel.x < 0:
                self.rect.left = tile.rect.right
            self.pos.x = self.rect.x

        # Vertical
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)
        self.on_ground = False
        collisions = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(self, solids, False)
        for tile in collisions:
            if self.vel.y > 0:
                self.rect.bottom = tile.rect.top
                self.on_ground = True
            elif self.vel.y < 0:
                self.rect.top = tile.rect.bottom
            self.vel.y = 0
            self.pos.y = self.rect.y

    def update_animation(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.state = "jump"
        elif self.vel.x != 0:
            self.state = "run"
        else:
            self.state = "idle"

        frames = self.animations[self.state]
        self.frame_index += self.animation_speed
        if self.frame_index >= len(frames):
            self.frame_index = 0

        frame = frames[int(self.frame_index)]
        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)
        self.image = frame

    def respawn(self):
        self.pos = self.spawn.copy()
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.rect.topleft = self.spawn
        self.health -= 1

    def update(self, solids):
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(solids)
        self.update_animation()

# -----------------------------
# Build level
# -----------------------------
all_sprites = pygame.sprite.Group()
solid_tiles = pygame.sprite.Group()
coins = pygame.sprite.Group()
enemies = pygame.sprite.Group()

player = None

for row_index, row in enumerate(level_map):
    for col_index, cell in enumerate(row):
        x = col_index * TILE_SIZE
        y = row_index * TILE_SIZE

        if cell == "#":
            tile = Tile(x, y, TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE, (110, 80, 50))
            solid_tiles.add(tile)
            all_sprites.add(tile)
        elif cell == "=":
            tile = Tile(x, y + TILE_SIZE // 2, TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE // 2, (90, 90, 90))
            solid_tiles.add(tile)
            all_sprites.add(tile)
        elif cell == "C":
            coin = Coin(x, y)
            coins.add(coin)
            all_sprites.add(coin)
        elif cell == "E":
            enemy = Enemy(x + 6, y + 12)
            enemies.add(enemy)
            all_sprites.add(enemy)
        elif cell == "P":
            player = Player(x, y)
            all_sprites.add(player)

if player is None:
    player = Player(100, 100)
    all_sprites.add(player)

level_width = len(level_map[0]) * TILE_SIZE
level_height = len(level_map) * TILE_SIZE
camera = Camera(level_width, level_height)

# -----------------------------
# Main loop
# -----------------------------
running = True
win = False

while running:
    dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0

    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    player.handle_input(keys)
    player.update(solid_tiles)

    for coin in coins:
        coin.update()

    for enemy in enemies:
        enemy.update(solid_tiles)

    # Coin collection
    collected = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(player, coins, True)
    if collected:
        player.score += len(collected)

    # Enemy collision
    if pygame.sprite.spritecollideany(player, enemies):
        player.respawn()
        if player.health <= 0:
            running = False

    # Fall off map
    if player.rect.top > level_height:
        player.respawn()
        if player.health <= 0:
            running = False

    if len(coins) == 0:
        win = True
        running = False

    camera.update(player.rect)

    # -----------------------------
    # Draw
    # -----------------------------
    screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # Parallax hills
    for i in range(6):
        hill_x = i * 300 - camera.offset.x * 0.3
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (100, 180, 100), (hill_x, 320, 320, 180))

    # Draw sprites with camera offset
    for sprite in all_sprites:
        draw_pos = sprite.rect.move(-camera.offset.x, -camera.offset.y)
        screen.blit(sprite.image, draw_pos)

    # HUD
    hud = font.render(f"Score: {player.score}   Health: {player.health}", True, (20, 20, 20))
    screen.blit(hud, (20, 20))

    pygame.display.flip()

# -----------------------------
# End screen
# -----------------------------
screen.fill((30, 30, 30))
if win:
    msg = font.render(f"You Win! Final Score: {player.score}", True, (255, 255, 255))
else:
    msg = font.render(f"Game Over! Final Score: {player.score}", True, (255, 255, 255))

screen.blit(msg, (SCREEN_WIDTH // 2 - msg.get_width() // 2, SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2))
pygame.display.flip()
pygame.time.wait(3000)

pygame.quit()
sys.exit()

import pygame
import sys

# -----------------------------
# Config
# -----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60

GRAVITY = 0.7
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
JUMP_STRENGTH = -14
MAX_FALL_SPEED = 18

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)
GROUND_COLOR = (80, 180, 80)
PLATFORM_COLOR = (110, 80, 50)

# -----------------------------
# Helper functions
# -----------------------------
def make_frame(size, body_color, accent_color, leg_offset=0):
    """Create a simple placeholder sprite frame."""
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    w, h = size

    # Head
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 220, 180), (w // 2, h // 4), h // 8)

    # Body
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (w // 2 - 10, h // 4 + 10, 20, 28))

    # Arms
    pygame.draw.line(surf, accent_color, (w // 2 - 10, h // 4 + 20), (w // 2 - 20, h // 4 + 30), 4)
    pygame.draw.line(surf, accent_color, (w // 2 + 10, h // 4 + 20), (w // 2 + 20, h // 4 + 30), 4)

    # Legs
    pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w // 2 - 5, h // 4 + 38), (w // 2 - 8 - leg_offset, h - 8), 4)
    pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w // 2 + 5, h // 4 + 38), (w // 2 + 8 + leg_offset, h - 8), 4)

    return surf

# -----------------------------
# Platform class
# -----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        draw_rect = self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, PLATFORM_COLOR, draw_rect)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (70, 50, 30), draw_rect, 3)

# -----------------------------
# Player class
# -----------------------------
class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 40, 64)
        self.vel_x = 0
        self.vel_y = 0
        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = {
            "idle": [make_frame((40, 64), (220, 60, 60), (255, 255, 255), 0)],
            "run": [
                make_frame((40, 64), (220, 60, 60), (255, 255, 255), -4),
                make_frame((40, 64), (220, 60, 60), (255, 255, 255), 4),
            ],
            "jump": [make_frame((40, 64), (220, 60, 60), (255, 255, 255), 1)],
            "fall": [make_frame((40, 64), (220, 60, 60), (255, 255, 255), -1)],
        }

        self.current_animation = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.15

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel_x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel_x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel_x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel_y = JUMP_STRENGTH
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel_y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel_y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel_y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += self.vel_x
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel_x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += self.vel_y
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel_y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel_y = 0

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            if self.vel_y < 0:
                self.current_animation = "jump"
            else:
                self.current_animation = "fall"
        else:
            if self.vel_x != 0:
                self.current_animation = "run"
            else:
                self.current_animation = "idle"

        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        self.animation_timer += dt

        if len(frames) > 1 and self.animation_timer >= self.animation_speed:
            self.animation_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)
        elif len(frames) == 1:
            self.frame_index = 0

    def update(self, platforms, dt):
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        image = frames[self.frame_index]

        if not self.facing_right:
            image = pygame.transform.flip(image, True, False)

        surface.blit(image, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y))

# -----------------------------
# Level setup
# -----------------------------
def create_level():
    platforms = [
        Platform(-200, 500, 2000, 80),   # ground
        Platform(200, 420, 140, 20),
        Platform(420, 360, 140, 20),
        Platform(650, 300, 140, 20),
        Platform(900, 380, 180, 20),
        Platform(1180, 320, 160, 20),
        Platform(1450, 260, 180, 20),
    ]
    return platforms

# -----------------------------
# Main game
# -----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    player = Player(100, 300)
    platforms = create_level()

    camera_x = 0
    camera_y = 0

    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 28)

    while True:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0

        # Events
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                pygame.quit()
                sys.exit()
            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    player.jump()

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.handle_input(keys)
        player.update(platforms, dt)

        # Camera follow
        camera_x = player.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        camera_y = player.rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        # Clamp camera
        if camera_x < 0:
            camera_x = 0
        if camera_y < 0:
            camera_y = 0

        # Draw
        screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

        # Simple clouds
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (100, 80, 120, 50))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (300, 120, 140, 55))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (700, 90, 130, 50))

        for platform in platforms:
            platform.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

        player.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

        info = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: W/Up/Space", True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(info, (20, 20))

        pygame.display.flip()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Helper functions

def make_frame(size, body_color, accent_color=None, eye_color=(0, 0, 0), leg_offset=0):
    """

    This avoids external image files while still demonstrating sprite animation.
    """
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)

    pygame.draw.circle(surf, body_color, (w // 2, 12), 10)

    # Eyes
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, eye_color, (w // 2 - 4, 10), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, eye_color, (w // 2 + 4, 10), 2)

    # Accent
    if accent_color:
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (10, h // 2, w - 20, 8), border_radius=4)

    pygame.draw.line(surf, (40, 40, 40), (w - 16, h - 8), (w - 16, h - 2 + leg_offset), 4)

    return surf

    return [pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False) for frame in frames]

# Platform class

            PLATFORM_COLOR if self.rect.y < 450 else GROUND_COLOR,
            pygame.Rect(self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y, self.rect.w, self.rect.h),
            border_radius=6
        )


# -----------------------------
# Player class
# -----------------------------
class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 40, 56)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        # Animation setup
        self.animations = self.create_animations()
        self.current_animation = "idle"
        self.animation_index = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.12

    def create_animations(self):
        idle = [
            make_frame((40, 56), (255, 180, 60), (220, 80, 80), leg_offset=0),
            make_frame((40, 56), (255, 180, 60), (220, 80, 80), leg_offset=1),
        ]

            make_frame((40, 56), (255, 180, 60), (80, 160, 255), leg_offset=-4),

            make_frame((40, 56), (255, 180, 60), (80, 160, 255), leg_offset=4),
            make_frame((40, 56), (255, 180, 60), (80, 160, 255), leg_offset=0),
        ]

        jump = [
            make_frame((40, 56), (255, 180, 60), (180, 80, 220), leg_offset=-2),
        ]

        return {
            "idle_right": idle,
            "run_right": run,
            "jump_right": jump,
            "idle_left": flip_frames(idle),
            "run_left": flip_frames(run),
            "jump_left": flip_frames(jump),
        }

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel.x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False

        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

        if (keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_UP] or keys[pygame.K_w]) and self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel.y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel.y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += int(self.vel.x)
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel.y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel.y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel.y = 0

    def update_animation(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            base = "jump"
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 0:
            base = "run"
        else:
            base = "idle"

        direction = "right" if self.facing_right else "left"
        animation_name = f"{base}_{direction}"

        if animation_name != self.current_animation:
            self.current_animation = animation_name
            self.animation_index = 0
            self.animation_timer = 0

        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        self.animation_timer += self.animation_speed
        if self.animation_timer >= 1:
            self.animation_timer = 0
            self.animation_index = (self.animation_index + 1) % len(frames)

    def update(self, keys, platforms):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation()

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x):
        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        image = frames[self.animation_index]
        surface.blit(image, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y))


# -----------------------------
# Level setup
# -----------------------------
def create_level():
    platforms = []

    # Ground
    platforms.append(Platform(-400, 480, 2400, 80))

    # Floating platforms
    platforms.append(Platform(180, 390, 140, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(380, 320, 140, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(600, 260, 140, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(840, 340, 140, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(1080, 280, 180, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(1360, 220, 160, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(1620, 300, 200, 20))

    return platforms


# -----------------------------
# Main game loop
# -----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer with Physics and Animation")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 28)

    player = Player(100, 200)
    platforms = create_level()

    running = True
    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS)

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(keys, platforms)

        # Respawn if player falls off map
        if player.rect.top > SCREEN_HEIGHT + 200:
            player.rect.topleft = (100, 200)
            player.vel.xy = (0, 0)

        # Camera follows player
        camera_x = player.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        camera_x = max(0, camera_x)

        # Draw
        screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

        # Simple clouds / background decoration
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (100, 80, 120, 50))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (140, 60, 120, 60))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (500, 100, 140, 55))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (540, 80, 120, 60))

        for platform in platforms:
            platform.draw(screen, camera_x)

        player.draw(screen, camera_x)

        instructions = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right   Jump: W/Up/Space", True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(instructions, (20, 20))

        fps_text = font.render(f"FPS: {int(clock.get_fps())}", True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(fps_text, (20, 50))

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import pygame
import sys

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60

TILE_SIZE = 48
GRAVITY = 0.7
PLAYER_ACCEL = 0.8
PLAYER_FRICTION = 0.82
PLAYER_MAX_SPEED = 6
JUMP_VELOCITY = -14

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
BLACK = (20, 20, 20)
GREEN = (80, 180, 80)
BROWN = (120, 80, 40)
RED = (220, 80, 80)
BLUE = (80, 120, 220)
YELLOW = (240, 220, 80)

# ----------------------------
# Level Layout
# X = solid block
# ----------------------------
LEVEL_MAP = [
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "......................XXX.......................................",
    "................................................................",
    "..............XXX...............................................",
    "................................................................",
    ".................................XXXX...........................",
    "................................................................",
    "..........XXX...................................................",
    "................................................................",
    ".........................XXX....................................",
    "................................................................",
    "XXXX..............XXXX....................XXXX..................",
    "................................................................",
    "............................................................XXXX",
    "................................................................",
    "XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
]

# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
def make_frame(size, body_color, accent_color, pose="idle1"):
    """Create a simple placeholder sprite frame."""
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    w, h = size

    # body
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (10, 12, w - 20, h - 18), border_radius=8)

    # head
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, accent_color, (w // 2, 12), 10)

    # legs / pose variations
    if pose == "idle1":
        pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (w//2 - 8, h - 8), (w//2 - 8, h - 2), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (w//2 + 8, h - 8), (w//2 + 8, h - 2), 4)
    elif pose == "idle2":
        pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (w//2 - 6, h - 8), (w//2 - 10, h - 2), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (w//2 + 6, h - 8), (w//2 + 10, h - 2), 4)
    elif pose == "run1":
        pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (w//2 - 6, h - 8), (w//2 - 14, h - 1), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (w//2 + 6, h - 8), (w//2 + 14, h - 1), 4)
    elif pose == "run2":
        pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (w//2 - 6, h - 8), (w//2 - 1, h - 1), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (w//2 + 6, h - 8), (w//2 + 1, h - 1), 4)
    elif pose == "jump":
        pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (w//2 - 6, h - 8), (w//2 - 12, h - 4), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (w//2 + 6, h - 8), (w//2 + 12, h - 4), 4)

    # eyes
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, BLACK, (w//2 - 4, 10), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, BLACK, (w//2 + 4, 10), 2)

    return surf


def clamp(value, min_value, max_value):
    return max(min_value, min(value, max_value))


# ----------------------------
# Tile / Platform
# ----------------------------
class Tile(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y, size):
        super().__init__()
        self.image = pygame.Surface((size, size))
        self.image.fill(BROWN)
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, GREEN, (0, 0, size, 10))
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, BLACK, self.image.get_rect(), 2)
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))


# ----------------------------
# Player
# ----------------------------
class Player(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__()

        self.animations = {
            "idle": [
                make_frame((36, 52), BLUE, YELLOW, "idle1"),
                make_frame((36, 52), BLUE, YELLOW, "idle2"),
            ],
            "run": [
                make_frame((36, 52), RED, YELLOW, "run1"),
                make_frame((36, 52), RED, YELLOW, "run2"),
            ],
            "jump": [
                make_frame((36, 52), BLUE, YELLOW, "jump"),
            ],
        }

        self.state = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.15

        self.image = self.animations[self.state][self.frame_index]
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

        self.pos = pygame.Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x -= PLAYER_ACCEL
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x += PLAYER_ACCEL
            self.facing_right = True

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_physics(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        self.vel.x *= PLAYER_FRICTION
        self.vel.x = clamp(self.vel.x, -PLAYER_MAX_SPEED, PLAYER_MAX_SPEED)

    def horizontal_collisions(self, tiles):
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)
        for tile in tiles:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = tile.rect.left
                    self.pos.x = self.rect.x
                    self.vel.x = 0
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = tile.rect.right
                    self.pos.x = self.rect.x
                    self.vel.x = 0

    def vertical_collisions(self, tiles):
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for tile in tiles:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = tile.rect.top
                    self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                    self.vel.y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = tile.rect.bottom
                    self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                    self.vel.y = 0

    def update_state(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.state = "jump"
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 0.8:
            self.state = "run"
        else:
            self.state = "idle"

    def animate(self, dt):
        frames = self.animations[self.state]

        if len(frames) > 1:
            self.animation_timer += self.animation_speed * dt
            if self.animation_timer >= 1:
                self.animation_timer = 0
                self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)
        else:
            self.frame_index = 0

        self.image = frames[self.frame_index]

        if not self.facing_right:
            self.image = pygame.transform.flip(self.image, True, False)

    def update(self, tiles, dt):
        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_physics()

        # Horizontal movement
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x
        self.horizontal_collisions(tiles)

        # Vertical movement
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y
        self.vertical_collisions(tiles)

        self.update_state()
        self.animate(dt)


# ----------------------------
# Camera
# ----------------------------
class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.offset = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.level_width = width
        self.level_height = height

    def follow(self, target_rect):
        self.offset.x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.offset.y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        self.offset.x = clamp(self.offset.x, 0, max(0, self.level_width - SCREEN_WIDTH))
        self.offset.y = clamp(self.offset.y, 0, max(0, self.level_height - SCREEN_HEIGHT))

    def apply(self, rect):
        return rect.move(-self.offset.x, -self.offset.y)


# ----------------------------
# Build level
# ----------------------------
def build_level(level_map):
    tiles = pygame.sprite.Group()
    for row_index, row in enumerate(level_map):
        for col_index, cell in enumerate(row):
            if cell == "X":
                x = col_index * TILE_SIZE
                y = row_index * TILE_SIZE
                tiles.add(Tile(x, y, TILE_SIZE))
    return tiles


# ----------------------------
# Draw background
# ----------------------------
def draw_background(screen, camera):
    screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # simple parallax hills
    hill_color_1 = (110, 190, 110)
    hill_color_2 = (90, 170, 90)

    for i in range(6):
        x = i * 300 - (camera.offset.x * 0.3) % 300
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, hill_color_1, (x, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 180, 320, 140))

    for i in range(5):
        x = i * 380 - (camera.offset.x * 0.5) % 380
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, hill_color_2, (x, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 130, 400, 120))


# ----------------------------
# Main
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer with Physics and Animation")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 28)

    tiles = build_level(LEVEL_MAP)

    level_width = len(LEVEL_MAP[0]) * TILE_SIZE
    level_height = len(LEVEL_MAP) * TILE_SIZE

    player = Player(100, 100)
    camera = Camera(level_width, level_height)

    running = True
    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 16.67  # normalized around 60 FPS

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False

            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    player.jump()

        player.update(tiles, dt)
        camera.follow(player.rect)

        draw_background(screen, camera)

        # Draw tiles
        for tile in tiles:
            screen.blit(tile.image, camera.apply(tile.rect))

        # Draw player
        screen.blit(player.image, camera.apply(player.rect))

        # UI
        info = font.render(
            f"State: {player.state}  Vel: ({player.vel.x:.2f}, {player.vel.y:.2f})",
            True,
            BLACK
        )
        screen.blit(info, (20, 20))

        controls = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: Space/W/Up", True, BLACK)
        screen.blit(controls, (20, 50))

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import pygame
import sys

# ----------------------------
# Configuration
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60

GRAVITY = 0.6
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
JUMP_STRENGTH = -13
MAX_FALL_SPEED = 14

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)
GROUND_COLOR = (80, 180, 90)
PLATFORM_COLOR = (100, 100, 120)

# ----------------------------
# Platform class
# ----------------------------
class Platform(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h):
        super().__init__()
        self.image = pygame.Surface((w, h))
        self.image.fill(PLATFORM_COLOR)
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

# ----------------------------
# Player class
# ----------------------------
class Player(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__()

        self.animations = self.create_animations()
        self.state = "idle"
        self.facing_right = True
        self.animation_index = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.15

        self.image = self.animations[self.state][0]
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

        self.vel_x = 0
        self.vel_y = 0
        self.on_ground = False

    def create_animations(self):
        # Create simple colored rectangle frames as placeholder sprites
        # Replace these with loaded images if desired
        idle_frames = []
        run_frames = []
        jump_frames = []

        # Idle frames
        for i in range(4):
            surf = pygame.Surface((40, 60), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            color = (255, 220 - i * 10, 80)
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, color, (0, 0, 40, 60), border_radius=8)
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 40), (10, 10, 20, 20))
            idle_frames.append(surf)

        # Run frames
        for i in range(6):
            surf = pygame.Surface((40, 60), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            color = (255, 160 + i * 10, 60)
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, color, (0, 0, 40, 60), border_radius=8)
            leg_offset = 5 if i % 2 == 0 else 15
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, (30, 30, 30), (8, 45, 8, 12))
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, (30, 30, 30), (leg_offset, 45, 8, 12))
            run_frames.append(surf)

        # Jump frames
        for i in range(2):
            surf = pygame.Surface((40, 60), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            color = (255, 100, 100 + i * 50)
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, color, (0, 0, 40, 60), border_radius=8)
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, (20, 20, 20), (12, 8, 16, 16))
            jump_frames.append(surf)

        return {
            "idle": idle_frames,
            "run": run_frames,
            "jump": jump_frames,
        }

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel_x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel_x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False

        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel_x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

        if (keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_UP] or keys[pygame.K_w]) and self.on_ground:
            self.vel_y = JUMP_STRENGTH
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel_y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel_y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel_y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += self.vel_x
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel_x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += self.vel_y
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel_y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel_y = 0

    def update_state(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.state = "jump"
        elif self.vel_x != 0:
            self.state = "run"
        else:
            self.state = "idle"

    def animate(self):
        frames = self.animations[self.state]
        self.animation_index += self.animation_speed
        if self.animation_index >= len(frames):
            self.animation_index = 0

        frame = frames[int(self.animation_index)]
        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)
        self.image = frame

    def update(self, platforms, keys):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_state()
        self.animate()

# ----------------------------
# Camera
# ----------------------------
class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.offset = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.width = width
        self.height = height

    def follow(self, target):
        self.offset.x = target.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.offset.y = target.rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        # Clamp camera to world bounds
        self.offset.x = max(0, min(self.offset.x, self.width - SCREEN_WIDTH))
        self.offset.y = max(0, min(self.offset.y, self.height - SCREEN_HEIGHT))

# ----------------------------
# Level creation
# ----------------------------
def create_level():
    platforms = pygame.sprite.Group()

    level_data = [
        (0, 500, 1400, 40),
        (200, 420, 140, 20),
        (420, 360, 140, 20),
        (650, 300, 140, 20),
        (900, 380, 180, 20),
        (1150, 260, 160, 20),
        (1350, 450, 200, 20),
    ]

    for x, y, w, h in level_data:
        platforms.add(Platform(x, y, w, h))

    return platforms

# ----------------------------
# Drawing helpers
# ----------------------------
def draw_background(screen, camera):
    screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # Simple parallax hills
    for i in range(6):
        hill_x = i * 300 - camera.offset.x * 0.3
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (100, 190, 120), (hill_x, 380, 320, 180))

def draw_world(screen, player, platforms, camera):
    draw_background(screen, camera)

    for platform in platforms:
        screen.blit(platform.image, (platform.rect.x - camera.offset.x, platform.rect.y - camera.offset.y))

    screen.blit(player.image, (player.rect.x - camera.offset.x, player.rect.y - camera.offset.y))

# ----------------------------
# Main game
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    world_width = 1600
    world_height = 700

    platforms = create_level()
    player = Player(100, 300)
    camera = Camera(world_width, world_height)

    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 28)

    while True:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS)

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                pygame.quit()
                sys.exit()

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(platforms, keys)
        camera.follow(player)

        # Respawn if player falls off map
        if player.rect.top > world_height:
            player.rect.topleft = (100, 300)
            player.vel_x = 0
            player.vel_y = 0

        draw_world(screen, player, platforms, camera)

        info = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: Space/W/Up", True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(info, (20, 20))

        pygame.display.flip()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

---

## Features included

### Physics
- Gravity is applied every frame
- Jumping sets upward velocity
- Falling speed is capped
- Collision is resolved separately on X and Y axes

### Animation
- `idle`, `run`, and `jump` states
- Frame cycling based on `animation_speed`
- Sprite flips when moving left

### Camera
- Follows the player
- Clamped to world bounds

]

import pygame
import sys

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60

GRAVITY = 0.5
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
JUMP_VELOCITY = -12
MAX_FALL_SPEED = 14

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)
GROUND_COLOR = (80, 180, 80)
PLATFORM_COLOR = (110, 90, 70)

# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
def make_frame(size, body_color, accent_color, leg_offset=0, arm_offset=0):
    """Create a simple placeholder character frame."""
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    w, h = size

    # Head
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 220, 180), (w // 2, h // 4), 10)

    # Body
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (w // 2 - 10, h // 4 + 10, 20, 28), border_radius=4)

    # Arms
    pygame.draw.line(
        surf, accent_color,
        (w // 2 - 10, h // 4 + 18),
        (w // 2 - 18, h // 4 + 24 + arm_offset), 4
    )
    pygame.draw.line(
        surf, accent_color,
        (w // 2 + 10, h // 4 + 18),
        (w // 2 + 18, h // 4 + 24 - arm_offset), 4
    )

    # Legs
    pygame.draw.line(
        surf, (40, 40, 40),
        (w // 2 - 5, h // 4 + 38),
        (w // 2 - 10, h - 8 + leg_offset), 4
    )
    pygame.draw.line(
        surf, (40, 40, 40),
        (w // 2 + 5, h // 4 + 38),
        (w // 2 + 10, h - 8 - leg_offset), 4
    )

    return surf


def generate_animations():
    """Generate placeholder animation frames."""
    size = (40, 64)

    idle = [
        make_frame(size, (220, 60, 60), (255, 240, 0), 0, 0),
        make_frame(size, (220, 60, 60), (255, 240, 0), 1, 1),
    ]

    run = [
        make_frame(size, (60, 120, 240), (255, 255, 255), -4, 3),
        make_frame(size, (60, 120, 240), (255, 255, 255), 4, -3),
        make_frame(size, (60, 120, 240), (255, 255, 255), -2, 2),
        make_frame(size, (60, 120, 240), (255, 255, 255), 2, -2),
    ]

    jump = [
        make_frame(size, (140, 60, 220), (255, 255, 255), 0, -4),
    ]

    fall = [
        make_frame(size, (240, 140, 60), (255, 255, 255), 3, 4),
    ]

    return {
        "idle": idle,
        "run": run,
        "jump": jump,
        "fall": fall,
    }


# ----------------------------
# Platform
# ----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)

    def draw(self, screen):
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, PLATFORM_COLOR, self.rect, border_radius=6)
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (70, 55, 40), self.rect, 2, border_radius=6)


# ----------------------------
# Player
# ----------------------------
class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.animations = generate_animations()
        self.state = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.12

        self.image = self.animations["idle"][0]
        self.facing_right = True

        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))
        self.pos = pygame.Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel.x = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel.y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel.y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)

        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x

        # Vertical movement
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)

        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                self.vel.y = 0
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            if self.vel.y < 0:
                self.state = "jump"
            else:
                self.state = "fall"
        else:
            if abs(self.vel.x) > 0:
                self.state = "run"
            else:
                self.state = "idle"

        frames = self.animations[self.state]

        if len(frames) == 1:
            self.frame_index = 0
        else:
            self.animation_timer += dt
            if self.animation_timer >= self.animation_speed:
                self.animation_timer = 0
                self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        self.image = frames[self.frame_index]

    def update(self, dt, platforms, keys):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, screen):
        img = self.image
        if not self.facing_right:
            img = pygame.transform.flip(img, True, False)
        screen.blit(img, self.rect.topleft)


# ----------------------------
# Level setup
# ----------------------------
def create_level():
    platforms = [
        Platform(0, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 40, SCREEN_WIDTH, 40),
        Platform(150, 420, 180, 20),
        Platform(420, 340, 160, 20),
        Platform(680, 260, 180, 20),
        Platform(300, 220, 120, 20),
    ]
    return platforms


def draw_background(screen):
    screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # Simple clouds
    pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (100, 80, 100, 40))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (140, 65, 100, 50))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (180, 80, 100, 40))

    pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (650, 100, 90, 35))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (690, 85, 90, 45))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (730, 100, 90, 35))

    # Ground strip
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, GROUND_COLOR, (0, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 40, SCREEN_WIDTH, 40))


# ----------------------------
# Main game loop
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer Prototype")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    player = Player(100, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 120)
    platforms = create_level()

    running = True
    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False

            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    player.jump()

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(dt, platforms, keys)

        draw_background(screen)

        for platform in platforms:
            platform.draw(screen)

        player.draw(screen)

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
