## `platformer.py`

```python
import pygame
from pygame.math import Vector2

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60
TILE_SIZE = 48

GRAVITY = 1800
PLAYER_ACCEL = 2200
PLAYER_FRICTION = 1800
PLAYER_MAX_SPEED = 320
PLAYER_JUMP_SPEED = -700

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)

LEVEL_MAP = [
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "....................###.........................................",
    "................................................................",
    "..............###...............................................",
    "................................................................",
    "....................................####........................",
    "................................................................",
    "..........###...................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "############################....############################....",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "################################################################",
]

# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
def clamp(value, min_value, max_value):
    return max(min_value, min(value, max_value))


def make_frame(size, body_color, accent_color, eye_offset_x=0):
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    w, h = size

    # body
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (8, 8, w - 16, h - 8), border_radius=8)
    # feet
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (10, h - 10, 10, 8), border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (w - 20, h - 10, 10, 8), border_radius=3)
    # eyes
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 255, 255), (w // 2 - 8 + eye_offset_x, 18), 4)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 255, 255), (w // 2 + 8 + eye_offset_x, 18), 4)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (0, 0, 0), (w // 2 - 8 + eye_offset_x, 19), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (0, 0, 0), (w // 2 + 8 + eye_offset_x, 19), 2)
    return surf


# ----------------------------
# Animation
# ----------------------------
class Animation:
    def __init__(self, frames, frame_duration, loop=True):
        self.frames = frames
        self.frame_duration = frame_duration
        self.loop = loop
        self.time = 0.0
        self.finished = False

    def reset(self):
        self.time = 0.0
        self.finished = False

    def update(self, dt):
        if self.finished:
            return
        self.time += dt
        if not self.loop:
            total = len(self.frames) * self.frame_duration
            if self.time >= total:
                self.time = total - 1e-6
                self.finished = True

    def get_current_frame(self):
        index = int(self.time / self.frame_duration)
        if self.loop:
            index %= len(self.frames)
        else:
            index = min(index, len(self.frames) - 1)
        return self.frames[index]


# ----------------------------
# Tiles / Level
# ----------------------------
class Tile(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y, size):
        super().__init__()
        self.image = pygame.Surface((size, size))
        self.image.fill((90, 70, 50))
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, (120, 100, 70), (0, 0, size, 10))
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, (60, 45, 30), (0, 0, size, size), 2)
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))


class Level:
    def __init__(self, level_map):
        self.tiles = pygame.sprite.Group()
        self.width = len(level_map[0]) * TILE_SIZE
        self.height = len(level_map) * TILE_SIZE

        for row_idx, row in enumerate(level_map):
            for col_idx, cell in enumerate(row):
                if cell == "#":
                    tile = Tile(col_idx * TILE_SIZE, row_idx * TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE)
                    self.tiles.add(tile)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        for tile in self.tiles:
            surface.blit(tile.image, (tile.rect.x - camera_x, tile.rect.y - camera_y))


# ----------------------------
# Player
# ----------------------------
class Player(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__()

        self.size = (36, 52)
        self.animations = self._build_animations()
        self.current_animation_name = "idle"
        self.current_animation = self.animations[self.current_animation_name]

        self.image = self.current_animation.get_current_frame()
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

        self.pos = Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

    def _build_animations(self):
        idle_frames = [
            make_frame(self.size, (255, 180, 60), (180, 80, 40), 0),
            make_frame(self.size, (250, 170, 55), (180, 80, 40), 1),
        ]

        run_frames = [
            make_frame(self.size, (255, 180, 60), (200, 90, 50), -1),
            make_frame(self.size, (255, 190, 70), (200, 90, 50), 1),
            make_frame(self.size, (245, 175, 55), (200, 90, 50), -1),
            make_frame(self.size, (255, 185, 65), (200, 90, 50), 1),
        ]

        jump_frames = [
            make_frame(self.size, (255, 160, 80), (220, 100, 60), 0)
        ]

        return {
            "idle": Animation(idle_frames, 0.4, loop=True),
            "run": Animation(run_frames, 0.1, loop=True),
            "jump": Animation(jump_frames, 0.1, loop=True),
        }

    def set_animation(self, name):
        if self.current_animation_name != name:
            self.current_animation_name = name
            self.current_animation = self.animations[name]
            self.current_animation.reset()

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        move = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            move -= 1
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            move += 1

        if move != 0:
            self.vel.x += move * PLAYER_ACCEL / FPS
            self.facing_right = move > 0
        else:
            if self.vel.x > 0:
                self.vel.x -= PLAYER_FRICTION / FPS
                if self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.vel.x = 0
            elif self.vel.x < 0:
                self.vel.x += PLAYER_FRICTION / FPS
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.vel.x = 0

        self.vel.x = clamp(self.vel.x, -PLAYER_MAX_SPEED, PLAYER_MAX_SPEED)

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = PLAYER_JUMP_SPEED
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self, dt):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY * dt

    def move_and_collide(self, level, dt):
        # Horizontal
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x * dt
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)

        for tile in level.tiles:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = tile.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = tile.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x
                self.vel.x = 0

        # Vertical
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y * dt
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)

        self.on_ground = False
        for tile in level.tiles:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = tile.rect.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = tile.rect.bottom
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                self.vel.y = 0

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.set_animation("jump")
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 20:
            self.set_animation("run")
        else:
            self.set_animation("idle")

        self.current_animation.update(dt)
        frame = self.current_animation.get_current_frame()

        if self.facing_right:
            self.image = frame
        else:
            self.image = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

    def update(self, level, dt, keys):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity(dt)
        self.move_and_collide(level, dt)
        self.update_animation(dt)


# ----------------------------
# Camera
# ----------------------------
class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.x = 0
        self.y = 0
        self.width = width
        self.height = height

    def update(self, target_rect):
        self.x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        self.x = clamp(self.x, 0, max(0, self.width - SCREEN_WIDTH))
        self.y = clamp(self.y, 0, max(0, self.height - SCREEN_HEIGHT))


# ----------------------------
# Main
# ----------------------------
def draw_background(surface, camera_x, camera_y):
    surface.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # simple parallax hills
    for i in range(6):
        hill_x = i * 300 - (camera_x * 0.3) % 300
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (110, 190, 110), (hill_x, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 140, 260, 120))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (90, 170, 90), (hill_x + 80, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 120, 260, 100))


def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("Initial 2D Platformer")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 24)

    level = Level(LEVEL_MAP)
    player = Player(100, 100)
    camera = Camera(level.width, level.height)

    running = True
    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    player.jump()

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(level, dt, keys)
        camera.update(player.rect)

        draw_background(screen, camera.x, camera.y)
        level.draw(screen, camera.x, camera.y)
        screen.blit(player.image, (player.rect.x - camera.x, player.rect.y - camera.y))

        debug_text = f"pos=({player.rect.x},{player.rect.y}) vel=({player.vel.x:.1f},{player.vel.y:.1f}) ground={player.on_ground}"
```

```python
import pygame
from pygame.math import Vector2

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60
TITLE = "2D Platformer - Initial Implementation"

GRAVITY = 1800
PLAYER_SPEED = 280
JUMP_VELOCITY = -700
AIR_CONTROL = 0.85
GROUND_FRICTION = 0.82
MAX_FALL_SPEED = 1200

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)
GROUND_COLOR = (70, 70, 70)
PLATFORM_COLOR = (100, 100, 120)

# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
def clamp(value, min_value, max_value):
    return max(min_value, min(value, max_value))


def make_frame(size, body_color, accent_color, eye_offset_x=0, leg_offset=0):
    """
    Creates a simple placeholder sprite frame.
    """
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    w, h = size

    # Body
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (8, 8, w - 16, h - 16), border_radius=10)

    # Face / eye
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 255, 255), (w // 2 + eye_offset_x, h // 3), 5)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (0, 0, 0), (w // 2 + eye_offset_x, h // 3), 2)

    # Accent stripe
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (10, h // 2, w - 20, 8), border_radius=4)

    # Legs
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 40), (14, h - 14, 10, 10 + leg_offset), border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 40), (w - 24, h - 14, 10, 10 - leg_offset), border_radius=3)

    return surf


# ----------------------------
# Animation
# ----------------------------
class Animation:
    def __init__(self, frames, frame_duration, loop=True):
        self.frames = frames
        self.frame_duration = frame_duration
        self.loop = loop
        self.time = 0.0
        self.index = 0
        self.finished = False

    def reset(self):
        self.time = 0.0
        self.index = 0
        self.finished = False

    def update(self, dt):
        if self.finished or len(self.frames) <= 1:
            return

        self.time += dt
        while self.time >= self.frame_duration:
            self.time -= self.frame_duration
            self.index += 1

            if self.index >= len(self.frames):
                if self.loop:
                    self.index = 0
                else:
                    self.index = len(self.frames) - 1
                    self.finished = True

    def get_frame(self):
        return self.frames[self.index]


# ----------------------------
# Level geometry
# ----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x=0, camera_y=0):
        draw_rect = self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, PLATFORM_COLOR, draw_rect, border_radius=8)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (60, 60, 80), draw_rect, 3, border_radius=8)


# ----------------------------
# Player
# ----------------------------
class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 48, 64)
        self.pos = Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = self._build_animations()
        self.current_animation = "idle"

    def _build_animations(self):
        size = (self.rect.width, self.rect.height)

        idle_frames = [
            make_frame(size, (255, 180, 70), (255, 120, 50), eye_offset_x=0, leg_offset=0),
            make_frame(size, (255, 185, 75), (255, 120, 50), eye_offset_x=1, leg_offset=1),
        ]

        run_frames = [
            make_frame(size, (80, 220, 120), (40, 160, 80), eye_offset_x=1, leg_offset=4),
            make_frame(size, (90, 230, 130), (40, 160, 80), eye_offset_x=2, leg_offset=-3),
            make_frame(size, (80, 220, 120), (40, 160, 80), eye_offset_x=1, leg_offset=5),
            make_frame(size, (90, 230, 130), (40, 160, 80), eye_offset_x=2, leg_offset=-2),
        ]

        jump_frames = [
            make_frame(size, (120, 170, 255), (70, 110, 220), eye_offset_x=0, leg_offset=-4)
        ]

        return {
            "idle": Animation(idle_frames, 0.4, loop=True),
            "run": Animation(run_frames, 0.1, loop=True),
            "jump": Animation(jump_frames, 0.1, loop=True),
        }

    def set_animation(self, name):
        if self.current_animation != name:
            self.current_animation = name
            self.animations[name].reset()

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        move = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            move -= 1
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            move += 1

        if move != 0:
            self.facing_right = move > 0

        speed = PLAYER_SPEED if self.on_ground else PLAYER_SPEED * AIR_CONTROL
        self.vel.x = move * speed

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_physics(self, dt, platforms):
        # Gravity
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY * dt
        self.vel.y = min(self.vel.y, MAX_FALL_SPEED)

        # Horizontal movement
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x * dt
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)
        self._resolve_collisions(platforms, axis="x")

        # Vertical movement
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y * dt
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)
        self.on_ground = False
        self._resolve_collisions(platforms, axis="y")

        # Friction on ground when no input
        # (simple damping if grounded)
        if self.on_ground and abs(self.vel.x) < 1:
            self.vel.x = 0

    def _resolve_collisions(self, platforms, axis):
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if axis == "x":
                    if self.vel.x > 0:
                        self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                    elif self.vel.x < 0:
                        self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                    self.pos.x = self.rect.x
                    self.vel.x = 0

                elif axis == "y":
                    if self.vel.y > 0:
                        self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                        self.on_ground = True
                    elif self.vel.y < 0:
                        self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                    self.vel.y = 0

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.set_animation("jump")
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 10:
            self.set_animation("run")
        else:
            self.set_animation("idle")

        self.animations[self.current_animation].update(dt)

    def update(self, dt, keys, platforms):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_physics(dt, platforms)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x=0, camera_y=0):
        frame = self.animations[self.current_animation].get_frame()
        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        draw_pos = (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y)
        surface.blit(frame, draw_pos)

        # Optional debug rect:
        # pygame.draw.rect(surface, (255, 0, 0), pygame.Rect(draw_pos[0], draw_pos[1], self.rect.width, self.rect.height), 2)


# ----------------------------
# Game
# ----------------------------
class Game:
    def __init__(self):
        pygame.init()
        pygame.display.set_caption(TITLE)
        self.screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
        self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()
        self.running = True

        self.player = Player(100, 200)

        self.platforms = [
            Platform(0, 500, 1400, 40),   # ground
            Platform(220, 410, 180, 20),
            Platform(470, 340, 180, 20),
            Platform(760, 270, 180, 20),
            Platform(1050, 430, 160, 20),
        ]

        self.camera_x = 0
        self.camera_y = 0

        self.font = pygame.font.SysFont("consolas", 20)

    def handle_events(self):
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                self.running = False

            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    self.player.jump()

    def update_camera(self):
        target_x = self.player.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        target_y = self.player.rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        # Smooth follow
        self.camera_x += (target_x - self.camera_x) * 0.1
        self.camera_y += (target_y - self.camera_y) * 0.08

        # Clamp camera to level bounds
        level_width = 1400
        level_height = 540
        self.camera_x = clamp(self.camera_x, 0, max(0, level_width - SCREEN_WIDTH))
        self.camera_y = clamp(self.camera_y, 0, max(0, level_height - SCREEN_HEIGHT))

    def draw_background(self):
        self.screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

        # Simple parallax hills
        pygame.draw.ellipse(self.screen, (110, 190, 110), (-100 - self.camera_x * 0.2, 380, 400, 180))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(self.screen, (100, 180, 100), (180 - self.camera_x * 0.25, 360, 450, 200))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(self.screen, (90, 170, 90), (520 - self.camera_x * 0.3, 390, 420, 170))

    def draw(self):
        self.draw_background()

        for platform in self.platforms:
            if platform.rect.y >= 500:
                draw_rect = platform.rect.move(-self.camera_x, -self.camera_y)
                pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, GROUND_COLOR, draw_rect)
            else:
                platform.draw(self.screen, self.camera_x, self.camera_y)

        self.player.draw(self.screen, self.camera_x, self.camera_y)

        debug_text = f"pos=({self.player.rect.x}, {self.player.rect.y}) vel=({self.player.vel.x:.1f}, {self.player.vel.y:.1f}) on_ground={self.player.on_ground}"
        text_surf = self.font.render(debug_text, True, (20, 20, 20))
        self.screen.blit(text_surf, (12, 12))

        controls = self.font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: W/Up/Space", True, (20, 20, 20))
        self.screen.blit(controls, (12, 36))

        pygame.display.flip()

    def run(self):
        while self.running:
            dt = self.clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0

            self.handle_events()
            keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
            self.player.update(dt, keys, self.platforms)
            self.update_camera()
            self.draw()

        pygame.quit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    Game().run()
```

```python
def create_animation_frames(size, base_color, accent_color, count, label=None):
    """
    Create placeholder animation frames as colored surfaces.
    """
    frames = []
    w, h = size
    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 20)

    for i in range(count):
        surf = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        surf.fill((0, 0, 0, 0))

        # Body
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, base_color, (8, 8, w - 16, h - 16), border_radius=8)

        # Accent changes per frame to simulate animation
        offset = (i % 3) * 3
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (12 + offset, 14, w - 24, 10), border_radius=4)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (14, h - 20 - offset, w - 28, 8), border_radius=4)

        if label:
            text = font.render(label, True, (255, 255, 255))
            surf.blit(text, (6, 4))

        frames.append(surf)

    return frames

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = {
            "idle": create_animation_frames((48, 64), (50, 120, 220), (255, 255, 255), 4, "I"),
            "run": create_animation_frames((48, 64), (50, 200, 120), (255, 255, 255), 6, "R"),
            "jump": create_animation_frames((48, 64), (220, 120, 50), (255, 255, 255), 2, "J"),
        }

        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0
        self.animation_speed = {
            "idle": 10,

        }

        moving = False

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x = -MOVE_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
            moving = True
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x = MOVE_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True
            moving = True

        if not moving:
            self.vel.x *= FRICTION
            if abs(self.vel.x) < 0.2:
                self.vel.x = 0

            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel.y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel.y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def update(self, platforms):
        self.apply_gravity()

        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += int(self.vel.x)
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel.y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel.y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel.y = 0

        speed = self.animation_speed[self.state]

            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        frame = frames[self.frame_index % len(frames)]
        if not self.facing_right:
```

```python
PLAYER_MAX_SPEED = 320
PLAYER_JUMP_VELOCITY = -700
AIR_CONTROL = 0.65

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)
GROUND_COLOR = (80, 180, 90)
PLATFORM_COLOR = (110, 90, 70)
DEBUG = False


# ----------------------------
# Utility
# ----------------------------
def clamp(value, min_value, max_value):
    return max(min_value, min(value, max_value))


# ----------------------------
# Animation
# ----------------------------
class Animation:
    def __init__(self, frames, frame_duration, loop=True):
        self.frames = frames
        self.frame_duration = frame_duration
        self.loop = loop
        self.time = 0.0
        self.index = 0
        self.finished = False

    def reset(self):
        self.time = 0.0
        self.index = 0
        self.finished = False

    def update(self, dt):
        if self.finished or len(self.frames) <= 1:
            return

        self.time += dt
        while self.time >= self.frame_duration:
            self.time -= self.frame_duration
            self.index += 1

            if self.index >= len(self.frames):
                if self.loop:
                    self.index = 0
                else:
                    self.index = len(self.frames) - 1
                    self.finished = True

    def get_frame(self):
        return self.frames[self.index]


# ----------------------------
# Sprite generation
# ----------------------------
def make_player_frame(size, body_color, accent_color, leg_offset=0, arm_offset=0, eye_shift=0):
    w, h = size
    surf = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)

    # Body
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (10, 16, 28, 30), border_radius=6)

    # Head
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, (245, 220, 190), (12, 2, 24, 18), border_radius=6)

    # Eyes
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (20, 20, 20), (20 + eye_shift, 10), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (20, 20, 20), (28 + eye_shift, 10), 2)

    # Arms
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (5, 18 + arm_offset, 6, 18), border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (37, 18 - arm_offset, 6, 18), border_radius=3)

    # Legs
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 80), (14, 46 + leg_offset, 8, 14), border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 80), (26, 46 - leg_offset, 8, 14), border_radius=3)

    return surf


def build_player_animations():
    size = (48, 64)

    idle_frames = [
        make_player_frame(size, (220, 70, 70), (180, 50, 50), leg_offset=0, arm_offset=0, eye_shift=0),
        make_player_frame(size, (220, 70, 70), (180, 50, 50), leg_offset=1, arm_offset=1, eye_shift=0),
    ]

    run_frames = [
        make_player_frame(size, (220, 70, 70), (180, 50, 50), leg_offset=-3, arm_offset=3, eye_shift=1),
        make_player_frame(size, (220, 70, 70), (180, 50, 50), leg_offset=0, arm_offset=0, eye_shift=0),
        make_player_frame(size, (220, 70, 70), (180, 50, 50), leg_offset=3, arm_offset=-3, eye_shift=-1),
        make_player_frame(size, (220, 70, 70), (180, 50, 50), leg_offset=0, arm_offset=0, eye_shift=0),
    ]

    jump_frames = [
        make_player_frame(size, (220, 70, 70), (180, 50, 50), leg_offset=-4, arm_offset=-2, eye_shift=0),
    ]

    return {
        "idle": Animation(idle_frames, 0.35, loop=True),
        "run": Animation(run_frames, 0.10, loop=True),
        "jump": Animation(jump_frames, 0.10, loop=True),
    }


# ----------------------------
# World objects
# ----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        r = self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, PLATFORM_COLOR, r, border_radius=6)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (70, 55, 40), r, 2, border_radius=6)


class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 36, 60)
        self.pos = pygame.Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = build_player_animations()
        self.current_animation = "idle"

    def set_animation(self, name):
        if self.current_animation != name:
            self.current_animation = name
            self.animations[name].reset()

    def handle_input(self, keys, dt):
        move = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            move -= 1
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            move += 1

        accel = PLAYER_ACCEL if self.on_ground else PLAYER_ACCEL * AIR_CONTROL

        if move != 0:
            self.vel.x += move * accel * dt
            self.facing_right = move > 0
        else:
            if self.vel.x > 0:
                self.vel.x = max(0, self.vel.x - PLAYER_FRICTION * dt)
            elif self.vel.x < 0:
                self.vel.x = min(0, self.vel.x + PLAYER_FRICTION * dt)

        self.vel.x = clamp(self.vel.x, -PLAYER_MAX_SPEED, PLAYER_MAX_SPEED)

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = PLAYER_JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_physics(self, dt):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY * dt

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms, dt):
        # Horizontal
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x * dt
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)

        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x
                self.vel.x = 0

        # Vertical
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y * dt
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)

        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom

                self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                self.vel.y = 0

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.set_animation("jump")
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 20:
            self.set_animation("run")
        else:
            self.set_animation("idle")

        self.animations[self.current_animation].update(dt)

    def update(self, dt, keys, platforms):
        self.handle_input(keys, dt)
        self.apply_physics(dt)
        self.move_and_collide(platforms, dt)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frame = self.animations[self.current_animation].get_frame()

        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        draw_x = self.rect.x - camera_x - 6
        draw_y = self.rect.y - camera_y - 4
        surface.blit(frame, (draw_x, draw_y))

        if DEBUG:
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, (255, 0, 0), self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y), 1)


# ----------------------------
# Camera
# ----------------------------
class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.x = 0
        self.y = 0
        self.width = width
        self.height = height

    def update(self, target_rect, world_width, world_height):
        self.x = target_rect.centerx - self.width // 2
        self.y = target_rect.centery - self.height // 2

        self.x = clamp(self.x, 0, max(0, world_width - self.width))
        self.y = clamp(self.y, 0, max(0, world_height - self.height))


# ----------------------------
# Level
# ----------------------------
def create_level():
    platforms = []

    # Ground
    platforms.append(Platform(-200, 480, 2200, 100))

    # Floating platforms
    platforms.append(Platform(180, 390, 140, 24))
    platforms.append(Platform(380, 330, 140, 24))
    platforms.append(Platform(620, 270, 140, 24))
    platforms.append(Platform(860, 350, 180, 24))
    platforms.append(Platform(1140, 300, 160, 24))
    platforms.append(Platform(1420, 240, 180, 24))
    platforms.append(Platform(1700, 380, 180, 24))

    world_width = 2000
    world_height = 700
    return platforms, world_width, world_height


def draw_background(surface, camera_x, camera_y):
    surface.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # Simple parallax hills
    for i in range(6):
        x = i * 300 - (camera_x * 0.3) % 300
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (110, 190, 110), (x, 360, 320, 180))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (90, 170, 95), (x + 120, 390, 280, 150))

    # Clouds
    for i in range(5):
        x = i * 240 - (camera_x * 0.15) % 240
        y = 60 + (i % 2) * 40
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (255, 255, 255), (x, y, 70, 30))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (255, 255, 255), (x + 20, y - 10, 70, 40))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (255, 255, 255), (x + 50, y, 70, 30))


def draw_ui(surface, font, player):
    text = f"Pos: ({int(player.pos.x)}, {int(player.pos.y)})  Vel: ({int(player.vel.x)}, {int(player.vel.y)})"
    img = font.render(text, True, (20, 20, 20))
    surface.blit(img, (16, 12))

    controls = "Move: A/D or Left/Right   Jump: Space / W / Up"
    img2 = font.render(controls, True, (20, 20, 20))
    surface.blit(img2, (16, 36))


# ----------------------------
# Main
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    pygame.display.set_caption(TITLE)
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("consolas", 20)

    platforms, world_width, world_height = create_level()
    player = Player(80, 300)
    camera = Camera(SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT)

    running = True
    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0
        dt = min(dt, 1 / 30)  # avoid huge physics steps on lag spikes

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False

            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_w, pygame.K_UP):
                    player.jump()
                elif event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                    running = False

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(dt, keys, platforms)
        camera.update(player.rect, world_width, world_height)

        draw_background(screen, camera.x, camera.y)

        for platform in platforms:
            platform.draw(screen, camera.x, camera.y)

        player.draw(screen, camera.x, camera.y)
        draw_ui(screen, font, player)

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## What this implementation includes

### Physics
- Gravity pulls the player downward every frame.
- Horizontal movement uses acceleration and friction.
- Jumping applies an upward velocity.
- Axis-separated collision resolution:
  - move on X, resolve X collisions
  - move on Y, resolve Y collisions

This is a good simple starting point for platformer physics.

### Animation
The player has three animation states:
- `idle`
- `run`
- `jump`

Frames are procedurally generated with colored rectangles and circles, so you can test animation logic without needing art assets.

### Camera
The camera follows the player and clamps to the world bounds.

```python
def create_animation_frames(size=(32, 48)):

class Platform(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y, width, height):
        super().__init__()
        self.image = pygame.Surface((width, height))
        self.image.fill((90, 60, 30))
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, (120, 85, 45), self.image.get_rect(), 4)
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))


# ----------------------------
# Player class
# ----------------------------
class Player(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__()

        self.animations = create_animation_frames()
        self.state = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0

        self.image = self.animations["idle"][0]
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

        # Use a smaller collision box than the sprite
        self.hitbox = pygame.Rect(x + 6, y + 4, 20, 44)

        self.pos = Vector2(self.hitbox.x, self.hitbox.y)
        self.vel = Vector2(0, 0)
        self.acc = Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.acc.x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.acc.x = -PLAYER_SPEED * 4
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.acc.x = PLAYER_SPEED * 4
            self.facing_right = True

        if not self.on_ground:
            self.acc.x *= 0.55

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_physics(self, dt, platforms):
        # Gravity
        self.acc.y = GRAVITY

        # Horizontal integration
        self.vel.x += self.acc.x * dt
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.x *= GROUND_FRICTION
        else:
            self.vel.x *= AIR_CONTROL

        self.vel.x = clamp(self.vel.x, -PLAYER_SPEED, PLAYER_SPEED)

        self.pos.x += self.vel.x * dt
        self.hitbox.x = round(self.pos.x)
        self.resolve_collisions(platforms, axis="x")

        # Vertical integration
        self.vel.y += self.acc.y * dt
        self.vel.y = clamp(self.vel.y, -2000, MAX_FALL_SPEED)

        self.pos.y += self.vel.y * dt
        self.hitbox.y = round(self.pos.y)
        self.on_ground = False
        self.resolve_collisions(platforms, axis="y")

        # Sync sprite rect to hitbox
        self.rect.midbottom = self.hitbox.midbottom

    def resolve_collisions(self, platforms, axis):
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.hitbox.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if axis == "x":
                    if self.vel.x > 0:
                        self.hitbox.right = platform.rect.left
                    elif self.vel.x < 0:
                        self.hitbox.left = platform.rect.right
                    self.pos.x = self.hitbox.x
                    self.vel.x = 0

                elif axis == "y":
                    if self.vel.y > 0:
                        self.hitbox.bottom = platform.rect.top
                        self.on_ground = True
                    elif self.vel.y < 0:
                        self.hitbox.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.pos.y = self.hitbox.y
                    self.vel.y = 0

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.state = "jump"
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 20:
            self.state = "run"
        else:
            self.state = "idle"

        if self.state == "idle":
            speed = 0.22
        elif self.state == "run":
            speed = 0.10
        else:
            speed = 0.15

        self.animation_timer += dt
        frames = self.animations[self.state]

        if self.animation_timer >= speed:
            self.animation_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        frame = frames[self.frame_index]

        if self.facing_right:
            self.image = frame
        else:
            self.image = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        # preserve feet position
        current_midbottom = self.rect.midbottom
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect()
        self.rect.midbottom = current_midbottom

    def update(self, dt, platforms, keys):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_physics(dt, platforms)
        self.update_animation(dt)

        self.width = width
        self.height = height

    def follow(self, target_rect):
        self.offset.x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.offset.y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        self.offset.x = clamp(self.offset.x, 0, max(0, self.width - SCREEN_WIDTH))
        self.offset.y = clamp(self.offset.y, 0, max(0, self.height - SCREEN_HEIGHT))

def build_level(level_map):
    platforms = []
    for row_index, row in enumerate(level_map):
        for col_index, cell in enumerate(row):
            if cell == "#":
                x = col_index * TILE_SIZE
                y = row_index * TILE_SIZE
                platforms.append(Platform(x, y, TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE))
    return platforms


def draw_background(screen, camera):
    screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # Simple parallax hills
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (100, 200, 100), (0, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 120, SCREEN_WIDTH, 120))
    pygame.draw.circle(screen, (255, 245, 180), (SCREEN_WIDTH - 120, 100), 40)

    for i in range(6):
        hill_x = i * 220 - (camera.offset.x * 0.2) % 220
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (80, 170, 90), (hill_x, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 180, 260, 100))


def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption(TITLE)
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    camera = Camera(level_width, level_height)

    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0
        dt = min(dt, 1 / 30)  # avoid huge physics steps on lag spikes

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False

            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    player.jump()

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(dt, platforms, keys)
        camera.follow(player.rect)

        draw_background(screen, camera)

        player_draw_rect = player.rect.move(-camera.offset.x, -camera.offset.y)
```

```python
MAX_FALL_SPEED = 1200

GROUND_COLOR = (70, 70, 70)

# Utility

def clamp(value, min_value, max_value):
    return max(min_value, min(value, max_value))


# ----------------------------
# Animation
# ----------------------------
class Animation:
    def __init__(self, frames, frame_duration, loop=True):
        self.frames = frames
        self.frame_duration = frame_duration
        self.loop = loop
        self.time = 0.0
        self.finished = False

    def reset(self):
        self.time = 0.0
        self.finished = False

    def update(self, dt):
        if self.finished:
            return
        self.time += dt
        total_duration = len(self.frames) * self.frame_duration
        if self.loop:
            self.time %= total_duration
        elif self.time >= total_duration:
            self.time = total_duration - 0.0001
            self.finished = True

    def get_current_frame(self):
        index = int(self.time / self.frame_duration)
        index = clamp(index, 0, len(self.frames) - 1)
        return self.frames[index]

    pygame.draw.circle(surf, color_eye, (21, 8), 2)

    pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (22, 34), (22 - leg_offset, 48), 4)

    # arms
    pygame.draw.line(surf, (255, 220, 180), (8, 18), (2, 24 + arm_offset), 3)
    pygame.draw.line(surf, (255, 220, 180), (28, 18), (34, 24 - arm_offset), 3)

    return surf

        make_player_frame((220, 60, 60), (0, 0, 0), 1, 1),
    ]

    run_frames = [
        make_player_frame((60, 160, 255), (0, 0, 0), -4, -3),
        make_player_frame((60, 160, 255), (0, 0, 0), 0, 0),
        make_player_frame((60, 160, 255), (0, 0, 0), 4, 3),
        make_player_frame((60, 160, 255), (0, 0, 0), 0, 0),
    ]

    ]

    }

class Level:
    def __init__(self, tile_map):
        self.tile_map = tile_map
        self.width = len(tile_map[0])
        self.height = len(tile_map)
        self.solid_tiles = []

        for y, row in enumerate(tile_map):
            for x, cell in enumerate(row):
                if cell == "X":
                    rect = pygame.Rect(x * TILE_SIZE, y * TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE)
                    self.solid_tiles.append(rect)

    def get_nearby_tiles(self, rect):
        # Simple version: return all solids intersecting a broad area around rect
        nearby = []
        expanded = rect.inflate(TILE_SIZE * 2, TILE_SIZE * 2)
        for tile in self.solid_tiles:
            if expanded.colliderect(tile):
                nearby.append(tile)
        return nearby

        for tile in self.solid_tiles:
            draw_rect = pygame.Rect(tile.x - camera_x, tile.y - camera_y, tile.width, tile.height)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, GROUND_COLOR, draw_rect)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, PLATFORM_COLOR, draw_rect, 3)

class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 36, 52)
        self.pos = pygame.Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = create_player_animations()
        self.current_animation_name = "idle"
        self.current_animation = self.animations[self.current_animation_name]

    def set_animation(self, name):
        if self.current_animation_name != name:
            self.current_animation_name = name
            self.current_animation = self.animations[name]
            self.current_animation.reset()

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        move = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            move -= 1
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            move += 1

        self.vel.x = move * PLAYER_SPEED

        if move < 0:
            self.facing_right = False
        elif move > 0:
            self.facing_right = True

        return move

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def update(self, dt, level, keys):
        move = self.handle_input(keys)

        # Gravity
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY * dt
        self.vel.y = min(self.vel.y, MAX_FALL_SPEED)

        # Horizontal movement
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x * dt
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)
        self.resolve_collisions(level, axis="x")

        # Vertical movement
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y * dt
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)
        self.on_ground = False
        self.resolve_collisions(level, axis="y")

        # Animation state
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.set_animation("jump")
        elif abs(move) > 0:
            self.set_animation("run")
        else:
            self.set_animation("idle")

                    elif self.vel.x < 0:

                    self.vel.x = 0

                    elif self.vel.y < 0:
                        self.rect.top = tile.bottom
                    self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                    self.vel.y = 0

        draw_y = self.rect.y - camera_y
        surface.blit(frame, (draw_x, draw_y))
```

```python
import pygame
import sys

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60
TILE_SIZE = 48

GRAVITY = 0.6
MAX_FALL_SPEED = 14
MOVE_SPEED = 4.5
JUMP_SPEED = -12

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)

LEVEL_MAP = [
    "........................",
    "........................",
    "........................",
    "........................",
    "........................",
    "..............###.......",
    "......................#.",
    "..........###........##.",
    "....................###.",
    ".....###................",
    "....................##..",
    "..P.....................",
    "########################",
]


# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
def make_frame(size, body_color, accent_color, eye_offset=0, leg_offset=0):
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    w, h = size

    # body
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (8, 8, w - 16, h - 16), border_radius=8)

    # face/eyes
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 255, 255), (w // 2 - 8 + eye_offset, h // 2 - 6), 4)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 255, 255), (w // 2 + 8 + eye_offset, h // 2 - 6), 4)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (20, 20, 20), (w // 2 - 8 + eye_offset, h // 2 - 6), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (20, 20, 20), (w // 2 + 8 + eye_offset, h // 2 - 6), 2)

    # belt/accent
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (10, h // 2 + 6, w - 20, 8), border_radius=4)

    # legs
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 40), (14, h - 16, 10, 10 + leg_offset))
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 40), (w - 24, h - 16, 10, 10 - leg_offset if 10 - leg_offset > 2 else 2))

    return surf


def generate_player_animations():
    size = (36, 44)

    idle = [
        make_frame(size, (255, 180, 60), (220, 80, 80), eye_offset=0, leg_offset=0),
        make_frame(size, (255, 185, 65), (220, 80, 80), eye_offset=1, leg_offset=1),
    ]

    run = [
        make_frame(size, (255, 180, 60), (80, 180, 255), eye_offset=0, leg_offset=4),
        make_frame(size, (255, 175, 55), (80, 180, 255), eye_offset=1, leg_offset=-2),
        make_frame(size, (255, 180, 60), (80, 180, 255), eye_offset=0, leg_offset=0),
        make_frame(size, (255, 175, 55), (80, 180, 255), eye_offset=-1, leg_offset=3),
    ]

    jump = [
        make_frame(size, (255, 160, 80), (160, 80, 255), eye_offset=0, leg_offset=-4),
    ]

    return {
        "idle": idle,
        "run": run,
        "jump": jump,
    }


# ----------------------------
# World objects
# ----------------------------
class Tile(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y, size):
        super().__init__()
        self.image = pygame.Surface((size, size))
        self.image.fill((100, 70, 40))
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, (120, 200, 90), (0, 0, size, 10))
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, (80, 55, 30), (0, 10, size, size - 10))
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))


class Player(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__()
        self.animations = generate_player_animations()
        self.state = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.12

        self.facing_right = True

        self.image = self.animations["idle"][0]
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

        self.pos = pygame.Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False

    def handle_input(self):
        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        self.vel.x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x = -MOVE_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x = MOVE_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

        if (keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_UP] or keys[pygame.K_w]) and self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_SPEED
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel.y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel.y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, tiles):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)

        for tile in tiles:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = tile.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = tile.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x

        # Vertical movement
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)

        self.on_ground = False
        for tile in tiles:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = tile.rect.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = tile.rect.bottom
                self.vel.y = 0
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y

    def update_animation(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.state = "jump"
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 0.1:
            self.state = "run"
        else:
            self.state = "idle"

        frames = self.animations[self.state]

        if self.state == "jump":
            self.frame_index = 0
        else:
            self.animation_timer += self.animation_speed
            if self.animation_timer >= 1:
                self.animation_timer = 0
                self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        frame = frames[self.frame_index]
        if self.facing_right:
            self.image = frame
        else:
            self.image = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

    def update(self, tiles):
        self.handle_input()
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(tiles)
        self.update_animation()


# ----------------------------
# Level
# ----------------------------
def build_level(level_map):
    tiles = pygame.sprite.Group()
    player = None

    for row_index, row in enumerate(level_map):
        for col_index, cell in enumerate(row):
            x = col_index * TILE_SIZE
            y = row_index * TILE_SIZE

            if cell == "#":
                tiles.add(Tile(x, y, TILE_SIZE))
            elif cell == "P":
                player = Player(x, y)

    return tiles, player


# ----------------------------
# Camera
# ----------------------------
class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.offset = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.width = width
        self.height = height

    def follow(self, target_rect):
        self.offset.x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.offset.y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        max_x = max(0, self.width - SCREEN_WIDTH)
        max_y = max(0, self.height - SCREEN_HEIGHT)

        self.offset.x = max(0, min(self.offset.x, max_x))
        self.offset.y = max(0, min(self.offset.y, max_y))


# ----------------------------
# Main
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("Initial 2D Platformer")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    tiles, player = build_level(LEVEL_MAP)
    if player is None:
        print("No player spawn 'P' found in level.")
        pygame.quit()
        sys.exit()

    world_width = len(LEVEL_MAP[0]) * TILE_SIZE
    world_height = len(LEVEL_MAP) * TILE_SIZE
    camera = Camera(world_width, world_height)

    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 24)

    running = True
    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False

        player.update(tiles.sprites())
        camera.follow(player.rect)

        # Draw background
        screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

        # Simple parallax clouds
        for i in range(6):
            cloud_x = (i * 220) - camera.offset.x * 0.2
            cloud_y = 60 + (i % 3) * 40
            pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (cloud_x, cloud_y, 90, 40))
            pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (245, 245, 245), (cloud_x + 25, cloud_y - 10, 70, 35))

        # Draw tiles
        for tile in tiles:
            screen.blit(tile.image, tile.rect.topleft - camera.offset)

        # Draw player
        screen.blit(player.image, player.rect.topleft - camera.offset)

        # UI
        info = f"Pos=({int(player.pos.x)}, {int(player.pos.y)}) Vel=({player.vel.x:.1f}, {player.vel.y:.1f}) Ground={player.on_ground}"
        text = font.render(info, True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(text, (12, 12))

        controls = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right   Jump: Space/W/Up", True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(controls, (12, 36))

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
import pygame

# Config
```

```python
PLATFORM_COLOR = (80, 60, 40)

# Helpers
# ----------------------------
def clamp(value, minimum, maximum):
    return max(minimum, min(value, maximum))


def sign(x):
    if x > 0:
        return 1
    if x < 0:
        return -1
    return 0


# ----------------------------
# Animation
# ----------------------------
class Animation:
    def __init__(self, frames, frame_duration, loop=True):
        self.frames = frames
        self.frame_duration = frame_duration
        self.loop = loop
        self.time = 0.0
        self.index = 0
        self.finished = False

    def reset(self):
        self.time = 0.0
        self.index = 0
        self.finished = False

    def update(self, dt):
        if self.finished or len(self.frames) <= 1:
            return

        self.time += dt
        while self.time >= self.frame_duration:
            self.time -= self.frame_duration
            self.index += 1

            if self.index >= len(self.frames):
                if self.loop:
                    self.index = 0
                else:
                    self.index = len(self.frames) - 1
                    self.finished = True

    def get_frame(self):
        return self.frames[self.index]


# ----------------------------
# Sprite generation
# ----------------------------
def make_player_frame(size, body_color, accent_color, leg_offset=0, arm_offset=0, airborne=False):
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    w, h = size

    # Head
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 224, 189), (w // 2, 12), 8)

    # Body
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (w // 2 - 8, 20, 16, 22), border_radius=4)

    # Arms
    pygame.draw.line(
        surf,
        accent_color,
        (w // 2 - 8, 26),
        (w // 2 - 14, 34 + arm_offset),
        4,
    )
    pygame.draw.line(
        surf,
        accent_color,
        (w // 2 + 8, 26),
        (w // 2 + 14, 34 - arm_offset),
        4,
    )

    # Legs
    if airborne:
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w // 2 - 4, 42), (w // 2 - 10, 52), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w // 2 + 4, 42), (w // 2 + 10, 50), 4)
    else:
        pygame.draw.line(
            surf,
            (30, 30, 30),
            (w // 2 - 4, 42),
            (w // 2 - 8, 54 + leg_offset),
            4,
        )
        pygame.draw.line(
            surf,
            (30, 30, 30),
            (w // 2 + 4, 42),
            (w // 2 + 8, 54 - leg_offset),
            4,
        )

    return surf


def create_player_animations():
    size = (40, 60)

    idle_frames = [
        make_player_frame(size, (220, 60, 60), (255, 180, 50), leg_offset=0, arm_offset=0),
        make_player_frame(size, (220, 70, 70), (255, 180, 50), leg_offset=1, arm_offset=1),
    ]

    run_frames = [
        make_player_frame(size, (220, 60, 60), (255, 180, 50), leg_offset=-4, arm_offset=4),
        make_player_frame(size, (220, 60, 60), (255, 180, 50), leg_offset=0, arm_offset=0),
        make_player_frame(size, (220, 60, 60), (255, 180, 50), leg_offset=4, arm_offset=-4),
        make_player_frame(size, (220, 60, 60), (255, 180, 50), leg_offset=0, arm_offset=0),
    ]

    jump_frames = [
        make_player_frame(size, (80, 120, 240), (255, 220, 80), airborne=True),
    ]

    return {
        "idle": Animation(idle_frames, 0.35, loop=True),
        "run": Animation(run_frames, 0.10, loop=True),
        "jump": Animation(jump_frames, 0.10, loop=True),
    }


# ----------------------------
# World objects
# ----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        draw_rect = self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, PLATFORM_COLOR, draw_rect, border_radius=6)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (120, 90, 60), draw_rect, 3, border_radius=6)


class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 40, 60)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing = 1

        self.animations = create_player_animations()
        self.current_animation = "idle"

    def set_animation(self, name):
        if self.current_animation != name:
            self.current_animation = name
            self.animations[name].reset()

    def handle_input(self, keys, dt):
        move = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            move -= 1
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            move += 1

        control = 1.0 if self.on_ground else AIR_CONTROL
        self.vel.x = move * PLAYER_SPEED * control

        if move != 0:
            self.facing = sign(move)

        if (keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_UP] or keys[pygame.K_w]) and self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_physics(self, dt, platforms):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY * dt
        self.vel.y = min(self.vel.y, MAX_FALL_SPEED)

        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += int(self.vel.x * dt)
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel.y * dt)
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel.y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel.y = 0

        if self.on_ground and abs(self.vel.x) < 1:
            self.vel.x = 0

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.set_animation("jump")
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 10:
            self.set_animation("run")
        else:
            self.set_animation("idle")

        self.animations[self.current_animation].update(dt)

    def update(self, dt, keys, platforms):
        self.handle_input(keys, dt)
        self.apply_physics(dt, platforms)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frame = self.animations[self.current_animation].get_frame()
        if self.facing < 0:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        draw_pos = (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y)
        surface.blit(frame, draw_pos)

        if DEBUG:
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, (255, 0, 0), self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y), 1)


class Camera:
    def __init__(self):
        self.x = 0
        self.y = 0

    def update(self, target_rect):
        self.x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        self.x = max(0, self.x)
        self.y = max(0, self.y)


# ----------------------------
# Level
# ----------------------------
def create_level():
    platforms = [
        Platform(0, 500, 1400, 50),
        Platform(220, 420, 140, 20),
        Platform(430, 350, 140, 20),
        Platform(650, 290, 140, 20),
        Platform(860, 380, 180, 20),
        Platform(1120, 320, 160, 20),
        Platform(1320, 440, 220, 20),
    ]
    return platforms


def draw_background(surface, camera_x, camera_y):
    surface.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # Simple parallax hills
    for i in range(6):
        hill_x = i * 300 - (camera_x * 0.3) % 300
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (100, 190, 100), (hill_x, 360, 320, 180))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (80, 170, 90), (hill_x + 120, 390, 260, 150))

    # Clouds
    for i in range(5):
        cx = i * 240 - (camera_x * 0.15) % 240 + 80
        cy = 70 + (i % 2) * 35
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 255, 255), (int(cx), cy), 22)
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 255, 255), (int(cx + 20), cy - 8), 18)
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 255, 255), (int(cx + 40), cy), 20)


# ----------------------------
# Main
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption(TITLE)
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("consolas", 20)

    player = Player(100, 200)
    platforms = create_level()
    camera = Camera()

    running = True
    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0
        dt = min(dt, 1 / 30)  # avoid huge physics jumps on lag spikes

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(dt, keys, platforms)
        camera.update(player.rect)

        draw_background(screen, camera.x, camera.y)

        for platform in platforms:
            platform.draw(screen, camera.x, camera.y)

        player.draw(screen, camera.x, camera.y)

        info = f"Pos=({player.rect.x},{player.rect.y}) Vel=({player.vel.x:.1f},{player.vel.y:.1f})"
        text = font.render(info, True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(text, (12, 12))

        controls = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: W/Up/Space", True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(controls, (12, 36))

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
import pygame
import sys

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60
TILE_SIZE = 48

GRAVITY = 0.6
MAX_FALL_SPEED = 14
MOVE_SPEED = 5
JUMP_SPEED = -13
GROUND_FRICTION = 0.8
AIR_CONTROL = 0.5

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)

LEVEL_MAP = [
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    ".............................###................................",
    "................................................................",
    "....................###.........................................",
    "................................................................",
    "..........###...................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "....P...........................................................",
    "################....##############...........###################",
    "################....##############...........###################",
]

# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
def clamp(value, min_value, max_value):
    return max(min_value, min(value, max_value))


def make_frame(size, body_color, accent_color, eye_color=(255, 255, 255), eye_pupil=(0, 0, 0), leg_offset=0):
    """Generate a simple placeholder character frame."""
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    w, h = size

    # Body
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (w * 0.2, h * 0.2, w * 0.6, h * 0.55), border_radius=8)

    # Head/accent
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (w * 0.28, h * 0.08, w * 0.44, h * 0.22), border_radius=6)

    # Eyes
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, eye_color, (int(w * 0.42), int(h * 0.22)), 4)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, eye_color, (int(w * 0.58), int(h * 0.22)), 4)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, eye_pupil, (int(w * 0.42), int(h * 0.22)), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, eye_pupil, (int(w * 0.58), int(h * 0.22)), 2)

    # Arms
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (w * 0.08, h * 0.35, w * 0.12, h * 0.12), border_radius=4)
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (w * 0.80, h * 0.35, w * 0.12, h * 0.12), border_radius=4)

    # Legs
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 60), (w * 0.30, h * 0.75, w * 0.12, h * 0.18 + leg_offset), border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 60), (w * 0.58, h * 0.75 - leg_offset, w * 0.12, h * 0.18 + leg_offset), border_radius=3)

    return surf


def generate_player_animations():
    size = (36, 52)

    idle = [
        make_frame(size, (255, 180, 60), (220, 80, 80), leg_offset=0),
        make_frame(size, (255, 185, 65), (220, 85, 85), leg_offset=1),
    ]

    run = [
        make_frame(size, (255, 180, 60), (220, 80, 80), leg_offset=4),
        make_frame(size, (255, 180, 60), (220, 80, 80), leg_offset=-2),
        make_frame(size, (255, 180, 60), (220, 80, 80), leg_offset=5),
        make_frame(size, (255, 180, 60), (220, 80, 80), leg_offset=-1),
    ]

    jump = [
        make_frame(size, (255, 200, 80), (240, 100, 100), leg_offset=2),
    ]

    return {
        "idle": idle,
        "run": run,
        "jump": jump,
    }


# ----------------------------
# Tile / Level
# ----------------------------
class Tile(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y, size):
        super().__init__()
        self.image = pygame.Surface((size, size))
        self.image.fill((90, 70, 50))
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, (120, 100, 70), (0, 0, size, 10))
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, (70, 55, 40), (0, 0, size, size), 3)
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))


class Level:
    def __init__(self, level_map):
        self.tiles = pygame.sprite.Group()
        self.player_spawn = (100, 100)
        self.width = len(level_map[0]) * TILE_SIZE
        self.height = len(level_map) * TILE_SIZE

        for row_idx, row in enumerate(level_map):
            for col_idx, cell in enumerate(row):
                x = col_idx * TILE_SIZE
                y = row_idx * TILE_SIZE

                if cell == "#":
                    self.tiles.add(Tile(x, y, TILE_SIZE))
                elif cell == "P":
                    self.player_spawn = (x, y)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        for tile in self.tiles:
            surface.blit(tile.image, (tile.rect.x - camera_x, tile.rect.y - camera_y))


# ----------------------------
# Player
# ----------------------------
class Player(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y, solid_tiles):
        super().__init__()
        self.animations = generate_player_animations()
        self.state = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.12

        self.facing_right = True

        self.image = self.animations["idle"][0]
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

        # Use floats for precise physics
        self.pos = pygame.Vector2(self.rect.x, self.rect.y)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        self.solid_tiles = solid_tiles
        self.on_ground = False

    def handle_input(self):
        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        move = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            move -= 1
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            move += 1

        if move != 0:
            self.facing_right = move > 0

        control = 1.0 if self.on_ground else AIR_CONTROL
        self.vel.x = move * MOVE_SPEED * control

        if move == 0 and self.on_ground:
            self.vel.x *= GROUND_FRICTION
            if abs(self.vel.x) < 0.2:
                self.vel.x = 0

        if (keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_UP] or keys[pygame.K_w]) and self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_SPEED
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        self.vel.y = clamp(self.vel.y, -100, MAX_FALL_SPEED)

    def move_and_collide(self):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)

        for tile in self.solid_tiles:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = tile.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = tile.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x

        # Vertical movement
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)

        self.on_ground = False
        for tile in self.solid_tiles:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = tile.rect.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = tile.rect.bottom
                self.vel.y = 0
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.state = "jump"
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 0.5:
            self.state = "run"
        else:
            self.state = "idle"

        frames = self.animations[self.state]
        self.animation_timer += dt

        speed = self.animation_speed
        if self.state == "run":
            speed = 0.08
        elif self.state == "idle":
            speed = 0.25
        elif self.state == "jump":
            speed = 0.15

        if self.animation_timer >= speed:
            self.animation_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        frame = frames[self.frame_index % len(frames)]
        if self.facing_right:
            self.image = frame
        else:
            self.image = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

    def update(self, dt):
        self.handle_input()
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide()
        self.update_animation(dt)


# ----------------------------
# Camera
# ----------------------------
class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.x = 0
        self.y = 0
        self.width = width
        self.height = height

    def update(self, target_rect):
        self.x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        self.x = clamp(self.x, 0, max(0, self.width - SCREEN_WIDTH))
        self.y = clamp(self.y, 0, max(0, self.height - SCREEN_HEIGHT))


# ----------------------------
# Drawing
# ----------------------------
def draw_background(screen, camera_x, camera_y):
    screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # Simple parallax hills/cloud bands
    for i in range(6):
        pygame.draw.ellipse(
            screen,
            (180, 230, 255),
            (
                (i * 220) - (camera_x * 0.2) % 220 - 50,
                60 + (i % 2) * 20,
                180,
                60,
            ),
        )

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (100, 190, 100), (0, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 80, SCREEN_WIDTH, 80))


def draw_player(screen, player, camera_x, camera_y):
    screen.blit(player.image, (player.rect.x - camera_x, player.rect.y - camera_y))


# ----------------------------
# Main
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("Initial 2D Platformer")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("arial", 20)

    level = Level(LEVEL_MAP)
    player = Player(level.player_spawn[0], level.player_spawn[1], level.tiles)
    camera = Camera(level.width, level.height)

    while True:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                pygame.quit()
                sys.exit()

        player.update(dt)
        camera.update(player.rect)

        draw_background(screen, camera.x, camera.y)
        level.draw(screen, camera.x, camera.y)
        draw_player(screen, player, camera.x, camera.y)

        debug_text = f"pos=({player.rect.x}, {player.rect.y}) vel=({player.vel.x:.1f}, {player.vel.y:.1f}) on_ground={player.on_ground}"
        screen.blit(font.render(debug_text, True, (20, 20, 20)), (12, 12))

        controls = "Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: W/Up/Space"
        screen.blit(font.render(controls, True, (20, 20, 20)), (12, 38))

        pygame.display.flip()
```

## Features included

### Physics
- Gravity accelerates the player downward.
- Jumping applies an upward velocity.
- Horizontal and vertical movement are resolved separately for stable tile collisions.
- Falling speed is capped.

### Collision
- Solid `#` tiles block the player.
- The player can stand on platforms and collide with walls/ceilings.

### Animation
- `idle`, `run`, and `jump` animation states.
- Frames are generated procedurally, so no image files are needed.
- Sprite flips horizontally based on facing direction.

### Camera
- Camera follows the player.
- Camera is clamped to level bounds.

```python
        self.current_animation = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.12

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel_x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel_x = -MOVE_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False

        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel_x = MOVE_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

        if (keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_UP] or keys[pygame.K_w]) and self.on_ground:
            self.vel_y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

        self.vel_y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel_y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel_y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):

        self.rect.x += int(self.vel_x)
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel_x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel_y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel_y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel_y = 0

        if not self.on_ground:
            self.current_animation = "jump"
        elif abs(self.vel_x) > 0:
            self.current_animation = "run"
        else:
            self.current_animation = "idle"

        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        self.animation_timer += self.animation_speed

        if self.animation_timer >= 1:
            self.animation_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        if self.frame_index >= len(frames):
            self.frame_index = 0

        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation()

        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        image = frames[self.frame_index]

        if not self.facing_right:
            image = pygame.transform.flip(image, True, False)

        screen.blit(image, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y))
```

```python
def make_player_frame(size, body_color, accent_color, pose="idle1"):

    elif pose == "run2":

    elif pose == "run3":
```
