```python
    """
    def post(self, payment: PaymentRecord) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
        # Replace with transactional posting and settlement orchestration.
        return True, None


class PaymentService:
    def __init__(
        self,
        repository: PaymentRepository,
        audit_logger: AuditLogger,
        compliance_service: ComplianceService,
        fraud_service: FraudService,
        ledger_service: LedgerService,
    ) -> None:
        self.repository = repository
        self.audit_logger = audit_logger
        self.compliance_service = compliance_service
        self.fraud_service = fraud_service
        self.ledger_service = ledger_service

    def create_payment(self, request: PaymentRequest, actor: str) -> PaymentResponse:
        existing = self.repository.get_by_client_request_id(request.client_request_id)
        if existing:
            self.audit_logger.log(
                event_type="PAYMENT_IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY",
                payment_id=existing.payment_id,
                actor=actor,
                details={"client_request_id": request.client_request_id},
            )
            return self._to_response(existing)

        payment = PaymentRecord(
            client_request_id=request.client_request_id,
            amount=request.amount,
            currency=request.currency,
            debtor=request.debtor,
            creditor=request.creditor,
            purpose=request.purpose,
        )

        payment = self.repository.create_if_absent(payment)

        self.audit_logger.log(
            event_type="PAYMENT_CREATED",
            payment_id=payment.payment_id,
            actor=actor,
            details={
                "client_request_id": payment.client_request_id,
                "amount": str(payment.amount),
                "currency": payment.currency.value,
            },
        )

        fraud_ok, fraud_reason = self.fraud_service.assess(payment)
        if not fraud_ok:
            payment.status = PaymentStatus.REJECTED
            payment.status_reason = fraud_reason
            payment.updated_at = utcnow()
            self.repository.update(payment)
            self.audit_logger.log(
                event_type="PAYMENT_REJECTED_FRAUD",
                payment_id=payment.payment_id,
                actor=actor,
                details={"reason": fraud_reason},
            )
            return self._to_response(payment)

        compliance_ok, compliance_reason = self.compliance_service.screen_payment(payment)
        if not compliance_ok:
            payment.status = PaymentStatus.PENDING_REVIEW
            payment.status_reason = compliance_reason
            payment.updated_at = utcnow()
            self.repository.update(payment)
            self.audit_logger.log(
                event_type="PAYMENT_PENDING_REVIEW",
                payment_id=payment.payment_id,
                actor=actor,
                details={"reason": compliance_reason},
            )
            return self._to_response(payment)

        payment.status = PaymentStatus.APPROVED
        payment.updated_at = utcnow()
        self.repository.update(payment)
        self.audit_logger.log(
            event_type="PAYMENT_APPROVED",
            payment_id=payment.payment_id,
            actor=actor,
            details={},
        )

        posted, post_reason = self.ledger_service.post(payment)
        if not posted:
            payment.status = PaymentStatus.FAILED
            payment.status_reason = post_reason or "Ledger posting failed"
            payment.updated_at = utcnow()
            self.repository.update(payment)
            self.audit_logger.log(
                event_type="PAYMENT_POSTING_FAILED",
                payment_id=payment.payment_id,
                actor=actor,
                details={"reason": payment.status_reason},
            )
            return self._to_response(payment)

        payment.status = PaymentStatus.POSTED
        payment.status_reason = None
        payment.updated_at = utcnow()
        self.repository.update(payment)
        self.audit_logger.log(
            event_type="PAYMENT_POSTED",
            payment_id=payment.payment_id,
            actor=actor,
            details={},
        )

        return self._to_response(payment)

    def get_payment(self, payment_id: str) -> PaymentResponse | None:
        payment = self.repository.get_by_payment_id(payment_id)
        if not payment:
            return None
        return self._to_response(payment)

    @staticmethod
    def _to_response(payment: PaymentRecord) -> PaymentResponse:
        return PaymentResponse(
            payment_id=payment.payment_id,
            client_request_id=payment.client_request_id,
            status=payment.status,
            amount=payment.amount,
            currency=payment.currency,
            created_at=payment.created_at,
            updated_at=payment.updated_at,
            status_reason=payment.status_reason,
        )
```

```python
@app.post("/payments", response_model=PaymentResponse, dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)])
def create_payment(
    payload: CreatePaymentRequest,
    idempotency_key: str = Header(..., alias="Idempotency-Key"),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    existing = (
        db.query(Payment)
        .filter(
            Payment.client_id == payload.client_id,
            Payment.idempotency_key == idempotency_key
        )
        .first()
    )
    if existing:
        return PaymentResponse(
            id=existing.id,
            client_id=existing.client_id,
            source_account_id=existing.source_account_id,
            destination_account_id=existing.destination_account_id,
            amount=existing.amount,
            currency=existing.currency,
            status=existing.status,
            reference=existing.reference,
            created_at=existing.created_at,
            updated_at=existing.updated_at,
        )

    payment = Payment(
        client_id=payload.client_id,
        source_account_id=payload.source_account_id,
        destination_account_id=payload.destination_account_id,
        amount=payload.amount,
        currency=payload.currency.upper(),
        status=PaymentStatus.PENDING,
        reference=payload.reference,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
        created_at=utcnow(),
        updated_at=utcnow(),
    )
    db.add(payment)
    write_audit_log(
        db,
        actor=payload.client_id,
        action="PAYMENT_CREATED",
        entity_type="payment",
        entity_id=payment.id,
        details={
            "amount": str(payload.amount),
            "currency": payload.currency.upper(),
            "source_account_id": payload.source_account_id,
            "destination_account_id": payload.destination_account_id,
        },
    )
    db.flush()

    provider_result = send_to_payment_provider(payment)
    payment.provider_reference = provider_result.provider_reference
    payment.status = provider_result.status
    payment.updated_at = utcnow()

    if payment.status == PaymentStatus.AUTHORIZED:
        post_double_entry_ledger(db, payment)
        write_audit_log(
            db,
            actor="system",
            action="LEDGER_POSTED",
            entity_type="payment",
            entity_id=payment.id,
            details={"status": payment.status},
        )

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(payment)

    return PaymentResponse(
        id=payment.id,
        client_id=payment.client_id,
        source_account_id=payment.source_account_id,
        destination_account_id=payment.destination_account_id,
        amount=payment.amount,
        currency=payment.currency,
        status=payment.status,
        reference=payment.reference,
        created_at=payment.created_at,
        updated_at=payment.updated_at,
    )

@app.get("/payments/{payment_id}", response_model=PaymentResponse, dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)])
def get_payment(payment_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    payment = db.query(Payment).filter(Payment.id == payment_id).first()
    if not payment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Payment not found")

    return PaymentResponse(
        id=payment.id,
        client_id=payment.client_id,
        source_account_id=payment.source_account_id,
        destination_account_id=payment.destination_account_id,
        amount=payment.amount,
        currency=payment.currency,
        status=payment.status,
        reference=payment.reference,
        created_at=payment.created_at,
        updated_at=payment.updated_at,
    )

@app.post("/webhooks/provider")
async def provider_webhook(
    request: Request,
    x_signature: str = Header(..., alias="X-Signature"),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    raw_body = await request.body()
    if not verify_webhook_signature(raw_body, x_signature):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid signature")

    payload = WebhookEvent.model_validate_json(raw_body)

    payment = db.query(Payment).filter(Payment.id == payload.payment_id).first()
    if not payment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Payment not found")

    previous_status = payment.status
    payment.status = payload.status
    payment.updated_at = utcnow()

    if previous_status != PaymentStatus.AUTHORIZED and payload.status == PaymentStatus.AUTHORIZED:
        post_double_entry_ledger(db, payment)

    write_audit_log(
        db,
        actor="provider_webhook",
        action="PAYMENT_STATUS_UPDATED",
        entity_type="payment",
        entity_id=payment.id,
        details={
            "previous_status": previous_status,
            "new_status": payload.status,
            "provider_reference": payload.provider_reference,
        },
    )

    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True}
```

A payment service for a large financial institution should generally follow these principles:

- **Never mutate history silently**

- **External callbacks are authenticated**
- **All client retries are idempotent**
- **Provider integrations are isolated and observable**
- **Sensitive operations require strong auth and authorization**
- **Operational tooling must support reconciliation and incident response**

```python
    @field_validator("amount")
    @classmethod

        except InvalidOperation:
            raise ValueError("amount must be a valid decimal")

        if amount <= 0:
            raise ValueError("amount must be greater than zero")

        # Typical financial precision guard
        if amount.as_tuple().exponent < -2:
            raise ValueError("amount cannot have more than 2 decimal places")

        return v

class PaymentRepository(Protocol):
    def get_by_id(self, payment_id: str) -> Optional[Payment]:
        ...

    def get_by_idempotency_key(self, client_id: str, idempotency_key: str) -> Optional[Payment]:

    def update(self, payment: Payment) -> None:

class InMemoryPaymentRepository:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._payments: Dict[str, Payment] = {}
        self._idempotency_index: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self._lock = Lock()

    def _idem_key(self, client_id: str, idempotency_key: str) -> str:
        return f"{client_id}:{idempotency_key}"

    def get_by_id(self, payment_id: str) -> Optional[Payment]:
        return self._payments.get(payment_id)

    def get_by_idempotency_key(self, client_id: str, idempotency_key: str) -> Optional[Payment]:
        payment_id = self._idempotency_index.get(self._idem_key(client_id, idempotency_key))
        if not payment_id:
            return None
        return self._payments.get(payment_id)

    def save(self, payment: Payment) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            idem = self._idem_key(payment.client_id, payment.idempotency_key)
            if idem in self._idempotency_index:
                raise ValueError("duplicate idempotency key")
            self._payments[payment.payment_id] = payment
            self._idempotency_index[idem] = payment.payment_id

    def update(self, payment: Payment) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._payments[payment.payment_id] = payment

API_SHARED_SECRET = os.getenv("API_SHARED_SECRET", "change-me")

def authenticate_request(request: Request, authorization: Optional[str]) -> str:
    """
    Demo authentication.
    In production, use mTLS, OAuth2/JWT, HSM-backed signing, or institutional IAM.
    Returns client_id.
    """
    if not authorization or not authorization.startswith("Bearer "):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="missing or invalid auth")

    token = authorization.removeprefix("Bearer ").strip()

    # Demo only: token format "client_id:signature"
    try:
        client_id, signature = token.split(":", 1)
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="invalid token format")

    expected = hmac.new(
        API_SHARED_SECRET.encode(),
        client_id.encode(),
        hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()

    if not hmac.compare_digest(signature, expected):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="invalid token")

    return client_id

class RiskService:
    def screen_payment(self, payment: Payment) -> None:
        """
        Hook for AML, sanctions, fraud, velocity, and policy checks.
        Raise exception if rejected.
        """
        if payment.source_account == payment.destination_account:
            raise ValueError("source and destination accounts cannot be the same")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Application Service
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

class PaymentService:
    def __init__(
        self,
        repository: PaymentRepository,
        ledger: LedgerService,
        gateway: PaymentRailGateway,
        risk_service: RiskService,
    ) -> None:
        self.repository = repository
        self.ledger = ledger
        self.gateway = gateway
        self.risk_service = risk_service

    def create_payment(self, client_id: str, req: CreatePaymentRequest, idempotency_key: str) -> Payment:
        existing = self.repository.get_by_idempotency_key(client_id, idempotency_key)
        if existing:
            logger.info("Idempotent replay client_id=%s payment_id=%s", client_id, existing.payment_id)
            return existing

        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        payment = Payment(
            payment_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
            client_id=client_id,
            source_account=req.source_account,
            destination_account=req.destination_account,
            amount=Decimal(req.amount),
            currency=req.currency,
            reference=req.reference,
            status=PaymentStatus.PENDING,
            created_at=now,
            updated_at=now,
            idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
            metadata=req.metadata,
        )

        try:
            self.risk_service.screen_payment(payment)
        except ValueError as e:
            payment.status = PaymentStatus.REJECTED
            payment.failure_reason = str(e)
            payment.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            self.repository.save(payment)
            return payment

        self.repository.save(payment)

        try:
            reserved = self.ledger.reserve_funds(payment)
            if not reserved:
                payment.status = PaymentStatus.FAILED
                payment.failure_reason = "insufficient funds or reservation failed"
                payment.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
                self.repository.update(payment)
                return payment

            payment.status = PaymentStatus.AUTHORIZED
            payment.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            self.repository.update(payment)

            submitted = self.gateway.submit(payment)
            if not submitted:
                payment.status = PaymentStatus.FAILED
                payment.failure_reason = "payment rail submission failed"
                payment.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
                self.repository.update(payment)
                return payment

            self.ledger.settle(payment)
            payment.status = PaymentStatus.SETTLED
            payment.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            self.repository.update(payment)
            return payment

        except Exception as e:

            payment.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            self.repository.update(payment)
            return payment

    def get_payment(self, payment_id: str) -> Optional[Payment]:
        return self.repository.get_by_id(payment_id)
```

```python
        if amount <= 0:
            raise ValueError("amount must be greater than zero")
        if amount.as_tuple().exponent < -2:

class InMemoryPaymentRepository:

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._payments: Dict[str, Payment] = {}
        self._by_idempotency_key: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self._lock = Lock()

    def get_by_idempotency_key(self, key: str) -> Optional[Payment]:
        with self._lock:
            payment_id = self._by_idempotency_key.get(key)
            if not payment_id:
                return None
            return self._payments.get(payment_id)

    def create(self, payment: Payment) -> Payment:
        with self._lock:
            if payment.idempotency_key in self._by_idempotency_key:
                existing_id = self._by_idempotency_key[payment.idempotency_key]
                return self._payments[existing_id]

            self._payments[payment.payment_id] = payment
            self._by_idempotency_key[payment.idempotency_key] = payment.payment_id
            return payment

    def get(self, payment_id: str) -> Optional[Payment]:
        with self._lock:
            return self._payments.get(payment_id)

    def update_status(self, payment_id: str, status: PaymentStatus) -> Payment:
        with self._lock:
            payment = self._payments.get(payment_id)
            if not payment:
                raise KeyError("payment not found")
            payment.status = status
            payment.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            return payment

    @staticmethod
    def log(event_type: str, details: dict) -> None:

            "event_type": event_type,

        })


class PaymentProcessor:

    Business logic layer.

    def __init__(self, repo: InMemoryPaymentRepository, audit: AuditLogger) -> None:
        self.repo = repo
        self.audit = audit

    def create_payment(self, req: CreatePaymentRequest, idempotency_key: str) -> Payment:
        existing = self.repo.get_by_idempotency_key(idempotency_key)
        if existing:
            self.audit.log("payment.idempotent_replay", {
                "payment_id": existing.payment_id,
                "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
            })
            return existing

        if req.source_account_id == req.destination_account_id:
            raise ValueError("source and destination accounts must differ")

        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        payment = Payment(
            payment_id=str(uuid4()),
            amount=Decimal(req.amount),
            currency=req.currency,
            source_account_id=req.source_account_id,
            destination_account_id=req.destination_account_id,
            reference=req.reference,
            status=PaymentStatus.PENDING,
            created_at=now,
            updated_at=now,
            idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
        )

        created = self.repo.create(payment)
        self.audit.log("payment.created", {
            "payment_id": created.payment_id,
            "amount": str(created.amount),
            "currency": created.currency.value,
        })

        # Demo processing flow.

        authorized = self.repo.update_status(created.payment_id, PaymentStatus.AUTHORIZED)
        self.audit.log("payment.authorized", {"payment_id": authorized.payment_id})

        captured = self.repo.update_status(created.payment_id, PaymentStatus.CAPTURED)
        self.audit.log("payment.captured", {"payment_id": captured.payment_id})

        return captured

    def get_payment(self, payment_id: str) -> Payment:
        payment = self.repo.get(payment_id)
        if not payment:
            raise KeyError("payment not found")
        return payment
```

```python
from decimal import Decimal
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from app.models import Payment, LedgerEntry, PaymentStatus, LedgerEntryType
from app.repository import PaymentRepository
from app.logging_utils import logger


class PaymentService:
    def __init__(self, repo: PaymentRepository):
        self.repo = repo

    def process_payment(self, request):
        existing = self.repo.get_by_idempotency_key(request.idempotency_key)
        if existing:
            logger.info(
                "Idempotent replay detected for key=%s payment_id=%s",
                request.idempotency_key,
                existing.id
            )
            return existing

        payment = Payment(
            idempotency_key=request.idempotency_key,
            customer_id=request.customer_id,
            source_account=request.source_account,
            destination_account=request.destination_account,
            amount=request.amount,
            currency=request.currency,
            reference=request.reference,
            status=PaymentStatus.PENDING
        )

        try:
            self.repo.create_payment(payment)

            # In a real system:
            # 1. run sanctions/AML screening
            # 2. validate account ownership and status
            # 3. reserve funds
            # 4. call payment rail / core banking adapter
            # 5. wait for authorization/settlement events

            debit = LedgerEntry(
                payment=payment,
                account=request.source_account,
                entry_type=LedgerEntryType.DEBIT,
                amount=request.amount,
                currency=request.currency
            )

            credit = LedgerEntry(
                payment=payment,
                account=request.destination_account,
                entry_type=LedgerEntryType.CREDIT,
                amount=request.amount,
                currency=request.currency
            )

            self.repo.create_ledger_entry(debit)
            self.repo.create_ledger_entry(credit)

            payment.status = PaymentStatus.SETTLED

            self.repo.commit()
            self.repo.refresh(payment)

            logger.info(
                "Payment processed payment_id=%s customer_id=%s amount=%s currency=%s",
                payment.id,
                payment.customer_id,
                str(payment.amount),
                payment.currency
            )
            return payment

        except IntegrityError:
            self.repo.rollback()
            existing = self.repo.get_by_idempotency_key(request.idempotency_key)
            if existing:
                return existing
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            self.repo.rollback()
            logger.exception("Payment processing failed: %s", str(exc))
            raise

    def get_payment_by_idempotency_key(self, idempotency_key: str):
        return self.repo.get_by_idempotency_key(idempotency_key)
```

```python
            request_hash=request_hash,
```

```python
import json
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.domain import (
    PaymentStatus,
    PaymentError,
    can_authorize,
    can_capture,
    can_cancel,
    can_refund,
)
from app.models import Payment
from app.repository import PaymentRepository
from app.integrations import RiskEngine, CoreBankingConnector


class PaymentService:
    def __init__(self, db: Session):
        self.db = db
        self.repo = PaymentRepository(db)
        self.risk = RiskEngine()
        self.connector = CoreBankingConnector()

    def create_payment(self, request):
        allowed = self.risk.screen_payment(
            amount=request.amount,
            currency=request.currency,
            debtor_account=request.debtor_account,
            creditor_account=request.creditor_account,
        )

        status = PaymentStatus.PENDING_AUTHORIZATION if allowed else PaymentStatus.FAILED
        failure_reason = None if allowed else "Risk screening failed"

        payment = Payment(
            client_payment_id=request.client_payment_id,
            payment_type=request.payment_type,
            amount=request.amount,
            currency=request.currency,
            debtor_account=request.debtor_account,
            creditor_account=request.creditor_account,
            status=status,
            description=request.description,
            failure_reason=failure_reason,
        )

        self.repo.create_payment(payment)
        self.repo.add_audit_log(payment.id, "PAYMENT_CREATED", json.dumps({
            "status": payment.status,
            "amount": payment.amount,
            "currency": payment.currency
        }))
        self.db.commit()
        self.db.refresh(payment)
        return payment

    def get_payment(self, payment_id: str):
        payment = self.repo.get_payment(payment_id)
        if not payment:
            raise PaymentError("Payment not found")
        return payment

    def authorize_payment(self, payment_id: str):
        payment = self.get_payment(payment_id)
        if not can_authorize(payment.status):
            raise PaymentError(f"Payment in status {payment.status} cannot be authorized")

        success, reason = self.connector.authorize(payment.payment_type, payment.amount, payment.currency)
        if success:
            payment.status = PaymentStatus.AUTHORIZED
            payment.failure_reason = None
            event = "PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED"
        else:
            payment.status = PaymentStatus.FAILED
            payment.failure_reason = reason or "Authorization failed"
            event = "PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED"

        self.repo.save(payment)
        self.repo.add_audit_log(payment.id, event, json.dumps({
            "status": payment.status,
            "failure_reason": payment.failure_reason
        }))
        self.db.commit()
        self.db.refresh(payment)
        return payment

    def capture_payment(self, payment_id: str):
        payment = self.get_payment(payment_id)
        if not can_capture(payment.status):
            raise PaymentError(f"Payment in status {payment.status} cannot be captured")

        success, reason = self.connector.capture(payment.id, payment.amount, payment.currency)
        if success:
            payment.status = PaymentStatus.CAPTURED
            payment.failure_reason = None
            event = "PAYMENT_CAPTURED"
        else:
            payment.status = PaymentStatus.FAILED
            payment.failure_reason = reason or "Capture failed"
            event = "PAYMENT_CAPTURE_FAILED"

        self.repo.save(payment)
        self.repo.add_audit_log(payment.id, event, json.dumps({
            "status": payment.status,
            "failure_reason": payment.failure_reason
        }))
        self.db.commit()
        self.db.refresh(payment)
        return payment

    def cancel_payment(self, payment_id: str):
        payment = self.get_payment(payment_id)
        if not can_cancel(payment.status):
            raise PaymentError(f"Payment in status {payment.status} cannot be cancelled")

        success, reason = self.connector.cancel(payment.id)
        if success:
            payment.status = PaymentStatus.CANCELLED
            payment.failure_reason = None
            event = "PAYMENT_CANCELLED"
        else:
            payment.failure_reason = reason or "Cancellation failed"
            event = "PAYMENT_CANCELLATION_FAILED"

        self.repo.save(payment)
        self.repo.add_audit_log(payment.id, event, json.dumps({
            "status": payment.status,
            "failure_reason": payment.failure_reason
        }))
        self.db.commit()
        self.db.refresh(payment)
        return payment

    def refund_payment(self, payment_id: str, amount: int):
        payment = self.get_payment(payment_id)
        if not can_refund(payment.status):
            raise PaymentError(f"Payment in status {payment.status} cannot be refunded")

        refundable = payment.amount - payment.refunded_amount
        if amount > refundable:
            raise PaymentError("Refund amount exceeds remaining captured amount")

        success, reason = self.connector.refund(payment.id, amount)
        if not success:
            payment.failure_reason = reason or "Refund failed"
            self.repo.save(payment)
            self.repo.add_audit_log(payment.id, "PAYMENT_REFUND_FAILED", json.dumps({
                "refund_amount": amount,
                "failure_reason": payment.failure_reason
            }))
            self.db.commit()
            self.db.refresh(payment)
            return payment

        payment.refunded_amount += amount
        payment.failure_reason = None
        payment.status = (
            PaymentStatus.REFUNDED
            if payment.refunded_amount == payment.amount
            else PaymentStatus.PARTIALLY_REFUNDED
        )

        self.repo.save(payment)
        self.repo.add_audit_log(payment.id, "PAYMENT_REFUNDED", json.dumps({
            "refund_amount": amount,
            "refunded_total": payment.refunded_amount,
            "status": payment.status
        }))
        self.db.commit()
        self.db.refresh(payment)
        return payment
```

```python
import json
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Header, Response
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.db import get_db
from app.schemas import CreatePaymentRequest, PaymentResponse, RefundRequest
from app.service import PaymentService
from app.repository import PaymentRepository
from app.domain import PaymentError

router = APIRouter()


@router.post("/payments", response_model=PaymentResponse, status_code=201)
def create_payment(
    request: CreatePaymentRequest,
    response: Response,
    idempotency_key: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="Idempotency-Key"),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    repo = PaymentRepository(db)

    if idempotency_key:
        request_hash = repo.hash_request(request.model_dump())
        existing = repo.get_idempotency_key(idempotency_key)
        if existing:
            if existing.request_hash != request_hash:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Idempotency key reused with different payload")
            response.status_code = existing.status_code
            return json.loads(existing.response_body)

    service = PaymentService(db)
    try:
        payment = service.create_payment(request)
    except PaymentError as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e))

    payload = PaymentResponse.model_validate(payment).model_dump(mode="json")
    if idempotency_key:
        repo.save_idempotency_key(
            key=idempotency_key,
            request_hash=repo.hash_request(request.model_dump()),
            response_body=json.dumps(payload),
            status_code=201,
        )
        db.commit()

    return payload
```

```python
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="payment_not_capturable")

    remaining = payment.authorized_amount - payment.captured_amount
    capture_amount = request.amount if request.amount is not None else remaining

    if capture_amount <= 0 or capture_amount > remaining:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="invalid_capture_amount")

    payment.captured_amount += capture_amount
    payment.status = "captured" if payment.captured_amount == payment.authorized_amount else "partially_captured"

    refund_amount = request.amount if request.amount is not None else refundable

    if refund_amount <= 0 or refund_amount > refundable:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="invalid_refund_amount")

    payment.refunded_amount += refund_amount

    if payment.refunded_amount == payment.captured_amount:
```

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Header
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, constr, conint
from typing import Optional, Dict, Literal
from uuid import uuid4
from datetime import datetime

app = FastAPI(title="Mock Payment Processing Service")

# In-memory stores
payments: Dict[str, dict] = {}
idempotency_store: Dict[str, dict] = {}

Currency = Literal["USD", "EUR", "GBP"]
PaymentStatus = Literal["authorized", "captured", "refunded", "failed"]

class CardDetails(BaseModel):
    pan: constr(min_length=12, max_length=19)
    exp_month: conint(ge=1, le=12)
    exp_year: conint(ge=2024, le=2100)
    cvv: constr(min_length=3, max_length=4)

class CreatePaymentRequest(BaseModel):
    amount: conint(gt=0) = Field(..., description="Amount in minor units, e.g. cents")
    currency: Currency
    merchant_id: constr(min_length=1, max_length=64)
    card: CardDetails

class PaymentResponse(BaseModel):
    payment_id: str
    status: PaymentStatus
    amount: int
    currency: Currency
    merchant_id: str
    created_at: str
    captured_amount: int = 0
    refunded_amount: int = 0

class CaptureRequest(BaseModel):
    amount: Optional[conint(gt=0)] = None

class RefundRequest(BaseModel):
    amount: Optional[conint(gt=0)] = None

def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"

def mask_pan(pan: str) -> str:
    return "*" * (len(pan) - 4) + pan[-4:]

def build_response(payment: dict) -> PaymentResponse:
    return PaymentResponse(
        payment_id=payment["payment_id"],
        status=payment["status"],
        amount=payment["amount"],
        currency=payment["currency"],
        merchant_id=payment["merchant_id"],
        created_at=payment["created_at"],
        captured_amount=payment["captured_amount"],
        refunded_amount=payment["refunded_amount"],
    )

@app.get("/health")
def health():
    return {"status": "ok", "time": now_iso()}

@app.post("/payments", response_model=PaymentResponse)
def create_payment(
    req: CreatePaymentRequest,
    idempotency_key: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="Idempotency-Key")
):
    if idempotency_key and idempotency_key in idempotency_store:
        return build_response(idempotency_store[idempotency_key])

    # Mock authorization logic
    # Decline cards ending in 0000 to simulate failures
    status: PaymentStatus = "failed" if req.card.pan.endswith("0000") else "authorized"

    payment_id = str(uuid4())
    payment = {
        "payment_id": payment_id,
        "status": status,
        "amount": req.amount,
        "currency": req.currency,
        "merchant_id": req.merchant_id,
        "created_at": now_iso(),
        "captured_amount": 0,
        "refunded_amount": 0,
        "card_last4": req.card.pan[-4:],
        "card_masked": mask_pan(req.card.pan),
    }

    payments[payment_id] = payment
    if idempotency_key:
        idempotency_store[idempotency_key] = payment

    return build_response(payment)

@app.get("/payments/{payment_id}", response_model=PaymentResponse)
def get_payment(payment_id: str):
    payment = payments.get(payment_id)
    if not payment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Payment not found")
    return build_response(payment)

@app.post("/payments/{payment_id}/capture", response_model=PaymentResponse)
def capture_payment(payment_id: str, req: CaptureRequest):
    payment = payments.get(payment_id)
    if not payment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Payment not found")

    if payment["status"] != "authorized":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Only authorized payments can be captured")

    capture_amount = req.amount if req.amount is not None else payment["amount"]

    if capture_amount > payment["amount"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Capture amount exceeds authorized amount")

    payment["captured_amount"] = capture_amount
    payment["status"] = "captured"
    return build_response(payment)

@app.post("/payments/{payment_id}/refund", response_model=PaymentResponse)
def refund_payment(payment_id: str, req: RefundRequest):
    payment = payments.get(payment_id)
    if not payment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Payment not found")

    if payment["status"] not in ("captured", "refunded"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Only captured payments can be refunded")

    refundable = payment["captured_amount"] - payment["refunded_amount"]
    refund_amount = req.amount if req.amount is not None else refundable

    if refund_amount <= 0:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Nothing left to refund")

    if refund_amount > refundable:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Refund amount exceeds captured balance")

    payment["refunded_amount"] += refund_amount
    if payment["refunded_amount"] == payment["captured_amount"]:
        payment["status"] = "refunded"

    return build_response(payment)
```

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Dict, Optional, Literal
from uuid import uuid4
from datetime import datetime

app = FastAPI(title="Mock Payment Workflow Service")

PaymentStatus = Literal["pending", "approved", "rejected", "settled"]

class CreatePaymentRequest(BaseModel):
    customer_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=64)
    amount: float = Field(..., gt=0)
    currency: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=3)
    reference: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=140)

class Payment(BaseModel):
    payment_id: str
    customer_id: str
    amount: float
    currency: str
    reference: Optional[str]
    status: PaymentStatus
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str

class UpdateStatusRequest(BaseModel):
    status: Literal["approved", "rejected", "settled"]

payments: Dict[str, Payment] = {}

@app.get("/health")
def health():
    return {"status": "ok"}

@app.post("/payments", response_model=Payment)
def create_payment(req: CreatePaymentRequest):
    now = datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"
    payment = Payment(
        payment_id=str(uuid4()),
        customer_id=req.customer_id,
        amount=round(req.amount, 2),
        currency=req.currency.upper(),
        reference=req.reference,
        status="pending",
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
    )
    payments[payment.payment_id] = payment
    return payment

@app.get("/payments/{payment_id}", response_model=Payment)
def get_payment(payment_id: str):
    payment = payments.get(payment_id)
    if not payment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Payment not found")
    return payment

@app.post("/payments/{payment_id}/status", response_model=Payment)
def update_payment_status(payment_id: str, req: UpdateStatusRequest):
    payment = payments.get(payment_id)
    if not payment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Payment not found")

    valid_transitions = {
        "pending": {"approved", "rejected"},
        "approved": {"settled"},
        "rejected": set(),
        "settled": set(),
    }

    if req.status not in valid_transitions[payment.status]:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"Invalid status transition from {payment.status} to {req.status}"
        )

    payment.status = req.status
    payment.updated_at = datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"
    payments[payment_id] = payment
    return payment
```

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Header, Depends
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, constr
from typing import Optional, Dict, Literal
from uuid import uuid4
from datetime import datetime
import os

app = FastAPI(title="Mock Payment Processing Service", version="0.1.0")

API_KEY = os.getenv("MOCK_API_KEY", "dev-secret-key")

payments: Dict[str, dict] = {}
idempotency_index: Dict[str, str] = {}


def require_api_key(x_api_key: Optional[str] = Header(default=None)):
    if x_api_key != API_KEY:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Unauthorized")


class PaymentCreate(BaseModel):
    amount: int = Field(..., gt=0, description="Amount in minor units, e.g. cents")
    currency: constr(min_length=3, max_length=3) = "USD"
    source_account: str = Field(..., min_length=4, max_length=64)
    destination_account: str = Field(..., min_length=4, max_length=64)
    reference: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=140)
    simulate_outcome: Literal["success", "failure", "pending"] = "success"


class PaymentResponse(BaseModel):
    payment_id: str
    status: Literal["pending", "succeeded", "failed"]
    amount: int
    currency: str
    source_account: str
    destination_account: str
    reference: Optional[str]
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    failure_reason: Optional[str] = None


@app.get("/health")
def health():
    return {"status": "ok", "mode": "mock-only"}


@app.post("/payments", response_model=PaymentResponse, dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)])
def create_payment(
    payload: PaymentCreate,
    idempotency_key: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="Idempotency-Key")
):
    if idempotency_key and idempotency_key in idempotency_index:
        existing_id = idempotency_index[idempotency_key]
        return payments[existing_id]

    payment_id = str(uuid4())
    now = datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"

    status = "pending"
    failure_reason = None

    if payload.simulate_outcome == "success":
        status = "succeeded"
    elif payload.simulate_outcome == "failure":
        status = "failed"
        failure_reason = "simulated_failure"
    elif payload.simulate_outcome == "pending":
        status = "pending"

    payment = {
        "payment_id": payment_id,
        "status": status,
        "amount": payload.amount,
        "currency": payload.currency.upper(),
        "source_account": payload.source_account,
        "destination_account": payload.destination_account,
        "reference": payload.reference,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
        "failure_reason": failure_reason,
    }

    payments[payment_id] = payment

    if idempotency_key:
        idempotency_index[idempotency_key] = payment_id

    return payment


@app.get("/payments/{payment_id}", response_model=PaymentResponse, dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)])
def get_payment(payment_id: str):
    payment = payments.get(payment_id)
    if not payment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Payment not found")
    return payment


@app.get("/payments", dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)])
def list_payments():
    return {"items": list(payments.values()), "count": len(payments)}


class PaymentUpdateStatus(BaseModel):
    status: Literal["pending", "succeeded", "failed"]

    payment["updated_at"] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"
```

```python
    currency: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=3)
    source_token: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=128)
    capture_method: Literal["automatic", "manual"] = "automatic"


class PaymentResponse(BaseModel):

    amount: Decimal
    currency: str
    status: Literal["authorized", "captured", "refunded", "failed"]
    capture_method: Literal["automatic", "manual"]
    created_at: str
    captured_at: Optional[str] = None
    refunded_at: Optional[str] = None


class RefundRequest(BaseModel):

):

        return idempotency_store[idempotency_key]

    payment_id = f"pay_{uuid4().hex[:24]}"
    status = "captured" if req.capture_method == "automatic" else "authorized"
    created_at = now_iso()
    captured_at = created_at if status == "captured" else None

    payment = {
        "id": payment_id,
        "amount": req.amount,
        "currency": req.currency.upper(),
        "status": status,
        "capture_method": req.capture_method,
        "created_at": created_at,
        "captured_at": captured_at,
        "refunded_at": None,
        "source_token_last4": req.source_token[-4:],
    }

    payments[payment_id] = payment
    if idempotency_key:
        idempotency_store[idempotency_key] = payment

    return payment


@app.get("/payments/{payment_id}", response_model=PaymentResponse)

    payment = payments.get(payment_id)
    if not payment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Payment not found")

    if not payment:

    if payment["status"] == "captured":
        return payment
    if payment["status"] != "authorized":

    payment["status"] = "captured"
    payment["captured_at"] = now_iso()
    return payment
```

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Header
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, constr, condecimal
from typing import Optional, Literal, Dict, Any
from decimal import Decimal
from uuid import uuid4
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import logging

app = FastAPI(title="Mock Payment Processing Service", version="0.1.0")

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger("payment_service")

# In-memory stores: demo only
payments: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
idempotency_store: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}

Currency = Literal["USD", "EUR", "GBP"]
PaymentStatus = Literal["authorized", "captured", "refunded", "failed"]

def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

class PaymentCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    amount: condecimal(gt=Decimal("0.00"), max_digits=12, decimal_places=2)
    currency: Currency
    source_account: constr(min_length=6, max_length=34)
    destination_account: constr(min_length=6, max_length=34)
    reference: Optional[constr(max_length=140)] = None
    auto_capture: bool = False

class PaymentResponse(BaseModel):
    payment_id: str
    status: PaymentStatus
    amount: Decimal
    currency: Currency
    source_account: str
    destination_account: str
    reference: Optional[str]
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str

class RefundRequest(BaseModel):
    amount: Optional[condecimal(gt=Decimal("0.00"), max_digits=12, decimal_places=2)] = None

def audit(event: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    logger.info({"event": event, "timestamp": now_iso(), "payload": payload})

@app.get("/health")
def health():
    return {"status": "ok", "service": "mock-payment-processor"}

@app.post("/payments", response_model=PaymentResponse)
def create_payment(
    request: PaymentCreateRequest,
    idempotency_key: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="Idempotency-Key")
):
    if request.source_account == request.destination_account:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="source and destination accounts must differ")

    if idempotency_key and idempotency_key in idempotency_store:
        existing = idempotency_store[idempotency_key]
        audit("payment.create.idempotent_replay", {"idempotency_key": idempotency_key, "payment_id": existing["payment_id"]})
        return existing

    payment_id = str(uuid4())
    timestamp = now_iso()
    status: PaymentStatus = "captured" if request.auto_capture else "authorized"

    payment = {
        "payment_id": payment_id,
        "status": status,
        "amount": request.amount,
        "currency": request.currency,
        "source_account": request.source_account,
        "destination_account": request.destination_account,
        "reference": request.reference,
        "created_at": timestamp,
        "updated_at": timestamp,
    }

    payments[payment_id] = payment

    if idempotency_key:
        idempotency_store[idempotency_key] = payment

    audit("payment.created", {
        "payment_id": payment_id,
        "status": status,
        "amount": str(request.amount),
        "currency": request.currency
    })

    return payment

@app.get("/payments/{payment_id}", response_model=PaymentResponse)
def get_payment(payment_id: str):
    payment = payments.get(payment_id)
    if not payment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="payment not found")
    return payment

@app.post("/payments/{payment_id}/capture", response_model=PaymentResponse)
def capture_payment(payment_id: str):
    payment = payments.get(payment_id)
    if not payment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="payment not found")

    if payment["status"] == "captured":
        return payment

    if payment["status"] != "authorized":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=f"cannot capture payment in status '{payment['status']}'")

    payment["status"] = "captured"
    payment["updated_at"] = now_iso()

    audit("payment.captured", {"payment_id": payment_id})
    return payment

@app.post("/payments/{payment_id}/refund", response_model=PaymentResponse)
def refund_payment(payment_id: str, request: RefundRequest):
    payment = payments.get(payment_id)
    if not payment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="payment not found")

    if payment["status"] != "captured":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="only captured payments can be refunded")

    refund_amount = request.amount if request.amount is not None else payment["amount"]

    if refund_amount > payment["amount"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="refund amount exceeds original payment amount")

    # Minimal model: any refund marks the payment refunded.
    payment["status"] = "refunded"
    payment["updated_at"] = now_iso()

    audit("payment.refunded", {
        "payment_id": payment_id,
        "refund_amount": str(refund_amount)
    })
    return payment
```

```python
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify
from uuid import uuid4
from datetime import datetime

app = Flask(__name__)

payments = {}

@app.route("/health", methods=["GET"])
def health():
    return jsonify({"status": "ok"})

@app.route("/payments", methods=["POST"])
def create_payment():
    data = request.get_json(force=True)

    required = ["from_account", "to_account", "amount", "currency"]
    missing = [f for f in required if f not in data]
    if missing:
        return jsonify({"error": "missing_fields", "fields": missing}), 400

    if not isinstance(data["amount"], (int, float)) or data["amount"] <= 0:
        return jsonify({"error": "invalid_amount"}), 400

    payment_id = str(uuid4())
    payment = {
        "payment_id": payment_id,
        "from_account": str(data["from_account"]),
        "to_account": str(data["to_account"]),
        "amount": round(float(data["amount"]), 2),
        "currency": str(data["currency"]).upper(),
        "status": "processed",
        "created_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"
    }

    payments[payment_id] = payment
    return jsonify(payment), 201

@app.route("/payments/<payment_id>", methods=["GET"])
def get_payment(payment_id):
    payment = payments.get(payment_id)
    if not payment:
        return jsonify({"error": "not_found"}), 404
    return jsonify(payment)

@app.route("/payments", methods=["GET"])
def list_payments():
    return jsonify({"payments": list(payments.values())})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(debug=True, port=5000)
```

```csharp
using EnterpriseBackend.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Infrastructure.Data;

public class AppDbContext : DbContext
{
    public AppDbContext(DbContextOptions<AppDbContext> options) : base(options)
    {
    }

    public DbSet<Customer> Customers => Set<Customer>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        modelBuilder.Entity<Customer>(entity =>
        {
            entity.ToTable("Customers");
            entity.HasKey(x => x.Id);

            entity.Property(x => x.ExternalId)
                .HasMaxLength(100)
                .IsRequired();

            entity.Property(x => x.DisplayName)
                .HasMaxLength(200)
                .IsRequired();

            entity.Property(x => x.Email)
                .HasMaxLength(320)
                .IsRequired();

            entity.Property(x => x.CreatedUtc)
                .IsRequired();

            entity.HasIndex(x => x.ExternalId).IsUnique();
            entity.HasIndex(x => x.Email);
        });
    }
}
```

## 4.5 Application service implementation

**`src/EnterpriseBackend.Infrastructure/Repositories/CustomerService.cs`**

```csharp
using EnterpriseBackend.Application.DTOs;
using EnterpriseBackend.Application.Interfaces;
using EnterpriseBackend.Infrastructure.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class CustomerService : ICustomerService
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _dbContext;

    public CustomerService(AppDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyCollection<CustomerDto>> GetAllAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return await _dbContext.Customers
            .AsNoTracking()
            .OrderBy(x => x.DisplayName)
            .Select(x => new CustomerDto(
                x.Id,
                x.ExternalId,
                x.DisplayName,
                x.Email))
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<CustomerDto?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return await _dbContext.Customers
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(x => x.Id == id)
            .Select(x => new CustomerDto(
                x.Id,
                x.ExternalId,
                x.DisplayName,
                x.Email))
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using EnterpriseBackend.Application.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v{version:apiVersion}/customers")]

{
    private readonly ICustomerService _customerService;

    public CustomersController(ICustomerService customerService)
    {
        _customerService = customerService;
    }

    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var customers = await _customerService.GetAllAsync(cancellationToken);
        return Ok(customers);
    }

    [HttpGet("{id:guid}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetById(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var customer = await _customerService.GetByIdAsync(id, cancellationToken);

        if (customer is null)
            return NotFound();

        return Ok(customer);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Azure.Identity;
using EnterpriseBackend.Application.Interfaces;
using EnterpriseBackend.Infrastructure.Data;
using EnterpriseBackend.Infrastructure.Repositories;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Identity.Web;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Configuration sources
builder.Configuration
    .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json", optional: false, reloadOnChange: true)
    .AddJsonFile($"appsettings.{builder.Environment.EnvironmentName}.json", optional: true, reloadOnChange: true)
    .AddEnvironmentVariables();

// Optional: Azure Key Vault
var keyVaultUri = builder.Configuration["KeyVault:VaultUri"];
if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(keyVaultUri))
{
    builder.Configuration.AddAzureKeyVault(
        new Uri(keyVaultUri),
        new DefaultAzureCredential());
}

// Logging / telemetry
builder.Services.AddApplicationInsightsTelemetry();

// Controllers
builder.Services.AddControllers();

// API versioning
builder.Services.AddApiVersioning(options =>
{
    options.DefaultApiVersion = new Asp.Versioning.ApiVersion(1, 0);
    options.AssumeDefaultVersionWhenUnspecified = true;
    options.ReportApiVersions = true;
})
.AddApiExplorer(options =>
{
    options.GroupNameFormat = "'v'VVV";
    options.SubstituteApiVersionInUrl = true;
});

// Swagger
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

// Authentication with Microsoft Entra ID
builder.Services
    .AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddMicrosoftIdentityWebApi(builder.Configuration.GetSection("AzureAd"));

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.FallbackPolicy = options.DefaultPolicy;
});

// Database
builder.Services.AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(options =>
    options.UseSqlServer(builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("SqlServer")));

// Health checks
builder.Services.AddHealthChecks()
    .AddDbContextCheck<AppDbContext>("database");

// Dependency injection
builder.Services.AddScoped<ICustomerService, CustomerService>();

var app = builder.Build();

// Middleware pipeline
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();

app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapControllers();
app.MapHealthChecks("/health");
app.MapHealthChecks("/ready");

app.Run();
```

- Use **Microsoft Entra ID**
- Define **app roles** or **scopes**
- Add policy-based authorization, for example:

```csharp
builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("CustomerRead", policy =>
        policy.RequireClaim("scp", "Customers.Read"));
});
```

Then on controller/action:

```csharp
[Authorize(Policy = "CustomerRead")]
```

## Secrets
- Use **Managed Identity**
- Store secrets in **Azure Key Vault**
- Avoid connection strings with passwords

## Network security
- Restrict inbound access with:
  - Private endpoints
  - VNet integration
  - Azure API Management in front of the service
- Consider **App Gateway / WAF**

## Data protection
- Encrypt at rest via Azure SQL defaults
- Enforce TLS
- Add audit logging for sensitive operations

---

# 10. Production improvements to add next

This initial implementation is a solid base, but for a real enterprise rollout, next steps should include:

## API management
- Put **Azure API Management** in front of the service
- Centralize throttling, auth, routing, and developer portal

## Structured logging
Use Serilog or OpenTelemetry exporters:

```bash
dotnet add src/EnterpriseBackend.Api package Serilog.AspNetCore
dotnet add src/EnterpriseBackend.Api package Serilog.Sinks.Console
dotnet add src/EnterpriseBackend.Api package Serilog.Sinks.ApplicationInsights
```

## Exception handling middleware
Add a global exception handler returning RFC7807 ProblemDetails.

## Validation
Use FluentValidation or built-in model validation.

## Resilience
For downstream calls:
- Polly retry/circuit breaker
- timeout policies

## Background processing
If needed:
- Azure Service Bus
- Azure Functions
- Hosted services

## Caching
- Azure Cache for Redis

## Zero trust / internal enterprise controls
- Private DNS
- Managed identities everywhere
- Conditional access aware design

## Option A: Azure App Service
Best if:
- team is comfortable with PaaS

- no strong Kubernetes requirement

## Option B: Azure Container Apps
Best if:

```csharp
using Azure.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using EnterpriseBackend.Services;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Load Azure Key Vault if configured
var keyVaultUrl = builder.Configuration["KeyVault:Url"];
if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(keyVaultUrl))
{
    builder.Configuration.AddAzureKeyVault(
        new Uri(keyVaultUrl),
        new DefaultAzureCredential());
}

// Logging
builder.Logging.ClearProviders();
builder.Logging.AddConsole();

// Application Insights
var appInsightsConnectionString = builder.Configuration["ApplicationInsights:ConnectionString"];
if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(appInsightsConnectionString))
{
    builder.Services.AddApplicationInsightsTelemetry(options =>
    {
        options.ConnectionString = appInsightsConnectionString;
    });
}

// Services
builder.Services.AddSingleton<TimeService>();
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();

// Authentication with Azure AD / Entra ID
var tenantId = builder.Configuration["AzureAd:TenantId"];
var audience = builder.Configuration["AzureAd:Audience"];

if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(tenantId) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(audience))
{
    builder.Services
        .AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
        .AddJwtBearer(options =>
        {
            options.Authority = $"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenantId}/v2.0";
            options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
            {
                ValidateIssuer = true,
                ValidateAudience = true,
                ValidAudience = audience,
                ValidateLifetime = true
            };
        });

    builder.Services.AddAuthorization();
}

var app = builder.Build();

app.UseHttpsRedirection();

if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(tenantId) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(audience))
{
    app.UseAuthentication();
    app.UseAuthorization();
}

// Minimal health endpoint
app.MapGet("/health", () => Results.Ok(new
{
    status = "Healthy",
    timestampUtc = DateTime.UtcNow
}));

app.MapControllers();

app.Run();
```

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.Identity.Web;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Logging
builder.Logging.ClearProviders();
builder.Logging.AddConsole();
builder.Logging.AddDebug();

    .AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddMicrosoftIdentityWebApi(builder.Configuration.GetSection("AzureAd"));

builder.Services.AddAuthorization();

builder.Services.AddControllers();

// Swagger for testing
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

var app = builder.Build();

// Middleware pipeline
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();

app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

// Public health endpoint
app.MapGet("/health", () => Results.Ok(new
{
    status = "Healthy",
    service = "EnterpriseBackend",
    utc = DateTime.UtcNow
}));

app.MapControllers();

app.Run();
```

# 5. `Controllers/ProfileController.cs`

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using System.Security.Claims;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class ProfileController : ControllerBase
{
    [Authorize]
    [HttpGet]
    public IActionResult Get()
    {
        var name = User.Identity?.Name ?? "unknown";
        var objectId = User.FindFirstValue("oid") ?? "unknown";
        var upn = User.FindFirstValue("preferred_username") ?? "unknown";

        return Ok(new
        {
            message = "Authenticated request successful",
            user = new
            {
                name,
                objectId,
                upn
            }
        });
    }
}
```

## `Controllers/StatusController.cs`

```csharp
using EnterpriseBackend.Services;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class StatusController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ITimeService _timeService;
    private readonly ILogger<StatusController> _logger;

    public StatusController(ITimeService timeService, ILogger<StatusController> logger)
    {
        _timeService = timeService;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [HttpGet("health")]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public IActionResult Health()
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Health endpoint called at {Time}", _timeService.UtcNow);
        return Ok(new
        {
            status = "Healthy",
            timestampUtc = _timeService.UtcNow,
            machine = Environment.MachineName
        });
    }

    [HttpGet("secure")]
    [Authorize]
    public IActionResult Secure()
    {
        var userName = User.Identity?.Name ?? "unknown";
        return Ok(new
        {
            message = "Authenticated request successful",
            user = userName,
            timestampUtc = _timeService.UtcNow
        });
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using System.Security.Claims;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Controllers;

public class SecureController : ControllerBase

        var claims = User.Claims.Select(c => new { c.Type, c.Value });

        return Ok(new
        {
            message = "This is a protected endpoint.",
            user = userName,
            claims
        });
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class SecureController : ControllerBase
{
    [HttpGet("public")]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public IActionResult Public()
    {
        return Ok(new { message = "This is a public endpoint." });
    }

    [HttpGet("private")]
    [Authorize]
    public IActionResult Private()
    {
        return Ok(new { message = "Authenticated access granted." });
    }

    [HttpGet("scope-required")]
    [Authorize]
    public IActionResult ScopeRequired()
    {
        var scopes = User.Claims
            .Where(c => c.Type == "scp")
            .Select(c => c.Value)
            .ToList();

        if (!scopes.Any(s => s.Split(' ').Contains("access_as_user")))
        {
            return Forbid();
        }

        return Ok(new
        {
            message = "Required scope present.",
            scopes
        });
    }
}
```

```csharp
app.MapControllers();
```

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Logging
builder.Logging.ClearProviders();
builder.Logging.AddConsole();

// Configuration
var configuration = builder.Configuration;

// Services
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

// Authentication with Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD
var tenantId = configuration["AzureAd:TenantId"];
var audience = configuration["AzureAd:Audience"];

if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(tenantId) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(audience))
{
    builder.Services
        .AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
        .AddJwtBearer(options =>
        {
            options.Authority = $"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenantId}/v2.0";
            options.Audience = audience;
            options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
            {
                ValidateIssuer = true,
                ValidateAudience = true,
                ValidateLifetime = true
            };
        });

    builder.Services.AddAuthorization();
}

var app = builder.Build();

// Middleware
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();

if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(tenantId) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(audience))
{
    app.UseAuthentication();
    app.UseAuthorization();
}

app.MapControllers();

app.MapGet("/health", () => Results.Ok(new
{
    status = "Healthy",
    timestamp = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow
}));

app.Run();
```

# 3. `Controllers/OrdersController.cs`

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class OrdersController : ControllerBase
{
    private static readonly List<OrderDto> Orders =
    [
        new OrderDto(1, "Laptop", 5),
        new OrderDto(2, "Monitor", 10)
    ];

    private readonly ILogger<OrdersController> _logger;

    public OrdersController(ILogger<OrdersController> logger)
    {
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [HttpGet]
    [Authorize]
    public IActionResult GetAll()
    {
        var user = User.Identity?.Name ?? "unknown";
        _logger.LogInformation("Orders requested by {User}", user);
        return Ok(Orders);
    }

    [HttpGet("{id:int}")]
    [Authorize]
    public IActionResult GetById(int id)
    {
        var order = Orders.FirstOrDefault(o => o.Id == id);
        if (order is null)
            return NotFound();

        return Ok(order);
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize]
    public IActionResult Create([FromBody] CreateOrderRequest request)
    {
        var nextId = Orders.Count == 0 ? 1 : Orders.Max(o => o.Id) + 1;
        var order = new OrderDto(nextId, request.ProductName, request.Quantity);
        Orders.Add(order);

        _logger.LogInformation("Order created: {OrderId}", order.Id);

        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetById), new { id = order.Id }, order);
    }
}

public record OrderDto(int Id, string ProductName, int Quantity);
public record CreateOrderRequest(string ProductName, int Quantity);
```

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using EnterpriseBackend.Services;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Configuration
var config = builder.Configuration;

// Logging
builder.Logging.ClearProviders();
builder.Logging.AddConsole();

// Services
builder.Services.AddSingleton<TimeService>();
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

// Application Insights
builder.Services.AddApplicationInsightsTelemetry();

// Authentication with Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD JWT
builder.Services
    .AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddJwtBearer(options =>
    {
        options.Authority = $"{config["AzureAd:Instance"]}{config["AzureAd:TenantId"]}/v2.0";
        options.Audience = config["AzureAd:Audience"];

        options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
        {
            ValidateIssuer = true,
            ValidateAudience = true,
            ValidateLifetime = true
        };
    });

builder.Services.AddAuthorization();

var app = builder.Build();

// Middleware
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{

    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();

app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapControllers();
```

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class StatusController : ControllerBase

    private readonly TimeService _timeService;
    private readonly ILogger<StatusController> _logger;

    public StatusController(TimeService timeService, ILogger<StatusController> logger)
    {
        _timeService = timeService;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [HttpGet]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public ActionResult<StatusResponse> GetPublicStatus()
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Public status endpoint called.");

        return Ok(new StatusResponse
        {
            Service = "EnterpriseBackend",
            Environment = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT") ?? "Unknown",
            CurrentUtcTime = _timeService.GetUtcNow(),
            Authenticated = false
        });
    }

    [HttpGet("secure")]
    [Authorize]
    public ActionResult<StatusResponse> GetSecureStatus()
    {
        var userName = User.Identity?.Name ?? "unknown";
        _logger.LogInformation("Secure status endpoint called by {UserName}", userName);

        return Ok(new StatusResponse
        {
            Service = "EnterpriseBackend",
            Environment = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT") ?? "Unknown",
            CurrentUtcTime = _timeService.GetUtcNow(),
            Authenticated = true,
            User = userName
        });
    }
}
```

```csharp
using EnterpriseBackend.Api.Data;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;

using Microsoft.Identity.Web;

builder.Logging.AddConsole();

// Services
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

// SQL Server / Azure SQL
builder.Services.AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(options =>
    options.UseSqlServer(configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")));

// Azure AD / Entra ID JWT auth
builder.Services
    .AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddMicrosoftIdentityWebApi(configuration.GetSection("AzureAd"));

builder.Services.AddAuthorization();

// Health checks
builder.Services.AddHealthChecks()
    .AddDbContextCheck<AppDbContext>();

var app = builder.Build();

// Middleware
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();

app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapControllers();

app.Run();
```

```csharp
using EnterpriseBackend.Api.Data;
using EnterpriseBackend.Api.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class StatusController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _db;

    public StatusController(AppDbContext db)
    {
        _db = db;
    }

    [HttpGet("ping")]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public IActionResult Ping()
    {
        return Ok(new
        {
            service = "EnterpriseBackend.Api",
            status = "ok",
            utc = DateTime.UtcNow
        });
    }

    [HttpGet("customers")]
    [Authorize]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetCustomers()
    {
        var customers = await _db.Customers.AsNoTracking().ToListAsync();
        return Ok(customers);
    }

    [HttpPost("customers")]
    [Authorize]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateCustomer([FromBody] Customer customer)
    {
        _db.Customers.Add(customer);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetCustomers), new { id = customer.Id }, customer);
    }
}
```
